name: add-component-version-to-version-info
negative_constraints: 不要把新行直接追加在列表末尾或 Platform/OS 块中。库版本应留在 Qt/PyQt 所在的分组内。
不要在 PyQt 行和新行上都保留 '\n\n'。那样会产生多余空行,或打乱现有分组布局。
不要硬编码版本字符串,也不要通过解析 user agent 得到版本。应使用 Qt/PyQt 提供的运行时 API,如 qWebKitVersion()。
不要为这一行展示改动去重构 version() 的整体拼接方式。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/utils/__init__.py 中的 version() 函数。它把多行字符串拼成一个列表来生成版本信息。
从 PyQt5 对应模块导入现成的运行时版本函数。例如 WebKit 版本用 `from PyQt5.QtWebKit import qWebKitVersion`。导入语句与现有的 PyQt5.QtCore 导入放在一起。

移动段落分隔符:把原本挂在 PyQt 行末尾的 '

' 改成单个 '
',再把 '

' 放到新的最后一行库版本上。这样库版本块与后面 Platform 块之间的空行仍然只有一处。
保持其余行(Platform、OS Version 等)的顺序和格式不变。
validation: 运行 python -c 'from qutebrowser.utils import version; print(version())'。确认输出中出现 'Webkit <x.y>',它紧跟在 PyQt 行之后,且与 Platform 块之间恰好有一个空行。
确认新导入在目标环境中可用:PyQt5.QtWebKit 已安装,且导入时没有报错。
运行现有测试或执行 lint(pyflakes/pylint),确认没有未使用的导入或语法错误。

name: add-general-config-option-with-default
negative_constraints: Do not read a new option without a fallback. Existing user config files will not contain it.
Do not add the option to code only. It must also appear in default_config.
procedure: Add the key=value line under the right section of the default_config string in qutebrowser/utils/config.py, keeping the existing indentation.
In the place that uses the option, read it with the typed getter (getboolean/getint) and a fallback equal to the default. This keeps older user configs that lack the key working.
Use a short lowercase key name that matches the other entries (show_completion, space_scroll).
validation: Start the app with an existing config file that lacks the new keys and confirm there is no NoOptionError.
Confirm that a fresh config file contains the new defaults.

name: audit-equal-specificity-qss-rule-order
negative_constraints: Do not assume that declaration order in the Python property code affects the visual priority. Only the QSS rule order matters.
procedure: When a widget's state color does not appear while another state is also active, list every rule in the widget's STYLESHEET that targets the same selector and differs only in an attribute.
Write down the intended priority of those states.
Reorder the rules so that a higher priority means a later position in the stylesheet.
Add a short comment noting that the order defines precedence, so that future additions are placed correctly.
validation: Run the existing tests.
Activate the conflicting states together and check that the highest-priority color is the one rendered.

name: audit-loop-guard-pass-vs-continue
negative_constraints: 不要在未确认意图前把所有 `pass` 机械地替换成 `continue`。有些 `pass` 是有意的占位。
不要在 bugfix 中引入与过滤无关的重构。
procedure: 当循环中某个过滤条件看起来没有生效时(结果包含应排除的项),先查找 `if <exclude-condition>: pass` 模式。
确认作者意图是跳过当前项。确认后,将 `pass` 替换为 `continue`。
把紧随的独立 `if` 并入 `elif` 链,使各个守卫分支互斥、可读。
在同一文件或模块中 grep 类似的 `startswith(...)` 加 `pass` 组合,一并评估。只修复明确有误的地方。
validation: run existing tests
构造包含应被过滤项的输入,断言输出中不再包含这些项。

name: avoid-local-var-shadowing-imported-module
negative_constraints: Do not rename or alias the module import, e.g. `from ... import config as conf`. That would affect every use of the import in the file.
Do not leave any old name in the same scope only half replaced. In particular, check the arguments of `functools.partial` and lambdas.
Do not change surrounding logic, such as the disconnect workaround for older PyQt versions (issue #390), while doing the rename.
Do not add tests or a changelog entry for a pure variable rename.
procedure: Locate the local variable assignments in the function that share a name with a module-level import. For example, in qutebrowser/browser/webview.py, `config = objreg.get('config')` shadows `from qutebrowser.config import config`.

Confirm the collision: check the module's import list. Then decide whether code later in the same function, or code that may be added later, still needs the imported module (e.g. `config.get(...)`). Assigning to the name inside the function makes it local for the whole function body, so any use before the assignment raises UnboundLocalError.
Rename the local variable to a short name that does not collide with anything. Use the repository's existing convention `cfg = objreg.get('config')` for the config object fetched from the registry.

Replace every use of the old local name within that scope. That includes `.connect(...)` calls and closure-style references such as `functools.partial(cfg.changed.disconnect, ...)` passed to signals like `destroyed.connect`.
Keep behavior identical. Change only the identifier, and leave signal wiring, ordering and comments as they are.
validation: Run pylint/flake8 on the changed file and confirm there are no redefined-outer-name or unused-import warnings.
grep the function body to confirm the old local name `config` is no longer used as a local object, and that every `cfg.` reference is consistent.
Run the existing test suite (tox/pytest) and do a basic smoke test of WebView creation and destruction to make sure the signals still connect and disconnect.

name: avoid-qkeysequence-roundtrip-in-keystring-normalization
negative_constraints: 不要依赖 QKeySequence.toString() 做按键字符串规范化。它对罕见按键名的改写不可预测。
不要引入新的 Qt 往返转换来替代被删除的逻辑。应改用显式、可读的字符串替换规则。
不要保留已经无用的 QKeySequence import。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/keyinput/basekeyparser.py 中的 key 字符串规范化函数(_normalize_keystr 或同类函数)。这类函数会对配置里的绑定字符串做 replace 处理, 例如别名替换、把 'Ctrl-' 改成 'Ctrl+'。
检查函数末尾是否有 QKeySequence(keystr).toString() 这类往返转换。它会把特殊/罕见的按键名改写成意料之外的结果, 而它带来的规范化收益很小。
删除这次 QKeySequence 往返转换, 只保留显式的字符串替换: 别名映射表, 以及修饰键分隔符从 '-' 统一为 '+'。
移除 QKeySequence 调用后, 如果该文件不再使用它, 一并删除 `from PyQt5.QtGui import QKeySequence` 的 import。
确认其他调用方(例如 _handle_special_key 生成的 modstr+keyname)产生的字符串格式, 仍与规范化后的绑定字符串一致。两者必须用同样的修饰键顺序和分隔符才能匹配。
validation: 运行现有测试套件, 尤其是 keyinput 相关测试。
手动检查常规绑定(如 'Ctrl-x' 规范化为 'Ctrl+x')和罕见按键名(多媒体键、非 ASCII 键名)经过规范化后与输入一致, 且能触发对应绑定。
运行 pylint/flake8, 确认没有未使用的 import 告警。

name: avoid-retaining-mutable-framework-objects
negative_constraints: Do not keep long-lived references to Qt event objects in containers.
Do not fix the bug by copying the whole QEvent. Copy only the fields that matter.
procedure: If a bug involves comparing or looking up a Qt object that was kept from an earlier callback, assume Qt may have reused or mutated that object.
At the moment you receive the object, copy the fields you need into an immutable, hashable Python value.
Choose which fields to copy based on what must stay the same across the paired events, and leave out fields that legitimately change.
Use set or dict membership on the snapshots. Remove the matched entry when it is used so the container does not grow forever.
validation: Run the existing tests.
Add a debug log of the snapshot repr and confirm that matching works across repeated events.

name: avoid-setattr-side-effects-negative-constraint
negative_constraints: Do not override __setattr__ on QWidget subclasses to watch attribute changes.
Do not use a naming convention (leading underscore) to implicitly decide whether an assignment triggers logic.
procedure: When reviewing or writing code that needs a side effect on attribute assignment, use an explicit property setter instead of a global __setattr__.
Check whether a Qt/PyQt object's __setattr__ is affected by super().__init__ setting attributes. Such attributes are set before any flag exists, which can cause AttributeError or spurious triggers.
Limit the side effect to the attributes that need it, and declare them as explicit properties.
validation: Construct the widget and confirm no exception occurs during initialization.
Run the existing test suite and lint.

name: bridge-manager-signals-to-qt-list-model
negative_constraints: Do not call beginInsertRows or beginRemoveRows after the manager's list has already been mutated. The pre-change signal must fire before the mutation, and the end* signal after it.
Do not emit dataChanged with a raw int. Always convert it with self.index(row, 0).
Do not reset the whole model (beginResetModel/endResetModel) for single-item add, remove or update operations.
Do not move model bookkeeping into the manager. The manager only emits signals and the model translates them.
procedure: Locate the model class in qutebrowser/models/ (e.g. DownloadModel in downloadmodel.py). It wraps a backend manager, here QApplication.instance().downloadmanager.
List the manager's lifecycle signals: download_about_to_be_added(idx), download_added, download_about_to_be_finished(idx), download_finished and data_changed(idx).

In the model's __init__, after storing the manager reference, connect each pre-change signal to the matching begin* call. Pass the parent as QModelIndex() and use idx for both first and last row, e.g. lambda idx: self.beginInsertRows(QModelIndex(), idx, idx).
Connect each post-change signal directly to the matching end* method: download_added to endInsertRows, and download_finished to endRemoveRows.
For per-item updates, add a @pyqtSlot(int) method named on_data_changed. It converts the int row to a model index with self.index(idx, 0), then emits self.dataChanged.emit(model_idx, model_idx).
Extend the PyQt5.QtCore import line with pyqtSlot and QModelIndex. Wrap the import in parentheses if it gets long.
validation: Run the existing tests and pylint/flake8 on the modified model file.
Manually start a download and check that the download bar or view adds a row, updates its progress, and removes the row when the download finishes.
Check that the begin*/end* pairs are balanced. Qt warns or crashes when they are not.

name: centralize-qurl-invalid-check-as-commanderror
negative_constraints: 不要在 command handler 里保留重复的内联 isValid/errorString 拼接代码。
不要输出带有未填充 '{}' 占位符的错误字符串,必须对 URL 做 format。
不要在这个 helper 里改用 message.error 或 invalid_url_error。命令上下文需要 CommandError,这样命令框架才能把错误报告出来。
不要在 URL 有效时抛异常或修改 URL,有效路径必须是 no-op。
不要顺手修改 fuzzy_url 或 FuzzyUrlError 的行为。
procedure: 先用 grep 'isValid()' 和 'Invalid URL' 搜索 qutebrowser/browser/commands.py 及其他 command handler,找出内联的 QUrl 有效性检查。
在 qutebrowser/utils/urlutils.py 中、紧挨现有 invalid_url_error 的位置新增 helper raise_cmdexc_if_invalid(url),并加一行 docstring。
helper 只在 not url.isValid() 时生效:错误消息以 'Invalid URL {}'.format(url.toDisplayString()) 开头,让消息里真正显示出 URL。原内联代码里的 '{}' 没有被 format,是个 bug。
把 url.errorString() 存进局部变量。只有它非空时,才追加 ' - {}'.format(url_error)。
抛出 cmdexc.CommandError(errstr)。在 urlutils 顶部加 'from qutebrowser.commands import cmdexc',与其他 qutebrowser 导入放在一起。
把调用方(例如 CommandDispatcher._open)的内联检查块替换成 urlutils.raise_cmdexc_if_invalid(url),调用位置保持在其他 tab/window 逻辑之前。
validation: 运行现有测试:pytest tests/ -k urlutils。如果仓库还有 unittest 套件,也一并运行。
检查导入:python -c 'import qutebrowser.utils.urlutils',确认引入 cmdexc 后没有产生循环导入。
手动或单元测试:raise_cmdexc_if_invalid(QUrl()) 应抛出 CommandError,且消息以 'Invalid URL' 开头。
手动或单元测试:传入有效的 QUrl('http://example.com') 时不应抛异常。
运行 pylint/flake8,确认 commands.py 和 urlutils.py 中没有未使用的导入。

name: clear-dangling-tab-focus-refs-on-close
negative_constraints: Don't call indexOf() or any other Qt method on a cached widget that may already be deleted. Clear the reference at the source.
Don't fix the crash only in the consumer (try/except around indexOf). The stale reference has to be cleared on close.
Don't raise a raw exception or let a Python exception escape a command handler. Use cmdutils CommandError so the user sees a message.
Don't clear the focus references after the tab is deleted or removed. Clear them before the tab is destroyed.
procedure: Find the place where the tab widget gets removed or deleted. In qutebrowser this is the tab-close path in qutebrowser/widgets/tabbedbrowser.py (TabbedBrowser._close_tab or a similar method). It runs after the idx/tab arguments are resolved and before removal or deleteLater.
List every attribute that caches a tab widget reference, such as self.now_focused and self.last_focused, which are updated by the current-changed handler.

Put identity checks right after the tab object is resolved: `if tab is self.now_focused: self.now_focused = None` and `if tab is self.last_focused: self.last_focused = None`. Use `is` so the check compares the object itself, not by equality.

Find each consumer of those cached references. In qutebrowser/browser/commands.py, CommandDispatcher.tab_focus_last calls self._tabs.indexOf(self._tabs.last_focused). Add a None guard that raises CommandError('No last focused tab!') before indexOf is called.
Keep the existing `idx == -1` -> CommandError('Last focused tab vanished!') fallback as a second line of defence.
validation: Run the existing test suite (tox / pytest) to confirm there are no regressions.
Manual check: open 3 tabs, switch between two of them, close the last-focused tab, then run :tab-focus-last. Expect an error message ('No last focused tab!') and no crash.
Manual check: close the currently focused tab and confirm that tab switching still updates now_focused/last_focused correctly afterwards.
grep for other uses of last_focused/now_focused and check each one handles None.

name: command-subclass-run-override-for-signal-args
negative_constraints: Do not declare run(self, *args) in subclasses.
Do not emit raw argv lists to a pyqtSignal(str).
Do not leave a parameterized signal without a run override. The base run emits with no arguments, which would raise on a typed signal.
procedure: When adding a Command subclass in qutebrowser/commands.py, set nargs, name and signal. Registration through cmd_dict happens automatically when name is set.
If the signal has zero parameters, rely on the base run.
If the signal has parameters, override run(self, argv). Convert or select argv elements to match the signal's types, then emit them.
Keep argv as a single list parameter, consistent with check(self, argv).
validation: Parse the new command with valid and invalid argument counts. Confirm that check raises correctly.
Confirm the emitted values reach the connected slot with the correct types.

name: config-backed-qwebpage-search-flags
negative_constraints: Do not set FindCaseSensitively when ignorecase is true. The accepted diff does exactly this, so its case logic is inverted and must be corrected (`if not getboolean(... 'ignorecase' ...)`).
Do not replace self.flags with `=` after other flags are already set.
Do not hardcode the search behaviour. Read it from config.
Do not use a getboolean fallback that disagrees with the default_config value.
procedure: Locate SearchParser.search() in qutebrowser/commands/utils.py. This is where the text and flags are emitted through the do_search signal.
Add `import qutebrowser.utils.config as config`. Read options with `config.config.getboolean('general', <name>, fallback=<default>)`. Use the same fallback value as the default_config entry.
Reset `self.flags = 0` at the start of each new search. This stops stale flags such as FindBackward from carrying over from the previous search.
Combine flags with bitwise OR (`|=`). Do not assign them, because a plain assignment overwrites earlier flags. Add FindBackward with `|=` when rev is set.
Map semantics carefully. When ignorecase=false, add QWebPage.FindCaseSensitively. When ignorecase=true, leave that flag off. When wrapsearch=true, add QWebPage.FindWrapsAroundDocument.
Check that nextsearch() reuses self.flags, so repeated searches keep the case and wrap behaviour.
validation: Run the existing tests or start the app and check it imports cleanly.
Search with mixed case and ignorecase=true: matches should ignore case. Set ignorecase=false: matches should respect case.
Set wrapsearch=true and search past the last match: the search should wrap to the top. Set wrapsearch=false: it should stop.
Run a reverse search followed by a forward search: the forward search must not keep FindBackward.

name: convert-crash-to-commanderror-for-user-input
negative_constraints: 不要让用户输入引起的异常冒泡成未捕获异常（会触发 crash handler）。
不要扩大修改范围去改动命令签名或注册参数。
procedure: 定位通过 cmdutils 注册、接收用户字符串参数的命令处理函数。
枚举边界输入：空串、仅空白、缺少前缀字符。检查每种输入是否会触发 IndexError、KeyError 或 ValueError 等 Python 异常。
在已有校验分支中用短路判断吸收这些边界情况，统一抛出 cmdexc.CommandError，让 qutebrowser 在状态栏显示错误，而不是弹出崩溃对话框。
保持最小 diff：只修改条件表达式，不重构周边逻辑。
validation: 运行现有单元测试。
逐一用边界参数调用命令，确认只显示错误消息、无 traceback。

name: dedupe-modifier-names-in-keyevent-to-string
negative_constraints: 不要只在 macOS 分支里删除 Meta 映射来掩盖问题。真正的修复是在拼接时去重，前一次修复不彻底的原因就在这里。
不要把 parts 改用 set 去重。set 会打乱 Ctrl/Alt/Meta/Shift 的规范顺序，导致 keybinding 字符串不稳定。
不要改变非 darwin 平台的输出格式。
不要遗漏测试的平台分支断言。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/utils/utils.py 中的 keyevent_to_string 和它的 modmask2str 映射。在 macOS (sys.platform == 'darwin') 上，Qt.ControlModifier 和 Qt.MetaModifier 可能都映射到同一个名字 'Ctrl'。
遍历 modmask2str.items() 时，modifier mask 匹配后先检查该名字是否已经在 parts 中，不在时才追加，即 `if mod & mask and s not in parts:`。这样即使多个 mask 共享同一个显示名，输出也只出现一次。
保持 modmask2str 的固定顺序 Ctrl, Alt, Meta, Shift 不变。最后用 key_to_string(e.key()) 追加按键本身，再用 '+' 连接。
修改 qutebrowser/test/utils/test_utils.py 中的 KeyEventToStringTests：构造带 Control|Alt|Meta|Shift 的 QKeyEvent，按平台分支断言。darwin 下期望 'Ctrl+Alt+Shift+A'，其他平台期望 'Ctrl+Alt+Meta+Shift+A'。
检查断言续行缩进是否与左括号对齐（pep8/flake8 的 E127/E128），顺手修正测试中的缩进问题。
validation: 运行 python -m unittest qutebrowser.test.utils.test_utils.KeyEventToStringTests
确认 darwin 与非 darwin 两个分支的期望字符串都正确，并且输出中没有重复的 'Ctrl'。
运行 flake8/pep8 检查 test_utils.py 的续行缩进。

name: defer-init-args-until-event-loop-running
negative_constraints: Do not call `_process_init_args` synchronously inside `__init__`. Startup commands would then run before the event loop exists.
Do not use a non-zero delay as a workaround for ordering problems. Use 0ms, so it runs on the first event loop iteration.
Do not assume `QTimer.singleShot(...)` returns a timer object. Appending its return value to a list only stores None.
procedure: Locate `QuteBrowser.__init__` in `qutebrowser/app.py`. Find where `_process_init_args()` is called synchronously after `mainwindow.show()` and `_python_hacks()`.

Diagnose the bug: startup arguments such as `qutebrowser ':quit'` currently run while the app is still being constructed. At that point `exec_()` has not started yet. Commands like `:quit`/`exit()` that depend on the event loop then misbehave.
Replace the direct call with `QTimer.singleShot(0, self._process_init_args)`. The 0ms timeout defers processing until the event loop is running and startup has fully finished.

If you want to keep a reference to the timer, note that the static `QTimer.singleShot` returns None. Instead create a `QTimer` instance, call `setSingleShot(True)`, connect `timeout` to `_process_init_args`, call `start(0)`, and only then store it.
Leave the URL/command dispatch logic inside `_process_init_args` unchanged. This fix only changes when it is called.
validation: Run `qutebrowser ':quit'` and confirm it exits cleanly without a traceback or a hang.
Run qutebrowser with a URL argument and confirm the URL still opens in a tab.
Run the existing tests.

name: derive-qt-argv-from-namespace-prefix
negative_constraints: Do not use `pass` as the prefix-filter branch. It is a no-op and lets non-qt_ arguments through.
Do not emit underscore names like -widget_count to Qt. Qt expects the hyphenated form.
Do not rely on dict iteration order for test assertions unless ordering is guaranteed. Compare sorted or set-like if needed.
Do not keep a parallel hardcoded list alongside the prefix scan.
procedure: Locate get_qt_args(namespace) in qutebrowser/utils/misc.py. It builds the argv list that is passed to QApplication.

Replace the hardcoded qt_args tuple. Iterate over vars(namespace).items() instead, so any argparse dest with the prefix 'qt_' is forwarded automatically. New Qt options then only need to be registered in the argparser.
Filter on the prefix with `if not argname.startswith('qt_'): continue`. It must be continue, not pass, or every non-Qt argument leaks into the Qt argv.
Strip the prefix with argname[len('qt_'):].
Convert underscores back to hyphens, because argparse turns --qt-widget-count into dest qt_widget_count. Example: '-' + name.replace('_', '-').
Keep the value semantics: None means not given, so skip it. True is a flag, so append only -name. Otherwise it is a nargs=1 list, so append -name and then val[0].
Keep argv[0] = sys.argv[0] as the first element.
Update the GetQtArgsTests tests to match. Remove the test that assumed unknown qt_ args are dropped (test_qt_unknown), because forwarding them is now the intended behavior.
Add a test that a namespace containing non-qt attributes only yields [sys.argv[0]].
Add a test for a hyphenated option such as widget-count.
validation: Run the existing tests: python -m unittest qutebrowser.test.utils.test_misc.
Check that a namespace with only non-qt args (e.g. debug=True, command=[]) returns [sys.argv[0]].
Check that qt_reverse=True gives ['-reverse'].
Check that qt_stylesheet=['foobar'] gives ['-stylesheet', 'foobar'].
Check that qt_widget_count=['1'] gives ['-widget-count', '1'].

name: enum-collection-string-formatting-guard
negative_constraints: 不要用 try/except 吞掉 TypeError 来掩盖格式化错误。
不要在数据结构层把枚举退化为字符串。
procedure: 遇到错误提示路径本身崩溃时，先检查格式化参数的类型。典型是 str.join 作用于枚举或对象集合。
追溯该集合的来源，例如命令注册时传入的 modes 参数，确认元素类型是 usertypes 中定义的枚举。
在格式化点就地转换，用 '/'.join(x.name for x in coll)，不改变集合本身的数据模型。
检查同一函数里的对称分支（正向和反向条件），一并修复，避免只修一半。
validation: run existing tests
人为触发错误分支，确认最终抛出的是业务异常及其可读消息，而不是格式化异常。

name: explicit-editable-input-hint-selectors
negative_constraints: Do not keep input:not([type=hidden]) next to the explicit list. It makes the allowlist pointless, and non-text inputs would still be hinted as editable.
Do not add non-text input types (checkbox, radio, submit, button, file, image, range, color, reset) to the editable group.
Do not change the hint group names or the dict structure. Commands and config refer to these keys.
Do not move the selector logic into JavaScript or the webelem code when only the CSS selector is wrong.
procedure: Open the hint-group selector mapping on HintManager (the class-level dict mapping group names to CSS selectors) in qutebrowser/browser/hints.py.

Find the 'editable' group. If it still uses the catch-all negative selector input:not([type=hidden]), work out which input types actually accept text. The catch-all also matches checkbox, radio, submit, button, file, range and color.
Replace the catch-all with an explicit allowlist of text-entry input types: text, email, url, tel, number, password and search. Keep textarea and any other already-supported editable elements.
Keep the existing selectors that were already explicit, such as input[type=text], input[type=password] and textarea. Dedupe them so each type appears only once.
Build the string with Python implicit literal concatenation. Each fragment except the last must end with ', ' so the joined selector stays a valid, readable comma list.
Remove the FIXME comment that called for this change once the explicit list is in place.
Leave the other groups (all, links, images, url) unchanged unless the task names them explicitly.
validation: Run the existing hint unit and integration tests (tests/unit/browser and tests/end2end features for hints). Confirm the editable group still hints text inputs and textareas.
In the Python REPL, evaluate HintManager.HINT_CSS_SELECTORS['editable'] (or the equivalent attribute) and check that it is a well-formed comma-separated selector with no merged tokens.
Optionally test it in a browser console with document.querySelectorAll(selector) on a page that has mixed input types. Check that checkboxes and submit buttons are not matched.

name: extract-qt-eventfilter-branches-to-helpers
negative_constraints: Do not return None from a helper. Qt expects a bool from eventFilter.
Do not drop the debug logging of the handled, passthrough, forward and filter decision. It is used for diagnosing key issues.
Do not copy-paste docstrings without fixing them. For example, the release helper's Args should say KeyRelease, not KeyPress.
procedure: Locate the Qt `eventFilter(self, obj, event)` override. In qutebrowser this is ModeManager in keyinput/modes.py.
Keep the early-return guards in eventFilter itself: not-a-key-event, mode None, and non-window objects.

Move each event-type branch into a private method named `_eventFilter_<eventtype>(self, event)` that returns True to filter and False to pass. Use a single filter_this variable, and log it before returning.
Keep shared state, such as `_releaseevents_to_pass`, on self so that the press and release helpers stay coupled through the instance.
Make eventFilter a thin dispatcher of the form `if typ == QEvent.KeyPress: return self._eventFilter_keypress(event) else: return self._eventFilter_keyrelease(event)`.
validation: Run pylint on modes.py and confirm the branch and statement-count warnings are resolved.
Run the existing tests and manually verify that key press and release forwarding in passthrough modes still works.

name: fix-noop-pass-in-arg-filter-loop
negative_constraints: 不要用 `pass` 充当过滤器。`pass` 不会跳过当前迭代。
不要为修这个 bug 重写 get_qt_args 或改动参数格式化逻辑。最小修复只改控制流。
不要改动 argparse 中 qt_ 参数的定义或命名约定。
不要让非 qt_ 的 namespace 属性泄漏进 Qt argv,例如 debug、temp_basedir、command。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/utils/misc.py 中的 get_qt_args(namespace)。它遍历 vars(namespace).items(),把参数转成传给 Qt 的 argv。
检查前缀过滤分支 `if not argname.startswith('qt_')`。如果分支体是 `pass`,这是 no-op 过滤 bug,非 Qt 参数会继续往下走,被加进 Qt argv。
把 `pass` 改为 `continue`,让非 qt_ 参数直接跳过。
把紧随其后的 `if val is None` 改成 `elif`,与后面的 `elif val is True` 等分支组成一条互斥链。这样可以表达过滤语义,也能防止以后再出现类似的 fall-through。
保持其余逻辑不变:None 跳过;True 只加 flag;其他值加 flag 和值。不要顺手修改 qt_ 前缀的剥离或拼接方式。
validation: run existing tests: pytest tests/unit/utils/test_utils.py -k qt_args(或 misc 相关测试)
手动构造 argparse.Namespace(foo=True, bar='x', qt_reverse=True, qt_stylesheet='a.css'),确认 get_qt_args 只返回 [argv0, '-reverse', '-stylesheet', 'a.css'],不含 foo 和 bar。
确认值为 None 的 qt_ 参数仍被跳过。

name: fix-qt-widget-sizehint-scope-errors
negative_constraints: 不要在 Qt 方法重写里使用未定义的裸名 (parent、minimumSizeHint、QSize); 这类错误只在 Qt 布局调用该方法时才以 NameError 报出来。
不要把 size policy 设为 Ignored; 否则布局会忽略 sizeHint, 进度条可能不可见或尺寸错误。
不要为了解决尺寸问题去重写 paintEvent / 绘制逻辑; 修正 size hint 和 size policy 就够了。
不要把 self.parent 当作 Qt API 的替代品去混用其它语义; 它只用于读取父容器尺寸。注意它会遮蔽 QObject.parent() 方法, 所以之后不能再调用 self.parent()。
不要顺手改动 StatusBar 的其他组件 (lbl、命令行等), 修改范围限定在进度条类内。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar.py 中自定义 Qt widget 子类 (如 StatusProgress(QProgressBar)) 重写的 sizeHint/minimumSizeHint 方法。
检查这些重写方法中引用的名字是否真的在作用域内: 裸名 `parent` 应改为实例属性 `self.parent` (或 Qt 的 `self.parentWidget()`); 同类方法互调要写成 `self.minimumSizeHint()`, 不能写裸函数名 `minimumSizeHint()`。
在 __init__ 中保存父 widget 引用 (例如 `self.parent = parent`, 在 super().__init__ 之前或之后均可), 供 size hint 计算时用父容器高度。
补齐 PyQt5.QtCore 的导入 (例如 QSize), 在已有的 `from PyQt5.QtCore import ...` 那一行追加, 不要另起一行导入。
在 minimumSizeHint 中返回 QSize(固定宽度, 父 statusbar 的高度), 让进度条与状态栏同高、宽度固定 (本修复用的是 100px); sizeHint 直接委托给 minimumSizeHint。
设置 `self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Fixed, QSizePolicy.Fixed)`, 让布局遵守 size hint, 不去拉伸进度条。
修复完成后, 删除已经过时的 FIXME 注释和被注释掉的旧 size policy 代码。
validation: 运行 python -m py_compile qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar.py, 并用 pyflakes 检查是否还有未定义的名字。
启动 qutebrowser 加载一个页面: 确认进度条出现在状态栏中、高度与状态栏一致、宽度固定, 且没有 NameError 回溯。
确认页面加载完成后进度条按原有逻辑隐藏, set_progress 仍会让它显示出来。

name: getattr-fallback-must-be-used
negative_constraints: 不要写了防御性的 getattr,却在下一行又直接访问同一个属性。
不要只在已安装最新版依赖的环境中测试回退分支。
procedure: 审查新增的 `x = getattr(obj, attr, default)` 语句,确认后续代码使用的是 x,而不是 `obj.attr`。
检查是否存在已赋值但未使用的变量(pylint unused-variable),它通常意味着回退逻辑没有生效。
检查新局部变量是否遮蔽了同名的外层函数或模块,有遮蔽就重命名。
validation: 运行 pylint,确认没有 unused-variable 或 redefined-outer-name 警告。
编写一个属性缺失的模拟场景测试,确认使用的是回退值。

name: guard-command-against-none-state
negative_constraints: Don't pass None into Qt APIs like indexOf/setCurrentIndex and rely on their behaviour.
Don't silently return without user feedback. Raise CommandError so the statusbar shows the reason.
procedure: Find the @cmdutils.register command in qutebrowser/browser/commands.py whose code reads optional browser state, i.e. an attribute that can be None after a lifecycle event.
At the top of the command, add an explicit `if state is None: raise CommandError('<user-facing reason>')` before any Qt call that uses that state.
Keep any existing sentinel checks (e.g. idx == -1) and put the None check before them, matching the existing CommandError message style.
validation: Run the existing tests.
Trigger the command in the None state and confirm the user gets an error message instead of a traceback or crash.

name: guard-empty-string-before-index-in-command-validation
negative_constraints: 不要用 try/except IndexError 包裹索引来掩盖问题，应显式判空。
不要为空输入新增独立的错误类型或消息，复用现有的 CommandError 即可。
不要在空输入时静默返回或调用 set_cmd_text('')，应该向用户报错。
不要改动 {url} 替换逻辑或 set_cmd_text 的行为，修复范围仅限校验条件。
不要依赖 `text[:1] in STARTCHARS` 这类写法。空串对容器类 STARTCHARS 的成员判断结果因类型而异：对字符串，'' in 'abc' 为 True。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/mainwindow/statusbar/command.py 中实现 :set-cmd-text 的方法。找到对 text[0] 做索引并与 modeparsers.STARTCHARS 比较的校验分支。
确认失败路径：用户传入空字符串时，text[0] 会抛出 IndexError，变成未处理的崩溃，而不是用户可见的错误提示。
把校验条件改为短路形式 `if not text or text[0] not in modeparsers.STARTCHARS:`，先判空，再取首字符。
复用已有的 `cmdexc.CommandError("Invalid command text '{}'.".format(text))` 作为错误出口。这样空输入和非法前缀走同一条用户可见的错误路径。
顺手把 `not x in y` 改为符合 PEP8 的 `x not in y`。
同一模块内其他对用户提供的字符串做 [0] 或 [-1] 索引的地方，也检查是否需要同样的判空保护。
validation: 运行现有测试套件（tox/pytest），确认无回归。
手动验证 `:set-cmd-text ""`：应显示 "Invalid command text ''." 错误，且不出现 IndexError 崩溃。
验证 `:set-cmd-text :open` 等合法前缀仍能正常设置命令行文本。
验证非法前缀（例如 `foo`）仍抛出 CommandError。

name: guard-none-confdir-before-path-join-in-config-init
negative_constraints: Do not substitute a fallback directory (cwd or a default path) when `confdir` is `None`. `-c ""` intentionally means no persistent config.
Do not skip `objreg.register` for the config objects. Later code depends on them being registered.
Do not catch `TypeError` broadly around the init code instead of checking explicitly for `None`.
Do not change `standarddir.get` semantics to return an empty string.
procedure: Reproduce the startup crash with an empty config-dir argument (e.g. `qutebrowser -c ""` or `--confdir ""`). Expected traceback: `TypeError` from `os.path.join(None, ...)` in `qutebrowser/config/config.py:init`.
Find every path-building call in `config.init(args)` that uses the value from `standarddir.get(...)`. Check `confdir`, `datadir` and `cachedir`, plus every `os.path.join(xxxdir, ...)` call.

Check whether each parser class already handles a `None` directory, meaning it skips reading and writing. Examples: `ConfigManager`, `keyconf.KeyConfigParser`, `ini.ReadWriteConfigParser`. If they do, keep passing `None` to their constructors.

Wrap the filename construction and `save_manager.add_saveable(...)` registration in `if confdir is not None:`. Keep `objreg.register(...)` outside the guard so the object is always registered. With no config dir there is no file to save, so the saveable is simply not registered.
Apply the same guard to every similar block: `config` / `qutebrowser.conf` and `key-config` / `keys.conf`. Check whether the `datadir` / `state` block has the same exposure.
Inspect the regression commit (here 9b1729c) to see which new `os.path.join` use or `filename=` kwarg it added. Make sure every spot it touched is covered.
validation: Start `qutebrowser -c "" --debug` (or run the equivalent `config.init` call with `args.confdir=''`) and confirm there is no traceback.
Confirm that `save_manager` has no `config` or `key-config` saveables when confdir is `None`, and that `:save` does not crash.
Start normally with a real confdir and confirm both saveables are registered and auto-save still works.
Run the existing test suite and pylint/flake8, and check line length and indentation.

name: guard-none-model-data-before-completion-emit
negative_constraints: Do not concatenate model.data() results with strings unless you first check that the result is not None.
Do not use a bare truthiness check (if data:) when an empty string could be a valid value. Compare explicitly with 'is not None'.
Do not raise an error or show a user error message for an impossible completion. Skip it silently.
Do not change the completion model or selection logic just to fix this. Keep the fix to a local guard.
procedure: Locate the completion widget handler (qutebrowser/widgets/completion.py, CompletionView tab/next-item logic). It selects an index and then emits append_cmd_text with model.data(idx) + ' '.

Identify where Qt model data is used directly as a str. model.data(idx) returns None in these cases: the index is invalid, the model is empty, or the item is a category/header row with no display data.
Store the result once in a local variable, for example data = self.model.data(idx).
Wrap the emit in an 'if data is not None:' check. When data is None, return without emitting, so the tab press does nothing instead of raising.
Leave the selection update and ignore_next state handling as they are. Only the text emission should depend on the data being present.
Inside the guard, emit using the local variable instead of calling model.data(idx) a second time.
validation: Run the existing test suite and linters (pylint/flake8) for qutebrowser.
Manually open the command line, type input that gives no completions or that lands on a category row, and press Tab. Confirm there is no TypeError traceback and the command text is unchanged.
Confirm that pressing Tab on a valid completion item still appends the item text plus a trailing space.

name: guard-none-qt-message-context-fields
negative_constraints: Do not wrap the whole handler in a broad try/except to swallow the TypeError. An exception inside a Qt message handler can crash or hide the original warning.
Do not drop or rewrite the regex extraction for the non-None case. Existing log output format must stay the same.
Do not use str(context.function) as the fix. It produces the misleading function name 'None' and still runs the regex needlessly.
Do not change the level mapping (qt_to_logging) or the category-based logger naming as part of this fix.
procedure: Open qutebrowser/utils/log.py and find qt_message_handler(msg_type, context, msg).

List every QMessageLogContext attribute the handler reads: function, file, line and category. Treat each one as possibly None. Qt passes None when it was built without debug info or when the message comes from a plugin or C code.
Before passing context.function to re.match or any other str operation, add an explicit `if context.function is None:` branch.
In that branch, set a stable placeholder such as func = 'none'. Use the same placeholder style the logging record expects elsewhere.

Move the existing regex logic into the else branch without changing it. That logic extracts the bare function name from a signature like 'void qt_png_warning(png_structp, png_const_charp)' by matching '.*( |::)(\w*)\(.*\)'. It falls back to the raw string when there is no match.
Keep the explanatory comment next to the regex in the else branch.
Check the rest of the handler for the same pattern, such as context.file used in makeRecord and context.category used in the name computation. Guard any field that the code does string operations on.
validation: Run the existing unit tests for utils/log (pytest tests/unit/utils/test_log.py).

Optionally add a test that calls qt_message_handler with a fake context whose function, file and line are None and whose category is 'default'. Assert that it logs without raising and that funcName == 'none'.
Confirm that a normal context with a C++ signature still logs the bare function name.

name: guard-optional-qt-ssl-import
negative_constraints: Do not assume a successful import means SSL is available. You must check both the import result (None) and supportsSsl().
Do not catch a broad Exception. Catch only ImportError.
Do not change the format or labels of the version output (for example 'SSL: ...'). Only the value should fall back.
Do not drop the SSL line or crash the version/crash-report path just because SSL is missing.
procedure: Find module-level imports of optional Qt classes. Search for QSslSocket and other SSL-related names under qutebrowser/, for example qutebrowser/utils/version.py. These classes may be missing when Qt/PyQt was built without OpenSSL.
Wrap the import in try/except ImportError and set the fallback to None: `try: from PyQt5.QtNetwork import QSslSocket` / `except ImportError: QSslSocket = None`.
Change every use site to check for the class first, as in `QSslSocket is not None and QSslSocket.supportsSsl()`. The import check must come before any attribute access.

Move complex conditional expressions out of the list or format literal and into a separate variable, for example ssl_version. Reuse the existing 'unavailable' fallback text so the output format stays the same.
Check whether other modules also import SSL classes directly, such as network or certificate error handling code. Apply the same import guard there, or add a runtime availability check.
validation: Run the existing tests for qutebrowser/utils/version.py (tests/utils/test_version*).
Simulate a missing class by monkeypatching version.QSslSocket = None. Confirm version() returns a line containing 'SSL: unavailable' and does not raise.
Simulate supportsSsl() returning False and confirm the output is also 'unavailable'.
Run pylint/flake8 to confirm the conditional import passes the linters.

name: guard-regex-match-before-group-in-handlers
negative_constraints: Do not wrap the whole handler in a bare `except` to hide the error. Make the parse step explicitly tolerant.
Do not change the handler's output format for inputs that already parse correctly.
procedure: Find places in callback or handler code (logging, signal, or message hooks) that call `re.match/search(...).group(n)` on externally supplied strings.
Split each call into `match = re.match(...)`, then `if match is not None: value = match.group(n) else: value = <original input or safe default>`.
Choose the fallback so that diagnostic information is kept, normally the unparsed input.
validation: Run the existing tests.
Add or perform a check with a non-matching input that confirms the fallback value is used and nothing raises.

name: minimal-scope-dead-dependency-removal
negative_constraints: 不要扩大范围去清理同目录其他文件的导入, 除非任务明确要求。
不要因为移除了某个功能的导入, 就推断需要删除相关功能代码。
不要修改无关的空白或格式。
procedure: 从任务标题中提取要移除的具体符号 (例如 'Remove QCompleter from statusbar.text' 对应文件 statusbar/text.py 和符号 QCompleter)。
把标题里的点分路径映射到仓库的实际路径: statusbar.text 对应 qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar/text.py。
确认这个符号是早期实现遗留的、已经失效的依赖, 然后只删除这个符号。
检查 diff, 确保只有一行发生变化, 而且删除后 import 语句的语法仍然合法。
validation: 确认 git diff 只涉及目标文件的目标行。
运行该模块的导入检查和现有测试。

name: pep8-blank-line-before-nested-def
negative_constraints: Do not refactor the closure into a method, rename it, or move it out of the branch as part of a whitespace fix.
Do not add two blank lines inside a function body. Nested defs need one, top-level defs need two.
Do not introduce trailing whitespace on the inserted blank line.
Do not touch tests, changelog or docs for a pure whitespace or style fix.
Do not mix unrelated logic changes into the whitespace commit.
procedure: Locate nested function definitions (def/class inside a method or function) in the module the linter flags, e.g. qutebrowser/widgets/tabbedbrowser.py. A common case is a closure like check_scroll_pos defined right after an assignment inside an else-branch.
Check whether the nested def directly follows a non-blank statement in the same block, for example `backward = int(flags) & QWebPage.FindBackward` immediately followed by `def check_scroll_pos():`.
Insert exactly one empty line (no trailing spaces) between the preceding statement and the nested def. Keep the def's indentation, docstring and body unchanged.
Leave the closure's captured variables and semantics untouched. Only vertical whitespace changes.
Scan the same file for other nested defs with the same pattern. Fix them in the same commit only if the linter flags them.
validation: Run the repo's style checkers (flake8/pep8 and pylint as configured in the repository) on the modified file and confirm the blank-line warning is gone.
Run `git diff` and confirm the change is purely whitespace: a single '+' empty line.
Run `python -m py_compile` on the file to confirm no indentation breakage.

name: preserve-verbatim-license-text-in-ui
negative_constraints: Do not paraphrase, restyle, lowercase, or 'prettify' legally significant license text. The uppercase warranty disclaimer is intentional and should match the FSF original.
Do not replace emphasis with other markup (e.g. <i>, <strong>, CSS) as a substitute for the original uppercase text.
Do not change the copyright year, the author lines, or the 'version 3 or later' clause unless the task explicitly asks for it.
Do not add a changelog or tests for this wording-only fix unless the repo requires them. The gold surface is code only.
procedure: Locate the embedded license or legal blurb. In qutebrowser it is the GPL text in the HTML string in qutebrowser/utils/version.py, which is shown on the version/about page.

Compare that text word for word against the canonical GPL notice ('This program is distributed in the hope that it will be useful, but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the GNU General Public License for more details.').
Restore the original wording and casing, including the uppercase disclaimer phrases. Remove stylistic markup such as ... and any lowercased rewording that departs from the official text.

Keep the structural HTML wrapper (

paragraphs, line breaks) the page needs. Change only the inline text and formatting inside it.
Keep the diff minimal and confined to the license string. Do not touch the surrounding version-info logic.
validation: Run the existing tests for the version module (e.g. pytest tests/unit/utils/test_version.py) and confirm no test asserts the old bold/lowercase text.
Grep the repo for leftover non-canonical variants (e.g. 'without any warranty', 'merchantability') and check any other copies of the GPL blurb for consistency.

Check that the HTML string still renders:

tags balanced, no stray tags.

name: python-break-cycle-by-extracting-leaf-module
negative_constraints: 不要在原模块保留兼容性 re-export, 否则会重新引入循环。
不要在同一个提交里混入行为改动。
procedure: 画出相关模块的依赖图。把被很多模块 import 的底层模块 (注册表、异常) 与依赖很多模块的高层类区分开。
把高层类提取到一个新的叶子模块。共享异常放进一个零依赖模块。
在每个调用点把 import 直接改为指向新模块, 并相应更新 docstring。
validation: 逐个单独 import 每个模块, 确认能干净加载。
运行现有测试和应用启动流程。

name: qss-property-selector-precedence-for-statusbar-states
negative_constraints: Do not add a new config color or new property logic just to fix this. Reordering the existing rules is enough.
Do not make the error rule more specific with extra hacks such as compound selectors or !important. Qt QSS does not support !important.
Do not reset insert_active or prompt_active when an error is shown, because that would corrupt mode state.
Do not change the {{ }} brace escaping in the format string.
procedure: Locate the STYLESHEET string in qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar/bar.py. StatusBar states (error, prompt_active, insert_active) are set as Qt dynamic or pyqtProperty values, and each one maps to a QWidget#StatusBar[prop="true"] selector.
Know the precedence rule: these selectors have equal specificity, so Qt applies whichever rule comes later in the stylesheet. Rule order is the priority order.
Decide which state must win when states coexist. An error should always be visible, so the error rule ranks above prompt and insert.
Move the higher-priority selector block below the lower-priority ones: base bg first, then prompt, then insert, then error. Leave the selector text and the color[...] placeholders unchanged.
Keep the generic QWidget fg/font rule where it is, after the background state rules.
Check that the code that sets the property still re-polishes the widget after a change (style().unpolish/polish or setStyleSheet). Otherwise the reordering has no visible effect.
validation: Run the existing tests and confirm the stylesheet still formats without KeyError or brace errors.
Manually enter insert mode, trigger an error such as an invalid command, and confirm the statusbar is red (statusbar.bg.error).
Confirm the insert and prompt colors still appear when no error is active, and that the base color returns when the error clears.

name: qt-argparse-passthrough-none-sentinel
negative_constraints: 不要保留 val in [False, None] 这类多值哨兵判断。默认值统一为 None 后, False 不应出现。
不要对 Qt 透传标志使用 store_true, 否则默认值 False 会和 '未给出' 的语义混淆。
不要只在 argparse 中新增 --qt-* 选项而不更新 _get_qt_args 的名单, 两处必须同步。
不要用 == True 或真值判断代替 is True, 否则带值参数(如端口字符串)会被误当作纯标志。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/qutebrowser.py 中 _parse_args 的 debug 参数组里所有 --qt-* 选项, 以及 qutebrowser/app.py 中 Application._get_qt_args 的 qt_args 名单。
布尔类 Qt 标志改用 action='store_const', const=True, 不用 store_true。这样未给出时默认值是 None 而不是 False, None 就能统一表示 '未传入'。
_get_qt_args 中用 getattr(namespace, 'qt_' + argname, None) 取值, 不用 try/except AttributeError。
分支顺序固定为三步: 先判断 val is None 则 continue; 再判断 val is True 则只追加 '-' + argname; 其余情况追加 '-' + argname 和 val。
在 argparse 定义处加注释, 说明两点: 新增 Qt 选项也要加入 app.py 的 _get_qt_args 名单; 使用 store_const 是为了让默认值为 None。
顺手修正同一参数组里续行缩进不对齐的问题, 例如 debug.add_argument 续行多出的一个空格。
validation: 运行现有测试套件。
手动验证不带 --qt-* 参数时, 日志 'Qt arguments' 只包含 argv[0]。
手动验证 --qt-reverse 产生 ['-reverse'], --qt-style fusion 产生 ['-style', 'fusion']。
对修改过的文件运行 pylint 或 flake8, 确认没有续行缩进告警。

name: qt-args-argparse-list-value-unwrap
negative_constraints: Do not append the raw argparse value when nargs=1. QApplication needs a flat list[str], and a nested list breaks or silently corrupts the Qt argv.
Do not change the argparse nargs definition to fix the symptom. The consumer side (get_qt_args) is the agreed fix point and other code may rely on the list shape.
Do not str() the list (that would give "['value']").
Do not touch flag-only argument handling.
procedure: Open get_qt_args(namespace) in qutebrowser/utils/misc.py. It walks the argparse namespace attributes, translates them into Qt-style argv entries, and the result is passed to QApplication.

Find the argparse definition of the relevant argument, for example in qutebrowser/qutebrowser.py. Note its nargs/action. With nargs=1 the namespace value is a one-element list such as ['value'], not a str.
In the branch that handles 'argument with a value', keep appending '-' + argname, then append the unwrapped scalar val[0] instead of val. Do not append the list object.
Leave the boolean/flag branch (val is True → only '-' + argname) unchanged. Leave the skip branch (falsy/None values) unchanged too.
Keep the fix inside the value-appending line. Do not restructure the loop or change how argnames are derived.
validation: Run the existing tests: pytest tests/unit/utils/test_utils.py -k qt_args (or misc tests).
Check that a namespace like Namespace(qt_foo=['bar'], qt_flag=True) produces ['qutebrowser', '-foo', 'bar', '-flag'] in the correct order with only str elements.
Check that every element of the returned argv is a str.

name: qt-argv-passthrough-value-shape
negative_constraints: Do not use val[0] on a string. It silently passes only the first character to Qt, with no error.
Do not change the argparse definitions to match the bug. Fix the consumer to match the declared shape.
Do not change the '-' + argname[3:] prefix-stripping convention.
procedure: Locate qutebrowser/utils/qtutils.py get_args(namespace). It turns argparse attributes prefixed 'qt_' into Qt argv entries ('-' + argname[3:]).
Check how the matching argparse options are declared (nargs, action) in qutebrowser's argument parser. Then confirm the runtime type of each value: a bool for flags, a str for single-value options.
For a value-taking option, append the value itself (argv.append(val)). Only index into it (val[0]) if the parser definition uses nargs=1 or a list.
Keep the bool and flag branch unchanged: append only '-name' when the value is True, and skip the option when it is False or None.
Make the minimal one-line fix in the branch that appends the value. Do not restructure the loop.
validation: Run the existing tests for qtutils, if any, with pytest.

In a Python shell, build an argparse.Namespace(qt_style='fusion', qt_reverse=True, qt_foo=False). Assert that get_args returns ['-style', 'fusion', '-reverse'] in iteration order, with no single-character values.
Launch qutebrowser with a value-taking --qt-* option and confirm Qt receives the full value.

name: qt-key-name-special-case-override-table
negative_constraints: Do not remove or rewrite the QKeySequence fallback. Only override the known-broken keys.
Do not return combining unicode characters for dead keys. Return the non-combining form.
Do not drop the existing Backtab->Tab normalization in the fallback path.
Do not change the names already produced for keys that render correctly, because that would break existing user keybindings.
procedure: Locate the key-to-name conversion helper in qutebrowser/utils/misc.py (key_to_string). Check how it currently delegates to QKeySequence(key).toString().

Find which Qt.Key_* values QKeySequence::toString mis-renders. This upstream Qt bug (QTBUG-40030) affects dead keys, media/remote keys, touchpad keys and similar keys. Typical bad output is an empty string, a unicode garbage character, or an unexpected name.
Add a local dict named special_names inside the helper that maps each problematic Qt.Key_* constant to a stable, human-readable name. Put a comment that cites the Qt bug URL.

Map dead/combining keys (Qt.Key_Dead_*) to their non-combining printable equivalent where one exists, for example Dead_Circumflex -> '^', Dead_Tilde -> '~' and Dead_Grave -> '`'. This keeps the name easy to type in the config. Map the remaining dead keys to a descriptive word ('Hook', 'Iota').
Look up special_names[key] first with try/except KeyError. Fall back to the existing QKeySequence(key).toString() path, and keep existing post-processing such as .replace('Backtab', 'Tab') unchanged.
Keep the change local to this helper so every caller (keyevent_to_string, the keyparsers) picks it up automatically.
validation: Run the existing tests for utils/misc (key_to_string / keyevent_to_string).
Spot-check that key_to_string(Qt.Key_Dead_Circumflex) == '^', that key_to_string(Qt.Key_MicMute) == 'Mic Mute', and that ordinary keys like Qt.Key_A and Qt.Key_Backtab still return 'A' and 'Tab'.
Run pyflakes/pylint so every Qt.Key_* constant used is confirmed to exist in the PyQt version in use.

name: qt-keyevent-modifier-only-key-filter
negative_constraints: Do not add regular printable or function keys to the modifiers tuple. Pressing them alone would stop working.
Do not move modifier filtering into individual keyparsers. Keep it centralized in keyevent_to_string.
procedure: Locate the modifiers tuple in keyevent_to_string in qutebrowser/utils/misc.py. This tuple lists the keys that, when pressed alone, should yield None.

If a modifier-like key that the platform emits produces a spurious binding string, append its Qt.Key_* constant to that tuple. Examples are Qt.Key_Direction_L and Qt.Key_Direction_R, alongside the Super, Hyper and AltGr keys.
Keep the early-return-None behaviour so the keyparsers ignore lone modifier presses.
validation: Run the existing utils tests.
Simulate a QKeyEvent with Qt.Key_Direction_L and assert that keyevent_to_string returns None.
Check that Ctrl+X style events still produce 'Ctrl+X'.

name: qt-message-handler-category-aware-logger-name
negative_constraints: 不要为默认 category 改变 logger name。默认 category 必须仍然是 'qt'，否则基于 'qt' 名称的过滤和测试会失效。
不要修改 QT_TO_LOGGING 的级别映射，也不要修改 context.function 的正则解析逻辑。
不要改成用 logging.getLogger(category) 新建 logger 来分发。应继续使用已有的 qt logger 调用 makeRecord 和 handle，确保 handler 和过滤配置一致。
不要在 handler 中吞掉或重写 msg 内容。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/utils/log.py 中的 qt_message_handler(msg_type, context, msg)。它负责把 Qt 消息转换成 Python logging record。
确认现有流程。先用正则从 context.function 提取函数名，再用 QT_TO_LOGGING[msg_type] 映射日志级别，最后由 qt.makeRecord(...) 生成 record 并调用 qt.handle(record)。
从 context.category 推导 record 的 logger name。category 为 'default' 时保留原名 'qt'，否则使用 'qt-' + context.category。这样可以按 Qt 日志分类（如 qt.network.ssl）区分来源。
只把 makeRecord 的第一个参数从硬编码的 'qt' 换成推导出的 name。file、line、msg、func 参数和 qt.handle 的调用方式保持不变。
保持修改最小，只在 makeRecord 之前增加一行 name 计算。
validation: 运行现有测试：pytest tests/unit/utils/test_log.py（如存在）以及整体单元测试。
手动验证：触发一条带非默认 category 的 Qt 警告（如 QLoggingCategory 相关的 SSL 或网络警告），确认日志记录名为 'qt-<category>'。
确认普通 qWarning（category 为 'default'）的日志名仍为 'qt'，并且日志过滤（--logfilter qt）行为不变。

name: qt-message-handler-downgrade-instead-of-drop
negative_constraints: Do not discard Qt messages with `return`. Keep them as DEBUG records so they stay in debug logs and :messages for diagnosis.
Do not change the qt_to_logging mapping, the logger name scheme, or the function-name regex extraction when you only need to adjust visibility.
Do not match suppressed messages by substring or regex unless it is required. Keep exact matching on msg.strip() to avoid hiding real warnings.
Do not bypass qt.makeRecord/qt.handle by calling log.debug directly. Doing so loses the file, line and func context.
procedure: Locate qt_message_handler in qutebrowser/utils/log.py. It maps QtMsgType to logging levels through the qt_to_logging dict, and it contains the suppressed_msgs list of well-known noisy Qt messages.
Remove the early `return` for messages in suppressed_msgs. Compute a local `level` instead: use logging.DEBUG when msg.strip() matches a known message, otherwise use qt_to_logging[msg_type].

Pass the computed `level` to qt.makeRecord(...) in place of the inline qt_to_logging[msg_type] lookup. The rest of the record construction stays unchanged: name 'qt' or 'qt-<category>', context.file, context.line, msg, and func parsed via the regex.
Rewrite the comment above suppressed_msgs. It should say these messages are downgraded to debug so users don't see them, not that they are suppressed.
To silence a new well-known Qt message later, add its exact stripped text to suppressed_msgs. Do not add another code path.
validation: Run the existing tests: pytest tests/ -k log (for example tests/utils/test_log.py).
Check that a suppressed message still produces a record at DEBUG level on the 'qt' logger with the correct file, line and func.
Check that a non-listed QtWarningMsg is still logged at WARNING.
Run flake8/pylint on qutebrowser/utils/log.py to check line length after reflowing the makeRecord call.

name: qt-message-handler-function-name-regex
negative_constraints: Do not assume context.function has the form '<single-word-type> name(args)'. Qt passes Q_FUNC_INFO-style strings with qualifiers, templates, namespaces and pointers.
Do not remove the 'match is None' fallback or turn it into an exception. The handler runs for every Qt message and must never raise.
Do not change the captured group semantics (group(1) = function identifier). Downstream log record funcName depends on it.
Do not touch unrelated filtering or suppression logic in qt_message_handler for this fix.
procedure: Open qt_message_handler in qutebrowser/utils/log.py and find the re.match call that pulls the bare function name out of context.function.

Gather real context.function signatures Qt can deliver. Include ones whose return type is more than one \w token, such as 'const QString& Foo::bar(int)', 'static void QObject::foo()', 'QList<int> ns::Cls::fn(...)' and pointer return types. A single '\w*' prefix fails to match all of these.
Make the prefix permissive (for example '.* (\w*)\(.*\)'). The capture group should still grab only the identifier directly before the argument list.
Keep the existing fallback branch for when the match is None, so unparseable signatures don't crash the handler.
Keep the explanatory comment above the regex in sync if the expected input format changes.
validation: Run the existing tests for qutebrowser utils log (pytest tests/unit/utils/test_log.py).

Manually check the regex against sample signatures and confirm group(1) is the bare function name, e.g. 'void qt_png_warning(png_structp, png_const_charp)' -> qt_png_warning and 'const QString& QFoo::bar(int)' -> bar.
Confirm that a None or odd context.function still goes through the fallback path without crashing.

name: qt-message-handler-special-case-hint
negative_constraints: Do not create a separate logging record or print to stderr directly. Change msg and let the existing qt.makeRecord/qt.handle path emit it.
Do not replace or drop the original Qt message text. Only append the hint.
Do not use substring matching that could catch unrelated Qt messages. Compare the exact first line.
Do not import faulthandler unconditionally at module top level for this path. Guard the import against ImportError.
Do not change log levels or the category naming logic (the 'qt' or 'qt-<category>' names).
procedure: Locate qt_message_handler in qutebrowser/utils/log.py. Qt warnings and fatal messages pass through this function before they are turned into logging records.
Find where the logger name and function are computed. Add the special case after that and before qt.makeRecord(...) is called. This way the existing record and handle path is reused.
Match the known Qt message with msg.splitlines()[0] == '<exact first line>'. Qt adds more lines after the first one, so compare only the first line, and compare it exactly.

Add the user-facing hint to msg, for example: msg += '

On Archlinux, this should fix the problem:
    pacman -S libxkbcommon-x11'. Keep the original Qt text and put the hint after it.

If the message is fatal and Qt will abort right after it, turn off faulthandler so a crash traceback does not bury the useful hint. Import it inside a guard: try: import faulthandler / except ImportError: pass / else: faulthandler.disable().
Add a short comment such as '# Handle this message specially.' so future maintainers know why the branch exists.
validation: Run the existing log tests: pytest tests/unit/utils/test_log.py (or the repo's equivalent).
Call qt_message_handler manually with a fake context and the exact xcb message. Check that the emitted record contains both the original text and the pacman hint.
Check that a normal Qt message with a different first line passes through unchanged.
Run flake8/pylint on qutebrowser/utils/log.py to check line length and import style.

name: qt-message-handler-tolerant-function-parsing
negative_constraints: Do not let exceptions propagate out of the Qt message handler. A crash there breaks all Qt logging and can abort the app.
Do not try to fix the problem by over-engineering the regex to cover every C++ signature. A graceful fallback is the required behavior.
Do not drop or blank out the function name on mismatch. Preserve the original `context.function`.
procedure: Locate the regex that extracts the function name from `context.function` inside `qt_message_handler` in qutebrowser/utils/log.py.
Assign the result of `re.match(r'\w* (\w*)\(.*\)', context.function)` to a variable first. Do not chain `.group(1)` directly onto the match call.
If the match is not None, use `match.group(1)` as `func`.

Otherwise, fall back to the raw `context.function` string, so the logging handler never raises on unexpected Qt signature formats. Examples of such formats: no return type, operators, templates, or lambdas.
Keep the rest of the record construction unchanged. That includes the category-to-name mapping (`qt` / `qt-<category>`) and the `makeRecord` arguments.
validation: Run the existing log tests (pytest tests/unit/utils/test_log.py, or the repository equivalent).

Manually or in a test, call `qt_message_handler` with a fake context whose `function` lacks a 'type name(args)' shape (e.g. 'foo' or 'operator()'). Assert that no exception is raised and that `record.funcName` equals the raw string.
Assert that a normal signature like 'void qt_png_warning(png_structp, png_const_charp)' still yields 'qt_png_warning'.

name: qt-msghandler-scoped-disable-for-hangs
negative_constraints: Do not keep the old workaround (forcing a Content-Type header) alongside the new one. Remove it entirely.
Do not disable the message handler globally or for a wide scope. Wrap only the single Qt call.
Do not leave the handler uninstalled on an exception path.
Do not change init_log or qt_message_handler itself to fix a call-site-specific hang.
procedure: Confirm root cause: the hang only appears when a Qt warning is emitted inside a Qt-internal call (e.g. QNetworkAccessManager.createRequest emits a missing Content-Type warning on POST), and does not reproduce with a minimal browser that has no custom message handler. Python handler re-entrancy is the suspected cause.

Do not work around the condition that triggers the warning (for example, manually setting a Content-Type header on certain ops). Instead, temporarily remove the custom Qt message handler around the specific call that emits the warning.

Reuse or add the context manager log.disable_qt_msghandler() in qutebrowser/utils/log.py. Implementation: old = qInstallMessageHandler(None); yield; qInstallMessageHandler(old). Import contextmanager from contextlib.
Restore the handler inside try/finally so it is reinstalled even when an exception is raised. The original PR did not do this; it is a known weakness.

At the call site, wrap only the minimal statement with the context manager: with log.disable_qt_msghandler(): reply = super().createRequest(op, req, outgoing_data). Keep bookkeeping such as self._requests.append and signal connections outside the with block.
Update the FIXME comment at the call site so it describes the current hypothesis (the message handler causes the freeze) and the open questions. Delete comments that describe the old workaround.
validation: Run the existing test suite (unit tests for utils/log if present).
Manually reproduce the case: a form POST without Content-Type (e.g. a currency click on ch.mouser.com/localsites). The page must not freeze.
Verify that Qt warnings outside the wrapped call are still routed through qt_message_handler into qutebrowser logging.
Verify that after an exception inside the with block, qInstallMessageHandler returns the original handler.

name: qt-nested-layout-no-parent-widget
negative_constraints: Do not pass `self` as the parent to a layout that will be added to another layout with addLayout.
Do not call addLayout for the same layout twice, or leave the old trailing addLayout in place after moving it earlier.
Do not change widget order or margins and spacing when making this fix. Only change the parenting and the order of construction.
procedure: Search the widget/dialog modules (e.g. qutebrowser/widgets/**) for layouts constructed with a widget parent: `Q*Layout(self)` or `QStackedLayout(self)`.

For each one, determine whether the layout is later nested into another layout via `parent_layout.addLayout(...)`. Only the top-level layout of a widget may receive the widget as parent, because passing the widget calls setLayout on it.
Create nested layouts without a parent, e.g. `self._hbox = QHBoxLayout()`.
Immediately after creating the parentless layout, call `outer_layout.addLayout(inner)` so the layout is parented and the nesting order is clear.

Then configure the inner layout (setContentsMargins, addStretch) and add its child widgets, e.g. create `self._stack`, call `self._hbox.addLayout(self._stack)`, and only then add widgets to the stack.
Remove the old, later `addLayout` call for the same layout so it is not added twice.
In subclasses that extend the layout (e.g. _CrashDialog subclasses that add buttons to `self._hbox`), check that they still work with the new order.
validation: Run the existing tests.
Start qutebrowser and check that Qt prints no 'QLayout: Attempting to add QLayout ... which already has a layout' warnings on stderr.
Open the crash dialog and the statusbar, then check that the buttons, the stretch, and the stacked command/prompt widgets render in the expected positions.

name: qt-objectname-stylesheet-selector-sync
negative_constraints: 不要假设 Qt 会对不匹配的选择器报错。样式只会静默不生效, 必须靠 grep 主动检查。
不要修改 {color[...]} 模板占位符。
procedure: 重命名任何 Qt widget 类前, 先检查其基类 (如 TextBase) 是否用 self.__class__.__name__ 或类名设置 objectName。
若是, 在该类及其子类的 STYLESHEET 字符串中搜索 '#<OldName>', 全部替换为 '#<NewName>'。
检查通过 set_register_stylesheet / get_stylesheet 注册的样式模板, 确认选择器与新 objectName 一致。
validation: grep -rn '#<OldName>' qutebrowser/ 结果为空。
手动启动并检查受影响 widget 的样式是否正常。

name: qt-parent-self-showing-child-widgets
negative_constraints: Do not leave parentless widgets that can show themselves in the time between construction and addWidget.
Do not delay connecting signals as a workaround when passing a parent fixes the root cause.
procedure: Identify child widgets that call self.show() or setVisible() in response to signals, such as the statusbar's Progress, which reacts to load progress.
Construct these widgets with an explicit parent at creation time, e.g. `Progress(self)`, rather than relying on a later layout.addWidget to reparent them.
Make sure the widget's __init__ accepts a parent argument and forwards it to super().__init__.
Add a brief comment explaining why the explicit parent is needed: a show() before addWidget makes the widget a toplevel window that briefly blinks.
validation: Run the existing tests.
Load a page at startup and check that no separate progress-bar window flashes.
Check that the widget is still positioned correctly inside the statusbar layout.

name: qt-passthrough-arg-must-match-native-qt-option
negative_constraints: 不要按 CLI 风格偏好给 --qt-* 参数加连字符或驼峰,它们是 Qt 原生选项的透传映射。
不要为了改名去修改转发逻辑(前缀剥离)。应修正参数名本身,保持映射规则统一。
不要顺带改动 help 文本或 action 语义,这属于纯命名修正。
不要遗漏 args.<dest> 的其他引用点,否则会触发 AttributeError。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/qutebrowser.py 中的 _parse_args(),找到 debug 参数组里所有以 --qt-* 开头的 add_argument。
确认这些参数是如何转发给 QApplication 的。通常的做法是:去掉 'qt-' 前缀,再以单横线形式 -<name> 拼进 Qt 的 argv,例如 --qt-style -> -style。
对照 Qt 原生命令行选项逐个核对拼写(-style、-stylesheet、-widgetcount、-reverse 等)。去掉前缀后的名字必须与 Qt 原生选项逐字一致,不能自行插入连字符,例如应写 widgetcount,不能写 widget-count。
发现名字不一致时,只改 add_argument 的选项字符串,使它变成 --qt-<qt原生名>。保持 help、action、const、metavar 不变。
全局搜索旧名和对应的属性名(argparse 会把连字符转成下划线,如 qt_widget_count 与 qt_widgetcount),同步更新所有读取该属性或转发参数的代码。
如果转发逻辑依赖 dest 名称来推导 Qt 参数名,需要确认改名后推导结果正确。
validation: python -m qutebrowser --help:确认显示的是新参数名。
用 --qt-widgetcount 启动并正常退出:确认 Qt 在结束时打印 widget 计数调试信息,证明参数已真正传给 Qt。
grep 旧名(qt-widget-count / qt_widget_count):确认没有残留引用。
运行现有测试和 lint。

name: qt-runtime-version-check-helper
negative_constraints: 要判断实际运行的 Qt 时,不要用编译期常量 QT_VERSION 或 PYQT_VERSION。
不要在各模块里重复写内联的 Version(qVersion()) 比较,统一调用 utils.misc.qt_version_check。
替换调用点时,不要去掉调用方原有的 ValueError 防护。
不要把 helper 写成只支持 >=,要保留 op 参数。
procedure: 先在 qutebrowser/ 下 grep 'qVersion()'、'Version(qVersion' 和 'QT_VERSION'。找出所有临时写的 Qt 版本比较。
在 qutebrowser/utils/misc.py 放模块级 helper `qt_version_check(version, op=operator.ge)`,放在常量之后、其他工具函数之前。函数体为 `return op(Version(qVersion()), Version(version))`,其中 Version 即 distutils StrictVersion。
在 misc.py 顶部 import operator。StrictVersion 和 qVersion 的 import 放在第三方/Qt import 组里。
docstring 用 Args: 段落,写清 version 和 op 的含义,并说明比较的是 Qt runtime 版本。
把已有调用点替换成 helper。例如 actute_warning 里的 `Version(qVersion()) >= Version('5.3.0')` 改为 `qt_version_check('5.3.0')`。原有的 try/except ValueError 要保留,因为 StrictVersion 可能解析不了某些 Qt 版本字符串。
需要非 >= 的比较时,给 op 传 operator.lt、operator.eq 等。调用方模块要 import operator,例如 browser/webpage.py。不要另外再写一个新 helper。
validation: 运行现有测试套件(包括 utils/misc 的测试),确认没有回归。
python -c 'from qutebrowser.utils.misc import qt_version_check; print(qt_version_check("5.0.0"))'
运行 flake8/pylint,检查是否有未使用的 import。例如调用方 import 了 operator 却没用到,或者 misc.py 的 import 顺序不对。
再 grep 一次 'Version(qVersion' 和 'qVersion()',确认没有遗漏的内联比较。

name: qt-statusbar-ignore-horizontal-sizehint
negative_constraints: Do not change the vertical size policy from Fixed. That would let the statusbar change height.
Do not truncate or shorten the text strings in code as a workaround for the layout problem.
Do not override sizeHint/minimumSizeHint with hardcoded widths when a size policy change solves it.
Do not add a full elided-label implementation in the same minimal bugfix unless the task asks for it. Leave a FIXME instead.
procedure: Locate the widget's __init__ in qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar.py (class StatusBar) and find its setSizePolicy call.

Diagnose: with QSizePolicy.Expanding, the widget's sizeHint/minimumSizeHint still constrains the layout. Long label text (URL, command text, messages) can then force the main window to grow or block it from shrinking.
Change only the horizontal policy to QSizePolicy.Ignored. Keep the vertical policy QSizePolicy.Fixed so the statusbar height stays stable.
Leave the child QHBoxLayout and its widgets unchanged. The parent layout now decides the width, and overflowing text gets clipped.
Add a FIXME/TODO noting that texts should eventually be elided instead of cut off, with a reference to an elided-label approach. Clipping is an accepted interim trade-off.
Check other bar-like widgets for the same symptom, such as the tab bar or the completion widget. Apply the same horizontal Ignored policy only when the width should come from the parent.
validation: Run the existing test suite / linters (pylint, flake8) for qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar.py.
Manually launch the app, load a very long URL or type a long command, and confirm the main window does not grow wider and can still be resized smaller.
Confirm the statusbar height is unchanged and the widgets still lay out left and right correctly.

name: qt-stylesheet-cross-platform-font-fallback
negative_constraints: 不要删除或替换 'Monospace' 首选项,否则 Linux/X11 原有的行为会变。
不要只改一个 widget,所有带 font-family 的 stylesheet 都要同步修改。
不要为这个 bugfix 引入平台检测分支 (sys.platform) 或 QFontDatabase 逻辑,CSS 回退列表就够用。
不要改动 stylesheet 字符串的引号和拼接,避免破坏 bg/fg 的注入。
procedure: 在 qutebrowser/widgets/ 下 grep 'font-family',找出所有内联 Qt stylesheet (setStyleSheet 字符串) 中的字体声明,至少包括 statusbar.py 的 '* {...}' 块和 tabbar.py 的 'QTabBar {...}' 块。
保留现有的通用族名 'Monospace' 作为首选项,在其后追加一个 Windows 上一定存在的具体等宽字体,形成逗号分隔的回退列表,例如 'font-family: Monospace, Courier;'。
让所有 widget 使用同一份回退列表,保证 statusbar 和 tabbar 的字体表现一致。
修改只限于 stylesheet 字符串字面量,保持周围的字符串拼接 (bg/fg 变量) 和选择器结构不变。
validation: 运行现有测试或至少导入 qutebrowser.widgets.statusbar 和 qutebrowser.widgets.tabbar,确认没有语法错误。
grep -rn 'font-family' qutebrowser/,确认每一处都包含相同的回退列表。
在 Windows 上 (或通过检查 QFontInfo(widget.font()).family()) 启动后确认 statusbar 和 tabbar 显示为等宽字体。
在 Linux 上确认 Monospace 仍然生效,没有回归。

name: qt-timer-cleanup-on-exception
negative_constraints: 不要在参数校验之前创建 parented Timer/QObject。
不要在异常分支吞掉异常，也不要把 CommandError 换成别的类型；清理后必须 re-raise。
不要直接 del 或同步销毁 QObject，统一用 deleteLater()。
不要去掉 OverflowError 到 CommandError 的转换。
不要为这类修复引入额外的 surfaces（changelog/docs），保持只改 code。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser 中创建 parented Qt 对象的命令实现，例如 utils/utilcmds.py 的 later()：其中 usertypes.Timer(parent=app) 在后续代码抛异常时会一直挂在 app 下，不会被释放。
先完成所有纯参数校验（如 ms < 0 时 raise cmdexc.CommandError、拼接 cmdline、构造 CommandRunner），再创建 Timer。这样校验失败时不会产生任何 Qt 对象。
Timer 创建之后，把所有可能失败的配置步骤放进一个 try 块：setSingleShot、setInterval（内层把 OverflowError 转成 CommandError）、timeout.connect(run_safely)、timeout.connect(timer.deleteLater)、timer.start()。
外层用 `except:  # pylint: disable=bare-except` 捕获任意异常，先调用 timer.deleteLater()，再执行裸 raise，保留原异常（含 CommandError）向上传播。
成功路径保持原有清理方式：通过 timeout -> deleteLater 在触发后释放 Timer。
validation: run existing tests (pytest tests/ 中与 utilcmds / later 相关的用例)。
手动验证 :later 999999999999 echo x：应报 'Numeric argument is too large'，且 app 的子对象中不残留 Timer。
手动验证 :later -1 echo x：应报错且不创建 Timer。
手动验证 :later 100 message-info hi：命令能正常执行，触发后 Timer 被删除。
运行 pylint，确认 bare-except 已用 disable 注释标注。

name: qt-version-gated-env-workaround-in-earlyinit
negative_constraints: 不要在模块顶层导入 PyQt5.QtWidgets，也不要导入任何会间接加载 QtWidgets 的模块，否则环境变量设置会失效。
不要对 Qt 版本做范围比较或字符串大小比较。应针对已确认有 bug 的具体版本用精确匹配，其他版本回退到稳定默认值。
不要改变用户显式传入 --harfbuzz old/new 时的行为。auto 逻辑只作用于 linux 且 args.harfbuzz == 'auto' 的情况。
不要在没有注释和 bug 链接的情况下加入版本特判。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/utils/earlyinit.py 中的 fix_harfbuzz(args)。它在导入 QtWidgets 之前运行，Qt 渲染相关的环境变量必须在这个阶段设置。
在函数内部用局部导入的方式引入 qVersion：from PyQt5.QtCore import qVersion。此时 QtCore 已可安全导入，但 QtWidgets 不能先于该函数导入。
在 'auto' 分支中，根据 qVersion() 的精确值选择引擎。已知有问题的版本（例如 '5.3.0' 的 QTBUG-39278）设为 'new'，其他版本默认设为最稳定的 'old'。
在版本分支旁写注释，逐个版本说明选择理由，并附上 Qt bugreport 链接，方便以后升级 Qt 时复查或移除。
把显式强制的取值合并为一个分支：elif args.harfbuzz in ['old', 'new']: os.environ['QT_HARFBUZZ'] = args.harfbuzz。
每个分支都调用 logger.debug，记录所选引擎和来源（auto/forced/system），便于排查崩溃报告。
保留 'system' 这个兜底分支，不设置环境变量，让 Qt 使用自身默认值。
保留函数开头对 'PyQt5.QtWidgets' in sys.modules 的警告，不要删除这项检查。
validation: 运行现有测试套件，例如 python -m unittest / tox，并对 earlyinit 做导入检查。
分别用 --harfbuzz auto/old/new/system 启动 qutebrowser 并开启 debug 日志，确认日志中的引擎选择和 os.environ['QT_HARFBUZZ'] 的值正确。
mock qVersion 返回 '5.3.0' 和 '5.2.1'，验证 auto 分支分别选择 new 和 old。
确认调用 fix_harfbuzz 时没有出现 'QtWidgets is already imported' 警告。

name: qt-warning-filter-context-manager
negative_constraints: Do not install or replace a Qt message handler just to hide one warning. Use a logging filter scoped to a context manager.
Do not attach the filter permanently to the 'qt' logger. It must be removed when the context exits.
Do not use the real 'qt' logger name in tests. Use a dedicated name such as 'qt-tests' to avoid cross-test interference.
Do not claim regex semantics in the docstring while implementing startswith, or the reverse.
Do not match against record.getMessage() after formatting unless that is intended. The evidence matches record.msg after strip().
procedure: Locate qutebrowser/utils/log.py. Qt messages are routed into Python logging by qt_message_handler, which writes to the 'qt' logger. Filter at the logging layer. Do not touch the Qt message handler.

Add a logging.Filter subclass, e.g. QtWarningFilter. Store the pattern in __init__ and call super().__init__(). Have filter(record) return False when record.msg.strip().startswith(pattern), and True otherwise. Stripping makes leading and trailing whitespace in Qt messages still match.

Add a @contextlib.contextmanager function hide_qt_warning(pattern, logger='qt'). It gets logging.getLogger(logger), calls addFilter, yields, then calls removeFilter. Make the logger name a parameter so tests can use an isolated logger.
Prefer wrapping the yield in try/finally so the filter is always removed, even when the body raises.
Make the docstring describe the real matching semantics: prefix match after strip. Either say that, or actually implement a regex if you call it one.
Put the new code next to the existing LogFilter or qt_message_handler code, and reuse the module's existing contextlib and logging imports.
In test_log.py, add a HideQtWarningTests class that extends BaseTest so logging state is reset. Import qWarning from PyQt5.QtCore.

Cover these cases: an unfiltered message, asserted with self.assertLogs(logger, logging.WARNING); an exact match that is filtered; a prefix match that is filtered; and a whitespace-padded message that is filtered.
validation: Run python -m unittest qutebrowser.test.utils.test_log, or the repo's test runner, and confirm all HideQtWarningTests pass.
Confirm the unfiltered case emits a WARNING inside hide_qt_warning by using assertLogs.
Confirm that after the with-block exits the logger has no leftover QtWarningFilter: check logger.filters is empty.
Run the existing log tests (InitLogTests, LogFilter tests) to make sure there are no regressions.

name: qt-widget-height-from-font-not-stylesheet
negative_constraints: 不要在 stylesheet 里用固定 px 高度去适配某个字号, 字体或 DPI 一变文字就会被截断。
不要把 height: 13px 换成 setFixedHeight 或 min/max-height 之类的固定值, 这只是换个地方写死。
去掉固定高度后, 不要让 QLineEdit 的纵向 policy 保持 Minimum 或 Expanding, 否则 statusbar 会变得比文本行更高。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/widgets 下控件的 Qt stylesheet 模板字符串, 例如 StatusBar 的 STYLESHEET 和 TabWidget 中的 QTabBar 规则。找出写死的 'height: Npx' 声明。
删除写死的 height 声明, 只保留 font-family 和 font-size, 让 Qt 根据字体度量算出控件高度。
检查同一布局里的子控件, 例如 statusbar 中的 Command(QLineEdit)。如果它的 sizeHint 会把容器高度撑大, 把它的纵向 size policy 改为 QSizePolicy.Ignored, 横向保持 Expanding, 让容器高度由其他标签类兄弟控件决定。
如果 stylesheet 是 str.format 模板, 保留 {{ }} 转义和 {color[...]}、{monospace} 等占位符的结构。
validation: 运行已有测试或 lint (pylint/flake8), 确认 stylesheet 的 format 模板仍能正确渲染。
手动启动 qutebrowser, 检查 tabbar 和 statusbar 的文字没有被截断, 且 statusbar 高度与文本行一致, 没有因命令输入框而变高。
临时修改 font-size, 确认两个栏的高度随字号自动调整。

name: qt-widget-property-setters-instead-of-setattr
negative_constraints: Do not keep __setattr__ while adding properties. Doing both causes double triggering or recursion.
Do not assign through the property in __init__ when the update method depends on state that is not yet initialized. Assign the private fields directly.
Do not change the public attribute names or the external call sites.
Do not keep a leftover _initializing guard flag.
procedure: Locate classes that override __setattr__ to trigger side effects such as UI refresh. Typical signatures: an _initializing flag, filtering by name.startswith('_'), or a call to self._update_*() inside __setattr__.
Enumerate the public attributes that actually need side effects (e.g. normaltext and temptext). Do not include every non-underscore attribute.
Rename each of these attributes to private storage (_normaltext, _temptext). In __init__, assign the private fields directly, which skips the side effect.
For each attribute, add a @property getter that returns the private field, and an @<name>.setter that writes the private field and then calls the update method (_update_text).
Delete the __setattr__ override and the _initializing flag. Then search for any remaining references to them.
Update the class docstring Attributes section: list the private fields and note 'Accessed via <name> property'. Remove the update method's docstring wording that says it is called from __setattr__.
Keep the public attribute names unchanged so external callers (e.g. StatusBar assigning text.temptext = ...) need no changes.
validation: Run the existing tests/pylint/flake8. Confirm no remaining references to _initializing or __setattr__ (grep).
Grep for every external assignment such as .normaltext = / .temptext = and confirm each one still triggers the display update.
Manual check: setting temptext shows it first, and clearing it falls back to normaltext.

name: qt-widget-sizehint-override-pitfalls
negative_constraints: 不要提交引用未定义名称(parent、QSize、裸 minimumSizeHint)的方法。布局计算时 Qt 会调用这些方法,导致运行时 NameError。原证据提交正因此成为 'broken progress bar'。
不要假设 Python 方法能访问 __init__ 的局部参数。
procedure: 重写 Qt 控件的 minimumSizeHint 或 sizeHint 时,通过 self.parentWidget() 或构造时保存的 self._parent 访问父控件,不要引用构造函数参数名 parent(方法作用域内它未定义)。
在 PyQt5.QtCore 的 import 行中显式导入 QSize。
sizeHint 内调用 self.minimumSizeHint(),不要写成裸调用 minimumSizeHint()。
如果只想让进度条高度跟随状态栏,优先使用 setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Fixed/Preferred, QSizePolicy.Ignored) 或 setMaximumHeight 等声明式方案,再考虑重写 hint 方法或重绘。
保留的 FIXME 必须对应可运行的代码。注释掉的实验代码不应和会在运行时抛错的重写方法同时提交。
validation: 运行 pyflakes 或 pylint qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar.py,确认没有 undefined name 警告。
实例化 StatusBar 并调用 show() 和 adjustSize(),确认 sizeHint 路径不抛异常。
目测进度条高度不超过状态栏高度。

name: qt-widget-stylesheet-class-template
negative_constraints: Do not leave single CSS braces in a template that goes through .format(): they raise KeyError/ValueError. Plain-text stylesheets that are never formatted keep single braces.
Do not re-render the stylesheet in __setattr__ for every attribute. Only re-render for the style attributes, to avoid repaints or recursion during Qt initialization.
Do not build CSS by string concatenation (`""" + bg + """`).
Do not change the CSS property values themselves (border, margin, font-size, chunk color). This is a refactor and must not change visual behavior.
procedure: Locate the setStyleSheet calls in qutebrowser/widgets/*.py that build triple-quoted CSS inline inside __init__ or a helper method, for example StatusBar.set_color, StatusProgress.__init__ and TabWidget.__init__.
Move each static stylesheet into a class attribute `_stylesheet = """..."""`. In __init__, call only `self.setStyleSheet(self._stylesheet.strip())`.
For a dynamic stylesheet, first turn the variable values (fgcolor, bgcolor, font, etc.) into class attributes with default values.
