If a bug only appears for programmatic or other-typed navigations, such as JS location changes, iframe loads, or hinting edge cases, look for a dedicated fix elsewhere first. A good precedent is commit f3b55d6 for #488. Fix the symptom at that targeted site instead of widening the type filter.
When reverting a broadening change, confirm that the issue the original change fixed is still covered by the later targeted fix. Cite that commit in the revert message.
Make the revert minimal. Restore the original `if typ != QWebPage.NavigationTypeLinkClicked: return True` condition and drop the stale comment.
validation: Run the existing test suite (pytest / tox) to make sure nothing regresses.
Manually check that the #567 scenario loads normally: pages or frames with NavigationTypeOther requests should not be hijacked.
Manually check that the #488 scenario still works (hinting or clicking links that open in a new tab or target).

name: qutebrowser-network-request-header-workaround
negative_constraints: Do not change Content-Type on requests that already have it set, or on non-POST operations.
Do not implement the workaround by hostname matching (e.g. checking for mouser.com). Fix the generic missing-header condition instead.
Do not move the header manipulation after super().createRequest(). The request has already been dispatched by then.
Do not alter the _requests tracking and destroyed-signal cleanup logic.
Do not use setRawHeader for well-known headers that QNetworkRequest exposes as KnownHeaders.
procedure: Locate NetworkManager.createRequest in qutebrowser/network/networkmanager.py. It is the single place where outgoing QNetworkRequest objects get adjusted before the reply is created. Accept-Language and similar headers are already set there.

Add the workaround inside the same block that already sets headers, before the call to super().createRequest(op, req, outgoing_data). This keeps the reply bookkeeping unchanged: self._requests.append and the destroyed.connect cleanup.

Guard the fix tightly. Check the operation type, for example op == QNetworkAccessManager.PostOperation. Also check that the header is missing, for example not req.header(QNetworkRequest.ContentTypeHeader). This way only the broken case is affected.

Set the header through the typed API: req.setHeader(QNetworkRequest.ContentTypeHeader, 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'). This mirrors the default that Qt applies in QHttpNetworkRequestPrivate::header.
Write a detailed comment next to the workaround. It should cover the reproducing URL or site, which Qt source and function the workaround mirrors, and why it is needed.
Add a FIXME listing the open questions, such as why Qt freezes and why the minimal browser does not. Future maintainers can then revisit the workaround or remove it.
validation: Run existing tests (tox / pytest) to ensure nothing in networkmanager regresses.
Manually reproduce the freeze on the reported site. Confirm it no longer freezes with the change, and that it still freezes without it.
Verify that normal form POSTs with an explicit Content-Type still send their original header, for example by logging or with a request-inspection site.
Run pylint/flake8 on the changed file to respect the repo's line-length and style checks.

name: qutebrowser-new-color-setting-registration
negative_constraints: Do not hardcode colors in widget code when a config option is expected.
Do not rename or reorder existing keys. Users' config files depend on them.
procedure: Locate the DATA OrderedDict in qutebrowser/config/configdata.py and the matching widget section, for example the statusbar.* keys under colors.
Insert the new entry next to its siblings, using a dotted name that extends the existing hierarchy (for example statusbar.bg.prompt next to statusbar.bg.error).

Use `SettingValue(types.Color(), default)`. The default can be a literal such as 'darkblue' or a reference such as '${statusbar.fg}'. Write a one-sentence description in the existing 'Background color of X if Y.' style.
Consume the setting through the `{color[key]}` placeholder in the widget's STYLESHEET, rendered with get_stylesheet.
validation: Run the existing tests.
Start with a fresh config and confirm the new key appears with its default value and no config validation errors.

name: qutebrowser-no-commanderror-outside-command-context
negative_constraints: Do not raise CommandError from code that can be reached via Qt signals, key handlers, or async callbacks.
Do not swallow the condition silently. Always report it via message.error.
Do not continue execution after message.error. Return before calling the handler with a None url.
Do not convert internal invariant errors (ValueError for an unknown target) into user messages.
procedure: Locate any `raise CommandError(...)` (or `cmdexc.CommandError`) inside a code path that is not executed synchronously from a `@cmdutils.register` command. Typical examples are `HintManager.fire` or `_fire`, which run after a keypress or filter match, Qt signal/slot callbacks, and timer callbacks.

Trace the callers to confirm the path. If the function can be called from a signal or keystring handler, a raised CommandError is not caught by the command runner. It surfaces as an unhandled exception and opens the crash dialog.
Replace `raise CommandError(msg)` with `message.error(msg)` followed by an immediate `return`. Keep the original user-facing message text.
Make sure `from qutebrowser.utils import message` is already imported in the module. Remove the CommandError import only if no other uses remain.
Keep any `raise ValueError` or other programmer-error branches as they are. Only user-facing, recoverable conditions should become `message.error`.
validation: Run the existing hint tests: pytest tests/unit/browser/test_hints.py, plus the end-to-end hints feature tests if available.
Manually or in an e2e test, hint an element without a resolvable URL (e.g. `:hint all tab` on a non-link element). Verify an error message appears and no crash dialog opens.
grep the module for remaining `raise CommandError` on non-command paths.

name: qutebrowser-normalize-escaped-quotes-in-format-strings
negative_constraints: 不要把外层字符串改成单引号去规避转义。仓库约定外层用双引号，内层引用值用单引号。
不要改注释中的文字，例如 DON"T 这类注释。提交只处理代码中的字符串字面量。
不要顺手把 .format 改写成 f-string 或 % 格式。
不要修改断言具体消息文本的测试预期，除非确有测试匹配旧的双引号文本。如有，需要同步更新。
procedure: 在 qutebrowser/ 下 grep 双引号字符串字面量里出现 \" 的地方，重点查 format 占位符周围的 \"{}\"。检查范围包括 logging.debug/warning 调用、ValueError/ValidationError 的 __init__ 消息，以及 completion 描述文本，例如 "Alias for ..."。
把内部被转义的双引号改成单引号："Invalid value \"{}\" - {}" 改为 "Invalid value '{}' - {}"。外层字符串保持双引号不变。
同时找出引号不配对的字符串，例如 "... section '{}\" because"，统一改成 '{}'。
如果修改后行长度变化，按 PEP8 79 列重新折行。拆分隐式拼接字符串时，保证一对 '{}' 的开闭引号逻辑上完整，并让续行参数对齐到左括号。
只改引号字符，format 参数、日志级别和消息语义都保持不变。
validation: grep -rn '\\"{}\\"' qutebrowser/ 应无结果。
grep 检查 '{}\" 这类单双引号混用残留。
运行 pylint/flake8，确认没有超长行和续行缩进告警。
运行现有测试套件，确认没有依赖旧消息文本的断言失败。

name: qutebrowser-package-init-with-docstrings
negative_constraints: 不要在新建的 __init__.py 里加 import 或 re-export 子模块, 以免引入循环导入或提前加载 PyQt。
不要修改已有 __init__.py 中函数的行为 (例如 qurl 的 http:// 前缀逻辑), 只补 docstring。
不要把 docstring 放在 import 之后。它必须是文件的第一条语句, 否则不算模块 docstring。
不要为了这个修复去重命名或移动包目录。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/ 下所有被 import 为包的目录 (例如 qutebrowser/widgets/)。检查每个目录是否有 __init__.py。缺失的会导致 'import qutebrowser.widgets.xxx' 失败, 或者 setuptools/packaging 漏掉该目录。
为缺失的包新增 __init__.py。内容只放一行模块 docstring, 用一句话描述这个包的职责, 例如 """The Qt widgets needed by qutebrowser."""。
复查同一批已有的 __init__.py (例如 utils/__init__.py、widgets/statusbar/__init__.py)。如果它们缺少模块级 docstring, 在文件第一行补上, 后面空一行再接 import。
如果已有 __init__.py 里定义了公共函数或类 (例如 utils.qurl), 顺手为每个缺 docstring 的函数补一句话 docstring, 说明输入和输出语义。
改动保持纯结构性和文档性, 不触碰函数逻辑。
validation: python -c 'import qutebrowser.widgets, qutebrowser.widgets.statusbar, qutebrowser.utils'
运行 pylint 或 flake8,确认没有 missing-docstring (C0111) 报错
启动 qutebrowser (python -m qutebrowser),确认主窗口和状态栏能正常加载

name: qutebrowser-pep8-visual-indent-continuation
negative_constraints: 不要改变任何表达式的语义、参数顺序或关键字参数名, 只调整空白和换行。
不要用反斜杠续行。
不要引入超过 79 列的行。
不要顺带修改无关逻辑、docstring 或测试。
不要混用 hanging indent 和 visual indent。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/widgets/** 中使用 hanging indent 的多行调用, 即开括号后直接换行、参数缩进 4 格的写法, 例如 `setInterval(\n    config.get(...))` 或 `NeighborList(\n    ...)`。
如果整个调用合并后能放进 79 列, 就合并为单行。例如 `self._text_pop_timer.setInterval(config.get('ui', 'message-timeout'))`。
如果放不下, 改用 visual indent: 第一个参数紧跟开括号放在同一行, 后续参数与第一个参数的起始列对齐, 例如 `NeighborList(config.get('ui', 'zoom-levels'),` 后接对齐的 `default=...` 和 `mode=...` 行。
嵌套调用仍然超长时, 在内层调用的参数之间换行, 并与内层开括号后的第一个参数对齐, 例如 `config.get('ui',` 下一行对齐 `'message-timeout'))`。
全文件统一应用此风格。同一文件中重复出现的相同表达式(如 __init__ 和 on_config_changed 中的 setInterval)都要检查。
validation: 运行 pep8/flake8(或 tox 中的 lint 环境), 确认没有 E12x 续行缩进和 E501 行长警告。
运行 pylint 确认没有新增警告。
运行现有测试并 git diff -w, 确认去掉空白差异后没有任何实质改动。

name: qutebrowser-prune-unused-qt-imports
negative_constraints: 不要删除在本文件或经由本模块被重导出后仍被使用的名字。
不要顺手重构 Text 类或修改 statusbar 的行为逻辑, 这类 bugfix 只限于 import 清理。
不要把 `from X import A, B` 改写成 `import X` 或通配导入。
不要为纯 import 清理添加 changelog 或测试文件, gold surface 只有 code。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/widgets/** 下目标模块里的 `from PyQt5.<Module> import A, B` 语句, 例如 statusbar/text.py。
在该文件内 grep 每个导入名 (例如 `QCompleter`), 确认它没有被引用。要覆盖类型注解、基类和字符串用法, 也要检查是否有其他模块通过 `from qutebrowser.widgets.statusbar.text import ...` 间接依赖这个名字。
只从原导入行中删掉未使用的名字, 其余仍在使用的名字 (例如 QLabel) 保持在同一行, 不改变导入顺序和风格。
如果删除后该行没有剩余名字, 就删除整行, 不要留下空导入。
这次修改只限于导入行, 类体和 docstring 保持不变。
validation: 运行 `python -c "import qutebrowser.widgets.statusbar.text"`, 确认模块可以导入且没有 NameError。
运行 pyflakes/pylint 检查该文件, 确认没有 unused-import 告警, 也没有新增 undefined-name。
用 grep 搜索整个仓库中被删名字经该模块导入的用法, 结果应为空。
运行现有测试套件或启动冒烟测试, 确认 statusbar 能正常构建。

name: qutebrowser-pylint-cleanup-pass
negative_constraints: Do not add module-level or global pylint disables. Keep disables local to the function and give each one a justification comment.
Do not change event filtering semantics while refactoring eventFilter. The release events matched to passed-through presses must still be let through, and all their occurrences removed afterwards.
Do not rename public signals, or methods used by other modules, during cleanup.
Do not touch tests, docs, or changelog for a pure lint pass. The maintenance surface is code only.
procedure: Run pylint/flake8/pep8 on the qutebrowser package. Fix each warning at its source. Do not change behavior.
Remove unused imports. For example, drop `Qt` from `from PyQt5.QtCore import pyqtSignal, Qt` when it is unused. Grep the module first to confirm no remaining references.

For a multi-line parenthesized import, use one of two styles. Either align the continuation lines with the opening paren, or break right after `(` and use a hanging indent of 4 spaces. Do not use a mixed or under-indented continuation.

For long methods that trigger complexity warnings, split them into private helpers. In ModeManager, the KeyPress and KeyRelease branches of eventFilter become `_eventFilter_keypress(event)` and `_eventFilter_keyrelease(event)`. Each helper returns a filter_this bool. The dispatcher only checks the event type and delegates.

Keep the original side effects inside each extracted helper and in the same order. That means emitting key_pressed, calling the mode handler, applying the passthrough/forward_unbound_keys logic, and appending to or pruning `_releaseevents_to_pass`.
Give each new helper a docstring with Args/Return sections, following the repo's Google-style docstrings.

Some warnings are structurally justified, such as Command.__init__ taking many arguments from the cmdutils registration. Add a scoped `# pylint: disable=<msg>` inside that function, with a short comment explaining why. Never disable the warning module-wide.
validation: Re-run pylint and pep8/flake8 on the changed files and confirm the targeted warnings are gone and no new ones appear.
Run the existing unit tests.
Smoke-test key handling manually. Check normal-mode bindings, passthrough (insert) mode, and hint mode, and confirm unbound keys and their releases are forwarded as before.

name: qutebrowser-pyqt-missing-import-fix
negative_constraints: 不要使用 from PyQt5.QtCore import * 这样的通配导入。
不要从错误的子模块导入,例如从 QtWidgets 导入 pyqtSignal。
不要顺带重构 StatusBar 类或其他无关代码。
不要为了这种单行导入修复去改 changelog 或测试,除非仓库明确要求。
procedure: 先找出出问题的 qutebrowser/widgets/*.py 模块(例如 statusbar.py)。在该模块里查找用到但没有导入的 PyQt 名字,比如 pyqtSignal、pyqtSlot、Qt、QTimer。
确认每个缺失的名字来自哪个子模块。pyqtSignal、pyqtSlot、Qt 和 QObject 来自 PyQt5.QtCore,QWidget、QLabel、QLineEdit 和 QHBoxLayout 来自 PyQt5.QtWidgets。
沿用文件顶部已有的导入风格,按子模块逐行写显式的 from PyQt5.<Sub> import <Name>。新增的 QtCore 导入行放在现有 QtWidgets 导入行旁边。
如果同一子模块已经有一行导入,把新名字追加到那一行。不要为同一个子模块重复写导入语句。
保持最小改动。只补上缺失的导入,不要改动类结构和信号定义。
validation: 运行 python -c 'import qutebrowser.widgets.statusbar',确认不再出现 NameError 或 ImportError。
用 pyflakes 或 pylint 检查该文件,确认没有 undefined name 和 unused import。
如果仓库有测试,运行现有测试。

name: qutebrowser-qwebpage-extension-handler-pattern
negative_constraints: 不要在处理函数里使用未经 cast 的原始 opt/out 指针。
不要修改通用的 extension 分发逻辑来特判某一个扩展。
procedure: 要新增 QWebPage 扩展支持时, 在 BrowserPage.__init__ 的 self._extension_handlers 中添加 QWebPage.<Ext>: self._handle_<name>。
确认已有的 supportsExtension/extension 实现基于该字典查表分发, 新条目会被自动覆盖, 无需改动它们。
处理函数签名统一为 (opt, out)。先对两个参数分别做 sip.cast 到对应的 Option/Return 类型; 任一为 None 时委托给 super().extension。
把结果写入 out 对象的属性, 成功时返回 True。
validation: 运行 lint 和现有测试。
手动触发对应扩展的场景, 确认处理函数被调用且返回 True。

name: qutebrowser-qwebpage-file-upload-hooks
negative_constraints: 不要直接返回 QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(s) 的元组; PyQt5 返回 (name(s), selectedFilter), 必须解包。
不要绕过 _extension_handlers 字典去另外硬编码 extension() 分支。
不要在 sip.cast 失败时直接返回 False 或抛异常, 应回退到 super().extension。
不要只实现 chooseFile 而漏掉 ChooseMultipleFilesExtension(<input multiple>), 也不要只实现后者而漏掉前者。
chooseFile 签名必须保持 (frame, suggested_file); 未使用的 frame 参数命名为 _frame, 以通过 pylint。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/browser/webpage.py 中的 BrowserPage(QWebPage)。它在 __init__ 里通过 self._extension_handlers 字典把 QWebPage 扩展分发给各自的处理函数。
处理单文件上传: 覆写 QWebPage.chooseFile(self, frame, suggested_file)。用 QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(None, None, suggested_file) 取得文件名。PyQt5 返回 (filename, filter) 元组, 解包后只返回 filename。
处理多文件上传: 在 _extension_handlers 中注册 QWebPage.ChooseMultipleFilesExtension 到新方法 _handle_multiple_files。复用已有的分发机制, 不要另写 extension() 分支。
在 _handle_multiple_files(opt, files) 中, 仿照 _handle_errorpage 的做法: 用 sip.cast 把 opt 转成 QWebPage.ChooseMultipleFilesExtensionOption, 把 files 转成 QWebPage.ChooseMultipleFilesExtensionReturn。
若任一 cast 结果为 None, 回退为 return super().extension(QWebPage.ChooseMultipleFilesExtension, opt, files)。
若 opt.suggestedFileNames 非空, 取其第一个元素作为对话框的初始路径。
调用 QFileDialog.getOpenFileNames(None, None, suggested), 把解包后的列表赋给 files.fileNames, 然后返回 True。
在 webpage.py 中新增 from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QFileDialog。新方法补齐 docstring(Args/Return), 保持仓库 pylint/pep257 风格。
validation: 运行 tox/pylint/flake8 风格检查, 确认无未使用参数和 docstring 告警。
运行现有单元测试, 确认 BrowserPage 构造正常。
手动验证单文件: 打开含 <input type=file> 的页面, 点击后应弹出单文件对话框, 选中的文件能提交。
手动验证多文件: 在含 <input type=file multiple> 的页面上能多选文件; 取消对话框时上传列表为空且不崩溃。
通过 supportsExtension 或实际行为确认 ChooseMultipleFilesExtension 已被支持。

name: qutebrowser-raise-commanderror-instead-of-message-error
negative_constraints: 不要在命令函数内部同时调用 message.error 又 raise CommandError,否则同一个错误会显示两次。
不要在调度层用宽泛的 except Exception 捕获,只捕获 CommandError,真实 bug 仍需走 crash handler。
不要只改命令函数而遗漏调度入口的 try/except,否则 CommandError 会变成未捕获异常并让应用崩溃。
不要修改错误消息文本或命令签名(count、参数默认值)。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/browser/curcommand.py 等文件中带 @cmdutils.register 装饰的命令处理函数。在其中找出 `message.error(...)` 后紧跟 `return` 的错误路径。
在命令模块顶部导入 `from qutebrowser.commands.exceptions import CommandError`。
把每对 `message.error(msg); return` 改写为 `raise CommandError(msg)`,错误文本保持原样。例如 'No frame focused!'、'Unknown hinting group {}!'。
处理 try/except AttributeError 包裹的参数查找时,在 except 分支里 raise CommandError,不要静默返回。
底层操作(如 go_back/go_forward)若已在失败时抛出 CommandError,调用方循环就不要再检查返回值后 break,直接调用,让异常传播出去。

确认所有命令调度入口都捕获 CommandError,并转成用户可见的消息。包括 CommandManager 和 app.py 中 QuteBrowser 的 cmd handler 调度(dotted_getattr + handler(*args, count=count))。具体写法是用 `try: handler(...) except CommandError as e: message.error(e)` 包住调用,并在 app.py 中导入 message 和 CommandError。
validation: 运行现有测试(tox/pytest)。
grep 被改动的命令模块,确认已没有残留的 `message.error(...)` 后接 `return` 的模式。
grep `raise CommandError`,确认每个使用它的文件都有对应的 import。
手动触发 :hint invalidgroup 和 :back(无历史时),验证状态栏显示错误且程序不崩溃。

name: qutebrowser-relay-tab-signal-to-statusbar
negative_constraints: 不要直接把每个 tab 的 urlChanged 连接到状态栏，必须经过 _filter_factory 只转发当前 tab，否则后台 tab 会覆盖显示。
不要在 update() 中硬编码字段列表，新增字段只应改 fields。
不要让 __setattr__ 对任意属性都调用 update()，否则初始化顺序问题会导致属性尚未定义就被 getattr。
不要把 QUrl 对象直接拼入文本，会引发 join 类型错误。
procedure: 在 qutebrowser/widgets/browser.py 中找到 TabbedBrowser 的 cur_* pyqtSignal 声明。新增 cur_<thing>_changed 信号，参数类型与 QWebView 原生信号一致，例如 pyqtSignal('QUrl')。
在 TabbedBrowser 创建 tab 的代码处，用 tab.<nativeSignal>.connect(self._filter_factory(self.cur_<thing>_changed)) 转发信号。复用 _filter_factory，确保只有当前 tab 的信号会被发出。
在 qutebrowser/widgets/mainwindow.py 的 MainWindow 中，与其它 self.tabs.cur_* 连接并列，增加 self.tabs.cur_<thing>_changed.connect(self.status.txt.set_<thing>)。
在 qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar.py 的 Text(QLabel) 中做三件事：新增类属性默认值 <thing> = ''；把它加入有序列表 fields，列表顺序即显示顺序；新增 set_<thing>(self, s) 作为 Qt slot。
set_<thing> 里先把 Qt 对象转换成字符串再赋值。URL 用 qutebrowser.utils.url.urlstring(s)，不要把 QUrl 直接存进去。
把 Text.update 改成按 fields 拼接：' '.join(getattr(self, n) for n in self.fields)，不要手写字段清单。
让 __setattr__ 只在 name in self.fields 时调用 self.update()，避免 QLabel 初始化或其它属性赋值时触发刷新。
validation: 启动 qutebrowser 打开页面，确认状态栏按 fields 顺序显示 keystring、url、error、text、scrollperc。
切换 tab 时，确认显示的是当前 tab 的 URL，后台 tab 导航不改变状态栏。
运行 pylint/flake8，确保新增 import 和 slot 无告警。
运行已有测试（如有）。

name: qutebrowser-release-version-bump
negative_constraints: Do not set `__version__` as a hardcoded string. It must stay derived from `__version_info__`.
Do not change other metadata in the same commit, such as `__copyright__`, `__license__`, `__email__` or `__description__`.
Do not mix functional code changes or bugfixes into the release-bump commit.
Do not skip version components or change the tuple arity. Keep three integers.
procedure: Open qutebrowser/__init__.py and find the `__version_info__` tuple. It is the single source of truth for the version.
Change only the tuple to the new release number. For a patch release, increment the last element, e.g. (0, 1, 2) -> (0, 1, 3).
Keep `__version__ = '.'.join(map(str, __version_info__))` as it is, so the string version is still derived from the tuple.

Search the repository for the old version as a literal string, e.g. `grep -rn "0\.1\.2"`. Check whether setup.py, docs or spec files hardcode it. The release evidence touched only __init__.py, so update other files only if they really contain a hardcoded copy.
Make the release commit with the subject 'Release vX.Y.Z' so it matches the existing convention.
validation: Run `python -c "import qutebrowser; print(qutebrowser.__version__)"` and confirm it prints the new version.
Run `python -m qutebrowser --version` if the environment allows, and check the reported version.
Run the existing test suite or smoke checks to make sure the import still works.
Confirm that `git diff` shows only the `__version_info__` line changed.

name: qutebrowser-remove-passthrough-statusbar-slots
negative_constraints: Do not remove wrappers that carry extra logic. disp_error and clear_error also manage the self.error state, so they must stay.
Do not change the public message.* API (message.info, message.text, message.clear). Only change how it is implemented internally.
Do not leave a declared-but-unused signal like MessageBridge.clear, or a dangling connect() to a deleted slot. PyQt only reports these at runtime.
Do not assign attributes such as txt.temptext directly from outside the widget when a setter slot exists.
procedure: In qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar.py, find StatusBar methods that only forward to a child widget. Typical pattern: a @pyqtSlot that does self.txt.<attr> = text. Find paired clear_* helpers that call the forwarder with ''.
Confirm the child widget (statusbar.txt) already exposes equivalent slots, such as set_temptext and set_normaltext.
If those slots are missing, add them to the child widget instead of keeping the wrappers.
Rewire every signal connection in qutebrowser/app.py straight to the child slots, for example message.bridge.info.connect(self.mainwindow.status.txt.set_temptext).
Remove 'clear' signals that only existed to feed a clear slot. Replace them by emitting the value signal with an empty string, e.g. message.clear() -> bridge.text.emit('').
Delete the pyqtSignal declaration from MessageBridge.
Replace internal callers of the removed wrappers with direct child calls, e.g. in keypress: self.txt.set_temptext('') instead of self.clear_tmp_text().
Delete the wrapper methods together with their docstrings.
Grep the whole package for each removed name (disp_tmp_text, clear_tmp_text, disp_text, clear_text, bridge.clear). Fix any remaining references.
validation: grep -rn 'disp_tmp_text\|clear_tmp_text\|disp_text\|clear_text\|bridge.clear' qutebrowser/ returns nothing
python -m pyflakes / pylint qutebrowser
Launch qutebrowser and check that message.info shows temporary text, a keypress clears it (modifier-only presses do not), and message.text/message.clear set and clear persistent text.
run existing tests

name: qutebrowser-remove-stale-fixme-comment
negative_constraints: 不要借删除 FIXME 的机会实现注释里提到的替代方案(如改用 QKeySequence.matches), 这会把纯注释清理变成行为变更。
不要修改 docstring、日志格式或按键处理逻辑。
不要删除同文件中其他仍有效的 FIXME/TODO, 除非任务明确要求。
不要为纯注释删除添加测试或 changelog 条目, 维护面仅限 code。
procedure: 定位目标 FIXME 注释所在的文件和函数。在 qutebrowser 中常见于 qutebrowser/utils/*.py, 例如 keyparser.py 的 KeyParser 按键处理方法。
判断该 FIXME 是否只是推测性的想法(如 'maybe we can do this in an easier way by using X'), 而不是标记已知缺陷。若是, 且维护者已决定不采纳, 直接删除整段注释(包括多行续行)。
只删除注释行。docstring、logging.debug 调用和后续逻辑(如 txt = e.text().strip())保持原样, 不要顺带重构。
确认删除后缩进和空行与周围代码一致: docstring 结束后直接接第一条语句, 不留多余空行。
validation: git diff 只包含被删除的注释行, 没有任何新增行或逻辑变更。
python -m py_compile 或导入该模块, 确认没有引入缩进或语法错误。
如有 pylint/flake8 配置可运行, 检查该文件无新增告警。

name: qutebrowser-rename-slot-update-all-callers
negative_constraints: 不要只修内部调用而遗漏 app.py 中的 .connect() 引用。PyQt 连接到不存在的属性会在启动时抛出 AttributeError。
不要新增一个重复的 set_cmd 包装方法来掩盖命名不一致。
不要改动历史导航逻辑(_histpos/_tmphist 边界)。这个 bug 只是方法名不匹配。
procedure: 定位报错的方法调用。示例: Command.on_key_up_pressed/on_key_down_pressed 调用了不存在的 self.set_cmd。
在类中查找实际存在的等价方法。示例: 带 @pyqtSlot(str) 的 on_set_cmd_text, 它执行 setText+setFocus。
统一为一个规范名称。示例: set_cmd_text。该方法既作为 slot 被外部信号连接, 也被内部直接调用, 因此去掉 on_ 前缀。
全仓 grep 旧名称和断裂名称, 例如 grep -rn 'set_cmd\b\|on_set_cmd_text' qutebrowser/。
同步修改所有调用点。包括 qutebrowser/app.py 中的 signal.connect(...) 连接, 例如 keyparser.set_cmd_text 和 tabs.set_cmd_text → status.cmd.set_cmd_text。也包括 widgets/statusbar.py 内的直接调用。
保留 @pyqtSlot(str) 装饰器和原有方法体, 只做重命名和调用修正。
validation: grep 确认仓库内不再有 on_set_cmd_text 或裸 set_cmd( 的引用
python -m pyflakes 或 pylint 检查 qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar.py 和 qutebrowser/app.py
启动 qutebrowser, 执行 ':' 命令后按 Up/Down, 确认历史条目能填入状态栏且无异常
run existing tests

name: qutebrowser-revert-config-feature-across-layers
negative_constraints: Do not leave orphan setting names in configdata after the type is removed, or the reverse.
Do not keep the QPoint-based scroll math once scrollbars are visible again. It is only needed when the scrollbar policy is AlwaysOff.
Do not blindly take the old side of a conflict. Unrelated edits made after the original commit must survive.
Do not leave unused Qt/QPoint imports. pylint/flake8 will flag them.
procedure:
From the reverted commit, list every touched layer:
- config type in qutebrowser/config/_conftypes.py (e.g. ScrollBarPolicy)
- setting entries in qutebrowser/config/configdata.py DATA (e.g. show-scroll-bar-horizontal/vertical)
- consumers in qutebrowser/widgets/webview.py (setScrollBarPolicy calls, config-changed handlers)
- signal wiring in qutebrowser/widgets/_tabbedbrowser.py
- command logic in qutebrowser/browser/commands.py

Delete the setting entries from configdata.DATA.
- Delete the BaseType subclass from _conftypes.
- Remove any imports that only the deleted code used (e.g. Qt in _conftypes).

Find webview and tabbedbrowser code that reads the removed setting or reacts to its changes.
- Remove it, or restore the pre-feature version, including the config-changed handlers.

Restore commands.py logic that was changed only because the feature existed.
- Example: _scroll_percent goes back from manual contentsSize/geometry/setScrollPosition(QPoint) math to frame.scrollBarMaximum(orientation).
- Keep the early return when the max is 0.
- Use frame.setScrollBarValue(orientation, int(m * perc / 100)).
- Drop the now-unused QPoint import.

Resolve merge conflicts in favour of the current code around the hunks.
- Revert only the feature-specific lines.
- Do not roll back unrelated later changes in the same files.
validation: Run: grep -r 'show-scroll-bar\|ScrollBarPolicy\|setScrollBarPolicy' qutebrowser/ (expect no hits).
Run the existing tests and pyflakes/pylint on the touched files.
Smoke test: start qutebrowser with an existing config containing the old keys and confirm it starts cleanly.
Run :scroll-perc 0/50/100 on a short page and on a long page, horizontally and vertically, and check the results.

name: qutebrowser-rewrap-long-docstring-and-string-lines
negative_constraints: Do not change the wording, punctuation or meaning of docstrings or setting descriptions. Fix pre-existing typos like `cmd-tag-bg` only in a separate change.
Do not add `# pylint: disable=line-too-long` or noqa markers instead of rewrapping.
Do not reformat unrelated lines or whole files.
Do not change code logic, signatures or string values.
When splitting concatenated strings, do not drop or duplicate the separating space.
procedure: Run the project's linters (pylint/flake8 via the repo's tox/run_checks setup) to find lines over the configured max length (79 chars) in qutebrowser/*.py.
For docstring prose, including command docstrings in browser/commands.py, move the last word(s) onto the next line. Keep the paragraph's existing indentation.

For bulleted arg lists inside docstrings (e.g. `- `cmd-tab`: ...`), indent continuation lines to align under the bullet text, matching the sibling bullets. Rewrap each bullet on its own; do not merge lines from neighbouring bullets.

For implicitly concatenated string literals inside tuples or calls (e.g. ValidValues in config/conftypes.py), split at a word boundary. Keep the trailing space at the end of the first fragment. Align the second fragment's opening quote with the first fragment's opening quote.
Read the rejoined text and check that the wording is byte-identical apart from the whitespace at the split point. These docstrings and strings feed generated docs and :help output.
validation: Re-run pylint/flake8 line-length checks on the touched files and confirm there are no new or remaining violations.
Run the existing tests, especially config and commands tests, to confirm nothing changed behaviourally.
Optionally regenerate the docs (e.g. the asciidoc generation script) and diff the output: the text should be unchanged except for whitespace normalization.

name: qutebrowser-scroll-pos-via-painteevent-not-scrollrequested
negative_constraints: Do not rely on QWebPage::scrollRequested to track scroll position. It never fires on some pages, such as Twitter and blog.fdik.org.
Do not emit scroll_pos_changed on every paint. Compare against `_old_scroll_pos` first, because paint events are very frequent.
Do not skip `super().paintEvent(e)`.
Do not divide by the scrollbar maximum when it is 0.
Do not keep both mechanisms (signal and paintEvent) at once, since that duplicates emissions.
procedure: Open qutebrowser/browser/webview.py and find the WebView class. Locate the scroll-position tracking: the `_old_scroll_pos` / `scroll_pos` attributes and the `scroll_pos_changed` signal.

If tracking hangs off `page.scrollRequested` (for example `on_scroll_requested` deferring to `update_scroll_perc` via `QTimer.singleShot`), remove it completely. Remove the `scrollRequested.connect` call in `__init__`. Remove the one-time initial `self.on_scroll_requested()` call. Remove both slots.
Override `paintEvent(self, e)` on WebView. Read `frame = self.page().mainFrame()` and build `new_pos` from `scrollBarValue(Qt.Horizontal)` and `scrollBarValue(Qt.Vertical)`.
Emit only when `new_pos != self._old_scroll_pos`. In that case update `_old_scroll_pos`, compute the percentage for each axis as `round(100 * pos / max)`, and use 0 when max is 0.
Assign the result to `self.scroll_pos` and emit `self.scroll_pos_changed.emit(*perc)`.
Always finish with `super().paintEvent(e)` so normal rendering still happens.
Put a docstring on the override saying it is a deliberate hack: it relies on a repaint happening on every scroll, because `scrollRequested` is unreliable (QTBUG-43521).
Check whether `QTimer` is still used elsewhere in the file. Remove the import only if nothing else uses it.
validation: Run the existing test suite and the linters (pylint/flake8) to catch unused imports such as QTimer.
Manually scroll Twitter or another dynamic page and check that the statusbar percentage updates.
Check that a non-scrollable page shows 0% with no ZeroDivisionError.

name: qutebrowser-split-false-flag-arg-maxsplit
negative_constraints: 不要把所有 flag 都计入 maxsplit 偏移，只计入需要值的 flag，否则布尔 flag 会导致多切一次。
不要只修改 runners.py 而硬编码 flag 名，必须从 Command 的签名检查结果中派生 flags_with_args。
不要在 _inspect_func 之后才初始化 flags_with_args，否则在检查签名时追加会失败。
不要改变 split=True 命令的解析行为。
procedure: 先在 qutebrowser/commands/command.py 的 Command 中确认哪些参数会生成带值的 flag：_inspect_func / _get_arg_names 中进入 opt_args 分支、且 param.kind == inspect.Parameter.KEYWORD_ONLY 的参数需要一个值。普通布尔 flag 不需要值。
在 Command.__init__ 中，在 _inspect_func() 调用之前初始化公共属性 flags_with_args = []，并在类 docstring 的 Attributes 部分写明该属性。
在添加 opt_args 的分支里，当 param.kind 是 KEYWORD_ONLY 时，把 param.name 追加到 flags_with_args。
在 qutebrowser/commands/runners.py 的 CommandRunner 中，找到 split=False 路径里逐个遍历 simple_split(argstr) 结果的循环。
在循环中增加计数器 flag_arg_count。遇到以 '-' 开头的 token 时，如果 arg.lstrip('-') 在 self._cmd.flags_with_args 中，就把 flag_arg_count 加 1。
遇到第一个非 '-' 开头的 token 时，用 maxsplit = i + self._cmd.maxsplit + flag_arg_count 重新调用 simple_split。这样 flag 的值会作为独立 token 保留，不会被并入最终的剩余文本参数。
其余去引号和反斜杠处理逻辑保持不变。
validation: 运行现有测试：pytest tests/ -k 'command or runner'。
手动验证一个 maxsplit=0 且带 keyword-only 值 flag 的命令，例如 ':cmd --flag val some text with spaces'：flag 应得到 'val'，剩余文本应完整为 'some text with spaces'。
验证只带布尔 flag 的 split=False 命令，确认切分次数未变。

name: qutebrowser-split-parsers-out-of-cmdutils-to-break-import-cycle
negative_constraints: 不要在 cmdutils 里给 CommandParser/SearchParser 留 re-export 或别名, 否则循环依赖会重新出现。
不要把 import 移进函数体内部当作首选修法。应先通过模块拆分让依赖保持单向: exceptions <- utils <- parsers <- app/keys。
不要让 qutebrowser/commands/exceptions.py import 任何 qutebrowser 内部模块。
不要借机修改 parser 的行为、信号签名 (例如 do_search(str, 'QWebPage::FindFlags')) 或解析逻辑。这里只是代码搬迁。
procedure: 定位循环: 找出哪个模块既被 command-registry 模块 (qutebrowser/commands/utils.py, 即 cmdutils) import, 又在模块层 import 它。典型情况是 parser 类需要 config 和 cmdutils.cmd_dict, 而 config、widgets 或其他模块又 import cmdutils 来注册命令。

把 consumer 类 (CommandParser、SearchParser) 搬到一个新的叶子模块 qutebrowser/commands/parsers.py。该模块可以安全地 import qutebrowser.config.config、qutebrowser.commands.utils as cmdutils 以及 qutebrowser.commands.exceptions, 因为没有任何底层模块会 import 它。
cmdutils 只保留命令注册相关内容 (cmd_dict、register 装饰器)。注册代码不能反过来 import parsers。
共享的异常类 (ArgumentCountError、NoSuchCommandError) 放在 qutebrowser/commands/exceptions.py。这个模块不 import 其他内部模块。parsers 和 utils 都从这里 import 异常。如果模块 docstring 只提到旧模块, 改成泛指 'commands modules'。
更新所有使用方的 import 指向新模块: app.py 改为 'from qutebrowser.commands.parsers import CommandParser, SearchParser', 并把 cmdutils.CommandParser() 换成 CommandParser()。keys.py 的 import 也改为从 parsers 引入。
用 grep 查找 'cmdutils.CommandParser'、'cmdutils.SearchParser'、'commands.utils import (CommandParser' 等残留引用, 并全部替换。
validation: 分别对每个模块执行 python -c 'import qutebrowser.commands.parsers'、'import qutebrowser.commands.keys' 和 'import qutebrowser.app', 确认不出现 ImportError 或 partially-initialized module 错误。
启动 qutebrowser, 确认 commandparser 和 searchparser 能正常构造, ':' 命令和 '/' 搜索都正常工作。
如果仓库配置了 pylint/flake8, 运行它们, 确认没有 unused-import 或 cyclic-import 告警。
grep 确认代码库中已无 cmdutils.CommandParser 或 cmdutils.SearchParser 引用。

name: qutebrowser-split-statusbar-into-widgets
negative_constraints: Do not leave any signal connected to a removed method on status.txt. Missing slots only fail at runtime with an AttributeError during startup.
Do not keep self.hbox as a public attribute when it is used only during construction.
Do not drop paintEvent from a plain QWidget subclass that relies on stylesheets. Without it, background colors do not render.
Do not reorder or remove the cmd and prog widgets. Other code connects to status.cmd and status.prog.
procedure: Locate the StatusBar class in qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar.py. Find the single text widget (Text) that formats several pieces of info into one string: message, keystring, URL and scroll percentage.

Create a small dedicated widget class for each piece of info, e.g. KeyString, Url and Percentage. Base them on QLabel. Keep the formatting logic inside each class, e.g. set_perc, set_url and set_hover_url.
Declare the new widgets as class attributes initialized to None (keystring, url, percentage) next to cmd, txt and prog.

Build the layout in __init__ with a local QHBoxLayout instead of self.hbox. Call setContentsMargins(0,0,0,0) and a non-zero setSpacing. Add widgets in this order: cmd, txt, addStretch(), keystring, url, percentage, prog. This keeps the right-aligned items grouped.

If the QWidget subclass needs stylesheet backgrounds, override paintEvent. Use QStyleOption.initFrom(self), then QPainter, then self.style().drawPrimitive(QStyle.PE_Widget, option, painter, self). Add QStyle, QStyleOption and QPainter to the imports.

Grep all consumers of the old aggregated API, e.g. status.txt.set_keystring, set_perc, set_url and set_hover_url. Look at least in app.py and widgets/mainwindow.py. Reconnect each signal to the new widget's slot, e.g. keystring_updated -> status.keystring.setText and cur_scroll_perc_changed -> status.percentage.set_perc.
Wherever the remaining Text widget only displays a plain message, connect the signal straight to QLabel.setText instead of a custom setter.
validation: grep -rn 'status\.txt\.' qutebrowser/ and confirm that only the methods that still exist are referenced
Launch qutebrowser. Check that keystrings, the URL, hover URLs and the scroll percentage each show in their own label on the right of the statusbar.
Run pylint/flake8 on the changed files to catch unused imports or attributes.

name: qutebrowser-split-widget-module-into-package
negative_constraints: Do not change behavior, names, signal signatures or stylesheet contents while splitting. Do only the pure move.
Do not leave the old statusbar.py alongside the new statusbar/ package.
Do not forget statusbar/__init__.py.
Do not create circular imports. Child widget files must not import the StatusBar container module. They receive the bar as a constructor argument instead.
Do not leave unused or missing imports, for example QCompleter or QValidator ending up in the wrong file.
procedure: Locate the monolithic widget module, e.g. qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar.py. Identify every class in it: StatusBar, StatusCommand, StatusText, StatusProgress, plus any validator or completer helpers.
Create a package directory with the same name, qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar/, and give it an __init__.py. Without __init__.py the package cannot be imported.
Put the container class in statusbar/statusbar.py. Move each child widget class into its own sibling file, such as command.py, text.py and progress.py.

Keep each class body unchanged during the move. This includes class-level attributes, the _stylesheet strings with doubled {{ }} braces for str.format, __setattr__ restyling, sizeHint/minimumSizeHint, and the signal and slot definitions.

Trim each new file's imports to only the PyQt5 names that file uses. In the container file, add explicit imports for the child classes, e.g. 'from qutebrowser.widgets.statusbar.command import StatusCommand'.
Delete the old statusbar.py. If it stays next to the statusbar/ package, the name is ambiguous.

Grep the whole repository for every import of the old module path, e.g. 'from qutebrowser.widgets.statusbar import' and 'widgets.statusbar.'. Update each one to the new submodule path, e.g. in mainwindow.py use 'from qutebrowser.widgets.statusbar.statusbar import StatusBar'.

Search for attribute references that cross into other modules, such as signal connections like bar.cmd.got_cmd and bar.prog.set_progress in app.py or browser.py. Make sure those attributes still exist under the same names.
validation: Run python -c 'import qutebrowser.widgets.mainwindow' and python -c 'from qutebrowser.widgets.statusbar.statusbar import StatusBar'.
grep -rn 'widgets.statusbar import StatusBar' and confirm it returns no matches for the old path.
Launch the app. Check that the statusbar renders, the command line accepts input, the progress bar shows while a page loads, and errors turn the bar red.
Run pyflakes or pylint on the new package to catch missing or unused imports.

name: qutebrowser-startup-positional-args-commands-and-urls
negative_constraints: Do not open default tabs inside widget constructors (TabbedBrowser.__init__). Initial content is application-startup policy and belongs in app.py.
Do not read `self.args.url`. With two consecutive nargs='*' positionals, argparse puts everything into the first one.
Do not process startup args before mainwindow, commandparser and config are initialized.
Do not open the start page when the user passed explicit URLs.
Do not open the start page just because commands were passed. Commands alone still get the start page.
Do not pass the leading ':' to commandparser.run.
procedure: In qutebrowser/app.py, find `_parseopts` (the argparse setup in the QuteBrowser QApplication subclass).
Add a single positional argument that collects every startup argument: `parser.add_argument('command', nargs='*', metavar=':command', help=...)`.

If you also want URLs shown in --help, add a second positional `url` with nargs='*'. Comment that argparse will put all values into `command`, so `url` exists only for the help text and is never read.
Add a `_process_init_args` method on QuteBrowser. Iterate over `self.args.command`.
For an entry that starts with ':', strip the colon and run it with `self.commandparser.run(e.lstrip(':'))`.
For any other entry, treat it as a URL and open it with `self.mainwindow.tabs.tabopen(e)`. Record that a URL was opened.
Log each case with `logging.debug` (startup cmd / startup url).
If no URL was opened, open the start page instead. Read it with `config.config.get('general', 'startpage', fallback=...)`, split on ',', and call tabopen once per URL.
Call `_process_init_args()` at the end of `__init__`, after `self.mainwindow.show()` and `_python_hacks()`. The commandparser, tabs and config must already exist at that point.
Remove any hardcoded initial `tabopen(QUrl(...))` from the `TabbedBrowser.__init__` widget constructor.
Drop any imports that become unused, such as `QUrl` in widgets/browser.py.
Add a `startpage = ...` default to the `[general]` section of `default_config` in qutebrowser/utils/config.py. Keep the code fallback consistent with that default.
validation: Run `python -m qutebrowser --help` and check that the :command and url positionals are listed.
Launch with no args and check that the configured startpage opens (comma-separated values open multiple tabs).
Launch with `http://example.com` and check that only that tab opens, with no start page.
Launch with `:open http://example.com`, or another registered command, and check that the command runs and the start page also opens.
Run pyflakes/pylint to confirm no unused imports (e.g. QUrl) remain.

name: qutebrowser-statusbar-as-styled-qwidget
negative_constraints: Do not call setStyleSheet on a QLayout subclass. Layouts are not widgets and cannot be styled.
Do not parent the status child widgets to the main window's central widget. That bypasses the StatusBar container and its stylesheet inheritance.
Do not leave addLayout(self.status) after StatusBar becomes a QWidget. Use addWidget.
Do not repeat background, color or font settings on each child widget. Keep them in the container's stylesheet.
procedure: Locate the StatusBar class in qutebrowser/widgets.py. Check whether it subclasses a layout (QHBoxLayout). A layout cannot hold a stylesheet or a background, so this is the cause of the styling bug.
Change StatusBar to subclass QWidget. Keep setObjectName(self.__class__.__name__).
Create an internal layout owned by the widget: self.hbox = QHBoxLayout(self). Give it an object name such as 'status_hbox'. Call setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0) and setSpacing(0) on it.
Construct the child widgets StatusCommand and StatusText with self (the StatusBar) as parent, not the outer parent. Add them through self.hbox.addWidget(...).
Put the shared style on the container in one helper, e.g. bg_color(color). It applies a '* { background: ...; color: white; font-family: Monospace; }' stylesheet so every child inherits it.
Reduce each child's own stylesheet to local tweaks only. Give QLineEdit 'border: 0px; padding-left: 1px' and QLabel 'padding-right: 1px'. Remove the placeholder yellow backgrounds.
In qutebrowser/app.py, add the status bar with vbox.addWidget(self.status) instead of addLayout.
Call setCentralWidget(cwidget) before building the vbox. Set the vbox margins and spacing to 0 so the statusbar sits flush with the tabs and window edges.
validation: Run the application (python -m qutebrowser or the app entry point). Confirm the statusbar shows a black background, white monospace text and no yellow.
Check that the statusbar has no visible margins or gaps relative to the tab widget and the window edges.
Check that the command line edit shows no border and that the label text 'Hello World' renders on the right.
Run any existing tests or a lint/import check so widgets.py imports QWidget correctly.

name: qutebrowser-statusbar-command-fixme-annotation
negative_constraints: 不要在只要求加 FIXME 的任务里顺手实现修复, 例如重写 event() 或 focusNextPrevChild。
不要修改类属性、__init__ 签名或已有逻辑。
不要为纯注释改动添加测试或 changelog 条目。
不要把 FIXME 放到无关模块, 它必须紧挨着受影响的类。
procedure: 定位问题所在的具体 widget 类, 例如 qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar/command.py 中的 Command(QLineEdit)。
在类体内与该问题相关的位置加 '# FIXME' 注释。注释放在类属性(_tmphist/_histpos)之后、__init__ 之前, 说明疑似问题, 例如: Tab 键是否会被 Qt 焦点链吞掉并切换到下一个 widget。
如果已知可能的修复思路或外部参考(例如通过重写 event()/keyPressEvent 捕获 Qt.Key_Tab 的方案), 用后续注释行附上链接或简述。
整个改动只限于注释, 不改动任何运行时行为。
validation: 确认 diff 只包含新增的注释行 (git diff --stat 显示单个文件、只有新增)。
运行 python -m py_compile qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar/command.py, 确认模块仍能导入。
如果项目配置了 pylint/flake8, 运行一遍, 确认长 URL 注释行没有引入新的 line-too-long 问题; 必要时把 URL 单独放一行。

name: qutebrowser-statusbar-command-prefix-validator
negative_constraints: Do not return a bare state enum from validate. PyQt5 needs the (state, string, pos) tuple.
Do not use QValidator.Intermediate for strings without ':'. That lets users delete the prefix, which is the bug being fixed.
Do not move the prefix check into process_cmd or a keyPressEvent override when a validator is enough.
Do not change the got_cmd signal contract. Emitted text must still have the ':' stripped.
Do not add a separate module for a few lines of validator code. Keep it next to StatusCommand in statusbar.py.
procedure: Open qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar.py and find the StatusCommand(QLineEdit) class. This is where the command input box is defined.
Treat the input rule as an input constraint, not a check on submit. Do not change process_cmd. It already calls lstrip(':') and emits got_cmd.
Add `from PyQt5.QtGui import QValidator` to the imports. Keep it grouped with the existing PyQt5 imports.
In the same file, add a validator class, for example CmdValidator(QValidator). Its validate(self, string, pos) method returns a 3-tuple (state, string, pos), which is the PyQt5 signature.
If string starts with ':', return QValidator.Acceptable. Otherwise return QValidator.Invalid. Qt then blocks any edit that would remove or replace the leading ':'.
In StatusCommand.__init__, call self.setValidator(CmdValidator()) after the style setup and before the returnPressed connection.
Check other code that calls setText on the widget. Text set programmatically with setText must also start with ':'. If such text would be rejected, adjust those callers.
validation: Run the existing tests if there are any. Also check that `python -c 'import qutebrowser.widgets.statusbar'` imports cleanly.
Launch the browser, focus the status command line, and type ':open foo'. The text should be accepted, and got_cmd should emit 'open foo'.
Try to backspace or select-delete the leading ':', and try typing text without ':'. The edit should be rejected.
Check that setText('') after processing a command still behaves as intended under the validator. setText bypasses validation, so confirm what the empty state looks like.

name: qutebrowser-statusbar-elided-label
negative_constraints: 不要只调用 setText 写入省略后的字符串。那样会丢失原文,导致后续 text() 返回截断值、resize 后也无法恢复。应保留原文,只在绘制时使用省略版本。
不要只在 setText 时计算省略文本。窗口 resize 时也必须重新计算。
不要在 ElideNone 模式下绕过 QLabel 的原生绘制。
不要对 URL 使用 ElideRight,否则会隐藏路径尾部的重要信息。
不要在每次 paintEvent 中重复调用 elidedText。应在 setText 和 resize 时更新缓存。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar.py 中的 TextBase(QLabel)。它是所有状态栏文本控件(Text, Url 等)的公共基类,在这里实现省略逻辑,不要在每个子类里分别处理。
给 TextBase.__init__ 增加 elidemode 参数,默认值为 Qt.ElideRight,并存为实例属性。同时增加一个 _elided_text 缓存。
重写 setText:先调用 super().setText(txt),再用当前 geometry().width() 重新计算省略后的文本。
重写 resizeEvent:先调用 super().resizeEvent(e),再用 e.size().width() 重新计算省略后的文本。文本或宽度任一变化都要刷新缓存。
把计算逻辑集中在 _update_elided_text(width) 中:调用 self.fontMetrics().elidedText(self.text(), self.elidemode, width, Qt.TextShowMnemonic)。
重写 paintEvent:当 elidemode == Qt.ElideNone 时回退到 super().paintEvent(e)。其他情况用 QPainter(self) 和 drawText(0, 0, w, h, self.alignment(), self._elided_text) 绘制缓存的文本,以保留对齐方式。
对 URL 类控件,在子类 Url 中重写 __init__,把默认值改为 elidemode=Qt.ElideMiddle,使协议/域名和路径尾部都保持可见。
确认 QPainter 已从 PyQt5.QtGui 导入。
把 StatusBar 中现已解决的 FIXME 注释删除,并在 TextBase 的 docstring 中说明省略行为和参考来源。
validation: 运行现有测试套件和 pylint/flake8,检查 statusbar.py 是否有未导入的 QPainter 或 Qt。
手动启动 qutebrowser,打开很长的 URL,确认状态栏 URL 在中间显示为 '…',且两端保持可见。
缩小窗口宽度,确认文本在 resize 后重新省略;放大窗口后完整文本恢复。
设置长状态消息,确认右侧显示省略号,且对齐方式与原 QLabel 一致。

name: qutebrowser-statusbar-fixed-height-sizing
negative_constraints: Do not compute a child widget's sizeHint or minimumSizeHint from the parent statusbar's current size. It causes resize loops and wrong heights.
Do not give children QSizePolicy.Fixed vertically together with a hand-made height. Use Ignored vertically so the container's fixed height wins.
Do not hardcode colors in the stylesheet. Keep using the config.colordict placeholders and config.get_stylesheet.
Do not drop the resized signal emission from resizeEvent. Other widgets, such as the completion popup, rely on it.
procedure: Locate the StatusBar container in qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar/__init__.py and its children: command.py (QLineEdit), progress.py (QProgressBar), text.py (QLabel).
Let the container own the bar height. Put font-size (e.g. 8pt) and an explicit height (e.g. 13px) in the StatusBar._stylesheet template, next to the existing color and font-family placeholders.
Render that template with config.get_stylesheet().
In StatusBar.__init__, call self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Fixed). This makes the bar fill the width but keeps its vertical size fixed.
Make the setSizePolicy call before the QHBoxLayout is built. Keep the layout's contentsMargins and spacing at 0.
In child widgets, remove sizeHint and minimumSizeHint overrides that read self.statusbar.size(). These create a feedback loop between the parent's size and the child's hint.
Instead, give each such child a policy whose vertical part is Ignored. For example, Progress uses QSizePolicy.Fixed horizontally and QSizePolicy.Ignored vertically, so it follows the parent's height.
Delete imports that become unused, such as QSize, and add the QSizePolicy import where it is now needed.

Make per-widget inline stylesheets well-formed by ending each declaration with ';', e.g. 'border: 0px; padding-left: 1px;'. Stylesheets get concatenated or cascaded, so a missing semicolon can break them.
Keep StatusBar.resizeEvent calling super(), then emitting the resized signal. Update its docstring to say it extends the base method rather than overriding it.
validation: Run the existing tests and pylint/flake8 to catch unused imports such as QSize.
Launch qutebrowser manually and confirm the statusbar has a constant small height while the window is resized.
Trigger a page load and confirm the progress bar shows inside the bar without growing it, then hides when loading finishes.
Focus the command line and type, and confirm the bar height does not change.

name: qutebrowser-statusbar-layout-stretch-removal
negative_constraints: Do not add a replacement addStretch/addSpacing elsewhere in _hbox. That would bring back the same space-stealing behaviour.
Do not change the order in which keystring/percentage/progress/url widgets are added. That would move indicators users rely on.
Do not touch _stack contents, the _hide_cmd_widget/_show_cmd_widget logic, or the statusbar color stylesheets as part of this fix.
Do not add tests or changelog entries just for this. The gold maintenance surface is code only.
procedure: Locate StatusBar.__init__ in qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar.py and find the self._hbox construction sequence: the _stack (QStackedLayout holding the command/text widgets) is added first, then the right-hand widgets (keystring, percentage, progress, url…).
Identify the self._hbox.addStretch() that sits between self._hbox.addLayout(self._stack) and the right-hand widgets. It takes up the free space, so the stacked command/text area cannot expand.

Remove that stretch. The upstream patch commented it out. Prefer deleting the line, or comment it out to match the upstream minimal change. With the stretch gone, the _stack layout expands and the right-hand widgets stay packed to the right.

Check that the widgets inside _stack (command input and text) use an expanding horizontal size policy. That lets them fill the space the stretch used to take. Do not add a new stretch elsewhere to compensate.
Keep the change to the layout line only. Do not reorder addWidget calls and do not change signals or slots.
validation: Run the existing test suite / pylint / flake8 for qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar.py. Make sure there are no unused-variable or syntax issues, and no leftover commented code flagged by the lint config.
Launch qutebrowser and press ':'. The command line should span the available statusbar width up to the right-hand indicators.
Visually check that the keystring, percentage, progress and url widgets are still shown, right-aligned after the expanding command/text area.
Switch between command mode and normal text display. Both stacked widgets should resize consistently.

name: qutebrowser-statusbar-message-channel-split
negative_constraints: Do not reuse cur_statusbar_message for transient feedback; it represents page-provided status text and will be overwritten or will overwrite it.
Do not leave the command widget as the default visible stack item; idle state must show text.
Do not connect signals to slots that were removed in the refactor (e.g. status.disp_tmp_text); PyQt fails at connect time with AttributeError.
Do not let docstring signal names drift from the actual pyqtSignal attribute names.
procedure: Locate the signal emitters in qutebrowser/widgets/browser.py. Find every place in TabbedBrowser that emits cur_statusbar_message. Decide which kind each message is: persistent page text from the WebView statusBarMessage, or short-lived user feedback such as 'URL yanked to ...'.

When a temporary message channel is needed, add a dedicated pyqtSignal(str) to TabbedBrowser (e.g. cur_temp_message). Document it in the class docstring's Signals section. Make sure the docstring name matches the signal attribute name, because this PR's docstring says cur_tmp_message while the code says cur_temp_message.
Switch transient-feedback emitters (cur_yank, cur_yank_title, etc.) to the temp signal. Update their 'Emit:' docstrings to name the new signal, replacing stale names like disp_tmp_message.

In qutebrowser/widgets/mainwindow.py, connect each tab signal directly to its matching setter on the status text widget. Connect cur_statusbar_message to status.txt.set_normaltext and cur_temp_message to status.txt.set_temptext. Errors go to the error setter. Do not route everything through a single disp_tmp_text.
In qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar.py, give the _Text widget separate normal, error and temp text slots with a clear precedence for what is displayed.
In statusbar.py, drive command-widget visibility from the command widget's own show_cmd and hide_cmd signals, connected to _show_cmd_widget and _hide_cmd_widget on the QStackedLayout.
In statusbar.py, call _hide_cmd_widget() at the end of __init__ so the idle state shows the text widget rather than the command line.
Remove or redirect the old combined slot (disp_tmp_text). Grep for every remaining caller so nothing connects to a deleted slot.
validation: Run python -c 'import qutebrowser.widgets.mainwindow' (or start the app) to catch broken signal connections.
grep -rn 'disp_tmp\|cur_statusbar_message\|cur_temp_message' qutebrowser/ to verify every emitter and connection uses the intended channel.
Manually: start the browser and confirm the statusbar shows text, not an empty command line, when idle.
Manually: yank a URL and confirm a temporary message appears.
Manually: press ':' and confirm the command line appears, then press Esc and confirm the text view returns.

name: qutebrowser-statusbar-message-signal-consolidation
negative_constraints: 不要保留两类并行的文本信号,也不要保留多种文本分类(普通/临时/错误各自一个 setter)。
不要让 app.py 或 mainwindow.py 直接操作 status.txt 等子控件,应通过 StatusBar 的公开 slot 访问。
不要只删信号声明而遗漏 docstring 或 connect,否则会在运行时触发 AttributeError。
不要把 Command 和文本控件并排放进布局,两者应互斥地放在 QStackedWidget 中。
procedure: 定位重复的状态栏文本通路。TabbedBrowser 上同时存在 disp_tmp_msg 和 cur_statusbar_message 两个信号时,把它们合并成一个。保留 cur_statusbar_message,删除 disp_tmp_msg。
删除 disp_tmp_msg 时同步改三处:pyqtSignal 声明、类 docstring 的 Signals 段落、mainwindow.py 中的 connect 语句。
把 TabbedBrowser 内所有 disp_tmp_msg.emit 调用改为 cur_statusbar_message.emit,例如 cur_yank 和 cur_yank_title。
在 StatusBar 上提供公开方法 disp_tmp_text 和 clear_tmp_text。外部组件只连接这两个方法,不要再直接访问 status.txt 内部控件。
在 StatusBar 内部用 QStackedWidget 放置 Command 输入框和文本控件。显示临时文本时切换到文本页;进入命令输入时切换到 cmd 页。
更新所有连接点:mainwindow.py 中 cur_statusbar_message 连到 status.disp_tmp_text;app.py 中 tabs.keypress 连到 status.clear_tmp_text。
全局 grep 旧名(disp_tmp_msg、txt.disp_tmp、txt.clear_tmp、txt.setText),确认没有残留引用。
validation: 运行现有测试和 pylint/flake8,确认没有未定义的属性。
grep -r 'disp_tmp_msg\|txt\.disp_tmp\|txt\.clear_tmp' qutebrowser/ 应无结果。
手动验证:执行 yank 后状态栏显示 'URL yanked to clipboard';按任意键后文本被清除;按 ':' 后切换到命令输入框,按 Esc 后焦点回到 tabs。

name: qutebrowser-statusbar-mode-color-via-qt-property
negative_constraints: Do not set colors directly via setPalette or an inline hardcoded stylesheet. Always go through the config color key and get_stylesheet, so the user can configure the color.
Do not put the new property field only in __init__. pyqtProperty needs the class attribute.
Do not forget to re-apply the stylesheet in the setter. Qt will not restyle a widget when only a dynamic property changes.
Do not tie the color to the passthrough text branch. Insert mode coloring must work whether or not the mode is in passthrough.
Do not add the new color key under a different section or naming scheme. Keep `statusbar.bg.*` naming so the config reference and stylesheet lookup stay consistent.
procedure: Locate the existing state-driven coloring pattern in qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar/bar.py. Its reference implementations are `_error`, `_prompt_active`, the `prompt_active` pyqtProperty, and the `QWidget#StatusBar[prompt_active="true"]` selector in STYLESHEET.

In qutebrowser/config/configdata.py, add a new `statusbar.bg.<state>` entry inside the 'colors' section, next to `statusbar.bg.prompt`. Use `SettingValue(types.Color(), '<default>')` plus a one-line description. In the evidence the entry is `statusbar.bg.insert` with default `darkgreen`.

Declare the backing field `_<state>_active = False` as a class attribute of StatusBar, not in __init__. pyqtProperty needs it at class level to work. Document it in the class docstring's Attributes section, following the `_prompt_active` wording.

Add a STYLESHEET rule `QWidget#StatusBar[<state>_active="true"] {{ {color[statusbar.bg.<state>]} }}`. Place it after the error and prompt rules and before the generic `QWidget {{ ... }}` block. The braces are doubled because the template goes through `.format` in get_stylesheet.

Add a getter decorated with `@pyqtProperty(bool)` that carries `# pylint: disable=method-hidden`. Add a setter that assigns the field and then calls `self.setStyleSheet(get_stylesheet(self.STYLESHEET))`, so that Qt re-evaluates the property selectors.

Hook the state into the mode signals. In `on_mode_entered`, add `if mode == '<mode>': self.<state>_active = True`. In `on_mode_left`, add the matching branch that sets it to False. Keep these as separate `if` checks next to the existing passthrough text handling, not merged into it.
While editing, fix any copy-paste errors in neighbouring docstrings, such as 'self.prompt' versus 'self.prompt_active'.
validation: Run the existing tests and pylint/flake8 on bar.py and configdata.py.
Start qutebrowser, focus an input field to enter insert mode, and confirm the statusbar background turns to the configured color.
Leave insert mode with Esc and confirm the color reverts to normal.
Check that the prompt and error colors still work and take effect in the expected order.
Check that changing `statusbar.bg.insert` in the config applies the new color.

name: qutebrowser-statusbar-progress-widget
negative_constraints: 不要保留 StatusText.set_progress 与 StatusProgress.set_progress 双份实现。进度只应有一个接收端,否则两个控件同时显示进度。
不要只修改 statusbar.py 而忘记 mainwindow.py 的 connect。旧的 self.status.lbl.set_progress 删除后,启动时会抛出 AttributeError。
不要让进度条默认可见。它应在首次收到进度时 show(),避免空闲时占用状态栏空间。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar.py 中的 StatusBar.__init__。它用 self.hbox (QHBoxLayout) 依次 addWidget 子控件,当前包括 StatusCommand 和 StatusText(self.lbl)。
新增一个独立的 StatusProgress(QProgressBar) 类,放在 statusbar.py 中,与 StatusText、StatusCommand 平级。构造函数中调用 super().__init__(parent),并执行 self.setObjectName(self.__class__.__name__),与现有子控件保持一致,便于 stylesheet 选择。
StatusProgress 初始状态调用 self.hide()。它暴露 set_progress(self, prog) 槽,内部依次执行 self.show() 和 self.setValue(prog)。
在 StatusBar.__init__ 中创建 self.prog = StatusProgress(self),并在 self.lbl 之后执行 self.hbox.addWidget(self.prog)。
从 StatusText 中移除 set_progress。StatusText 只负责文本和错误信息,保留 padding stylesheet,不再承担进度显示。
定位 qutebrowser/widgets/mainwindow.py 中的信号连接 self.tabs.cur_progress.connect(...)。把目标改为 self.status.prog.set_progress,保持信号名不变,只更换接收端。
所需的 QtWidgets 类(QProgressBar,以及 QSizePolicy 等)要加入 statusbar.py 顶部已有的 PyQt5.QtWidgets import 行。
validation: 启动 qutebrowser 并加载页面,确认进度条在加载时出现并更新数值,状态栏文本不再显示 'NN%'。
执行 python -c 'import qutebrowser.widgets.statusbar, qutebrowser.widgets.mainwindow',确认无 ImportError 或 NameError。
执行 grep -rn 'lbl.set_progress' qutebrowser/,确认没有残留的旧连接。

name: qutebrowser-statusbar-severity-message-level
negative_constraints: 不要再加一个并列的布尔属性(如 _warning)。多个布尔 Qt property 会造成样式优先级冲突,应使用单一 severity 字符串属性。
不要让 pyqtProperty 直接返回枚举对象。Qt stylesheet 属性选择器只能匹配字符串,必须返回 .name 或空串。
修改 severity 后不要省略重新 setStyleSheet,否则颜色不会刷新。
改名后不要遗留对 error 属性、_error 或 _set_error 的引用,包括 docstring 的 Class attributes 段。
不要硬编码颜色,必须走 configdata 中的 QssColor 设置。
procedure: 在 qutebrowser/mainwindow/statusbar/bar.py 中定位现有的 error 状态。它由 _error 类属性、@pyqtProperty(bool) error 和 _set_error 组成。
把布尔状态改成枚举。在 bar.py 模块级用 usertypes.enum 定义 Severity(normal/warning/error)。类属性改为 _severity = None,并保留在类级别,否则 pyqtProperty 不能正常工作。
把 Qt property 改成 @pyqtProperty(str) severity。getter 在值为 None 时返回空串,否则返回 self._severity.name。保留 '# pylint: disable=method-hidden'。
实现 _set_severity(severity)。赋值后必须重新设置 stylesheet(按 set_register_stylesheet/现有 _set_error 的做法),让 QSS 属性选择器重新求值。
在 STYLESHEET 中把 QWidget#StatusBar[error="true"] 改为 [severity="error"],并新增 [severity="warning"] 规则,引用 {{ color['statusbar.bg.warning'] }}。
在 qutebrowser/config/configdata.py 的 statusbar.bg.error 旁边新增 ('statusbar.bg.warning', SettingValue(typ.QssColor(), 'darkorange'), 说明文字)。保持 OrderedDict 中的相邻顺序。
新增 disp_warning slot,写法参照 disp_error:设置 Severity.warning 并显示文本。同时把所有原先调用 _set_error(True/False) 的地方替换为 _set_severity(Severity.error/normal)。
在 qutebrowser/mainwindow/mainwindow.py 的 messages 连接段,紧挨 s_error 新增 message_bridge.s_warning.connect(status.disp_warning)。同时确认 message bridge 已定义 s_warning 信号,并有对应的 message.warning API。
validation: grep -rn "_set_error\|_error\b\|error=\"true\"" qutebrowser/mainwindow 应无残留。
运行现有测试和 pylint/flake8,确认无 method-hidden 等新告警。
手动调用 message.warning(win_id, 'test'),确认状态栏背景为 darkorange;调用 message.error 时为 red。
确认清除消息或按键后 severity 恢复为 normal,背景恢复默认。

name: qutebrowser-statusbar-state-color-via-qt-property
negative_constraints: Do not set colors directly with setPalette or inline styles. Use the config-driven STYLESHEET with `{color[...]}` placeholders so user config keeps working.
Do not add a new state selector while the base selector is still `[error="false"]`. Base-selector specificity then becomes hard to reason about, and the new state may never show.
Do not forget to re-apply the stylesheet in the setter. Without it the property changes but the color never updates.
Do not leave the flag set on the hide path. Every show must be paired with a reset to False.
Do not reference a color key in STYLESHEET without also adding it to configdata.py. get_stylesheet will fail on the missing key.
procedure: Locate the existing state-coloring pattern in qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar/bar.py. The StatusBar class has a class attribute `_error = False`, an `@pyqtProperty(bool) error` getter/setter, and STYLESHEET selectors of the form `QWidget#StatusBar[error="true"]`.

Add the new color setting in qutebrowser/config/configdata.py under the 'colors' section. Place it next to the related statusbar.bg.* entries. Follow the existing form: `('statusbar.bg.<state>', SettingValue(types.Color(), '<default>'), "Background color of the statusbar if <condition>.")`.

Declare the backing flag as a class attribute, for example `_prompt_active = False`, not as an instance attribute. The existing docstring notes that pyqtProperty only works correctly this way. Add an Attributes docstring entry with that explanation.
Add a `@pyqtProperty(bool)` getter that returns the flag. Include `# pylint: disable=method-hidden` in the getter.
Add a matching setter that assigns the flag and then calls `self.setStyleSheet(get_stylesheet(self.STYLESHEET))`. Qt does not re-evaluate property selectors otherwise.
Change the base selector from `QWidget#StatusBar[error="false"]` to a plain `QWidget#StatusBar`. This lets every state override it.
Append a new `QWidget#StatusBar[<prop>="true"]` block that uses `{color[statusbar.bg.<state>]}`. Put it after the error block so that later selectors win when specificity is equal.

Toggle the property at the existing state transitions. Set it to True in the show handler (for example `_show_prompt_widget`, after it clears `self.error = False`). Set it to False at the start of the hide handler (`_hide_prompt_widget`).
validation: Run the existing test suite and the pylint/flake8 checks used by the repo.

Start qutebrowser and trigger a prompt (for example a yes/no question or a download location). Confirm the statusbar shows the statusbar.bg.prompt color and returns to statusbar.bg when the prompt closes.
Trigger an error message and confirm statusbar.bg.error still applies and the error state is cleared when a prompt appears.
Change the setting with :set colors statusbar.bg.prompt <color> and verify the change is picked up.

name: qutebrowser-statusbar-widget-class-rename
negative_constraints: 不要只改 class 定义和 import, 而遗漏 STYLESHEET 中的 QLabel#OldName 选择器。
不要重命名配置键 (statusbar.url.fg、statusbar.url.fg.success 等) 或 Qt property 名 urltype。
不要顺带重命名模块文件 url.py 或 StatusBar.url 属性, 否则会破坏其他模块的连接代码。
不要做无关的样式或逻辑重构。
procedure: 定位被重命名的 widget 类定义, 例如 qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar/url.py 中的 class Url(TextBase)。只改类名, 保留模块文件名和属性名, 除非任务另有要求。
在同一文件的 STYLESHEET 中, 把所有 QLabel#<OldName>[...] 选择器同步改为 QLabel#<NewName>[...]。statusbar widget 的 objectName 由类名派生, Qt 按 objectName 匹配 # 选择器。漏改选择器不会报错, 但颜色和样式会静默失效。
用 grep -rn '\b<OldName>\b' qutebrowser/ 找出所有 import 和实例化位置。至少包括 bar.py 中的 'from qutebrowser.widgets.statusbar.url import <OldName>' 和 'self.url = <OldName>()', 逐一改为新名。
更新引用旧类名的 docstring 和 Attributes 说明, 例如 StatusBar 中的 'url: The <NewName> widget in the statusbar.'。
保留实例属性名 self.url、urltype 属性值、配置键 statusbar.url.fg* 和信号连接不变。这些属于外部接口或配置面, 不随类名改变。
validation: grep -rn '\bUrl\b' qutebrowser/widgets/ 确认无残留的旧类名引用 (含 QLabel#Url)。
python -c 'import qutebrowser.widgets.statusbar.bar' 确认导入无误。
运行现有测试和 pylint/flake8。
启动 qutebrowser, 确认 statusbar URL 在 normal/success/error/warn/hover 状态下颜色仍然生效。

name: qutebrowser-statusbar-widget-qss-styling
negative_constraints: 不要修改父级 StatusBar 的全局样式表来实现单个子 widget 的外观,样式应局限在子 widget 自身。
不要用 padding 来留出色块边距:QProgressBar 的 padding 表现不稳定。用透明 border 代替。
不要保留可见的进度百分比文本:它会撑大固定尺寸的状态栏控件,导致文字被截断。
不要改动 setSizePolicy(Fixed, Fixed) 或 minimumSizeHint,纯样式修复不应改变布局尺寸行为。
不要遗留被注释掉的旧样式代码。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar.py 中目标 widget 类(如 StatusProgress(QProgressBar))的 __init__。保留已有的 setObjectName(self.__class__.__name__) 和 setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Fixed, QSizePolicy.Fixed) 调用。
删除被注释掉的旧样式尝试(如 #self.setStyleSheet("padding-right: 1px")),不要在旁边再叠加新的注释代码。
关闭 Qt 默认渲染的百分比文本:进度条调用 self.setTextVisible(False),让它在紧凑的状态栏中只显示色块。
在 __init__ 内用三引号多行 QSS 调用 self.setStyleSheet(...)。用类型选择器(QProgressBar { ... })限定作用范围,使其只影响本 widget。
在 QSS 中去掉原生外观:border-radius: 0px。用 border: 2px solid transparent 作为内边距,让色块不贴边。用 margin-left: 1px 与左侧相邻的状态栏元素隔开。
通过子控件选择器 QProgressBar::chunk { background-color: ... } 设置进度色块颜色,使其与状态栏前景色匹配(此处为 white)。
setStyleSheet 放在 self.hide() 之前,保持「先配置、后隐藏、按信号显示」的初始化顺序。不改动 minimumSizeHint/sizeHint 等尺寸逻辑。
validation: 运行 python -m pyflakes / pylint 检查 qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar.py,确保没有语法或风格错误。
启动 qutebrowser 并加载一个页面,确认进度条出现时:无文字、无圆角和原生边框、色块为白色、与左侧元素有 1px 间隔。
确认页面加载完成后进度条仍按原逻辑隐藏,状态栏其他元素的布局没有变化。

name: qutebrowser-strip-url-passwords-on-display
negative_constraints: Do not strip the password from URLs that are used to actually load or request a page (setUrl, openurl, QNetworkRequest). Authentication would break.

Do not replace `toString(QUrl.FullyEncoded)` with `toDisplayString()` where the result is stored or re-parsed. toDisplayString decodes percent-escapes. Use the `RemovePassword | FullyEncoded` combination instead.
Do not fix only the reported call site. Every user-visible or logged URL string path must be covered.
Do not hand-roll regex password scrubbing. Use QUrl formatting flags.
procedure: Search the whole repo with grep for `.url().toString(`, `url.toString(`, `toString(QUrl.FullyEncoded)` and `info.url.toString`. Find every place where a QUrl becomes a string.

Sort each call site by where the string goes: (a) shown to the user (statusbar command text from message.set_cmd_text, message.question prompts, error page title or text), (b) written to logs (log.*.debug, log.*.warning), (c) persisted or used as an identifier (quickmark save, history, config), (d) passed back into a network request or load.

For (a) and (b), switch to `url.toDisplayString()`. Its default formatting already includes RemovePassword. Examples are open_cur, open_tab_cur and open_tab_bg_cur in commands.py, hint cmd text in hints.py, the error page urlstr in webpage.py, and the debug log in qutescheme.py.

For (c), where the string must stay parseable and encoded, keep the encoding semantics and add the flag explicitly: `url.toString(QUrl.RemovePassword | QUrl.FullyEncoded)`. quickmarks.prompt_save is an example.
For (d), leave the original `toString()` or the QUrl object unchanged. Network loading still needs the credentials.
Also check helper functions in utils/url.py, such as fuzzy URL and repr helpers, that build URL strings for messages or debug output. Apply the same display and serialize rule there.
When you edit a log format call, keep the line under the flake8/pylint line-length limit by wrapping `.format(` arguments onto a new line.
Remove any `QUrl` import that the change leaves unused, for example in hints.py once FullyEncoded is gone. Keep it where RemovePassword or FullyEncoded is still referenced.
validation: After the change, grep for `toString()` on QUrl objects. Every remaining hit should be a load or request path or should carry RemovePassword.
Run the existing pytest/unittest suite, especially the tests for utils/url.py.
Run flake8 and pylint (tox lint envs) to catch unused QUrl imports and line-length issues.

Manual check: open [REDACTED_URL_CREDENTIALS]host/. Then run :open-cur style commands, hint-yank-to-cmd and quickmark-save, and trigger an error page. Confirm `secret` appears nowhere in the statusbar, prompt, error page or debug log.

name: qutebrowser-tab-close-must-not-abort-on-invalid-url
negative_constraints: 不要在 URL 校验失败时 return 或 raise,否则标签会永远关不掉 (#163 的根因)。
不要对空 URL 弹出 invalid_url_error。空 URL 属于合法场景,报错只会产生噪音。
不要把无效或空 URL 推入 _undo_stack,undo 时恢复不出有效页面。
不要改动 shutdown/removeTab/deleteLater 的顺序,也不要跳过其中任何一步。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/widgets/tabbedbrowser.py 中的 TabbedBrowser 关闭标签逻辑 (close_tab / _remove_tab)。找到把 tab.cur_url 序列化后放入 _undo_stack 的分支。

把 URL 检查拆成三路: (1) tab.cur_url.isValid() 时照常构造 UndoEntry(tab.cur_url, qtutils.serialize(tab.history())) 并 append 到 _undo_stack; (2) tab.cur_url.isEmpty() 时静默跳过,不报错也不入 undo 栈; (3) 其余非空但无效的 URL 调用 urlutils.invalid_url_error(self._win_id, tab.cur_url, 'saving tab') 给出警告。
删除 invalid 分支里的提前 return。无论 URL 状态如何,都要继续执行 tab.shutdown()、self.removeTab(idx)、tab.deleteLater()。
在空 URL 分支加注释说明原因: target=_blank 打开的下载会产生空 URL 标签。注释里引用 issue #163。
在 invalid 分支加注释说明: 这里只是警告,不 return,标签照样关闭。
validation: 运行现有测试套件 (tox / pytest),确认没有回归。
手动验证: 用 target=_blank 打开一个下载链接,产生空 URL 标签,确认 :tab-close 能关闭它且不报错。
手动验证: 关闭一个 URL 非空但无效的标签,确认会显示警告且标签仍被关闭。
确认关闭有效 URL 的标签后,:undo 仍能恢复。

name: qutebrowser-unified-early-exception-hook
negative_constraints: Do not keep two-phase hooks (a temporary one, then a real one). Exceptions that happen between the two phases get handled inconsistently.
Do not rely on QApplication.exit()/self.exit() to terminate the process from an exception hook.
Do not assume mainwindow, tabs, or config exist when the hook runs.
procedure: Locate the excepthook installation in qutebrowser/app.py: QuteBrowser.__init__ and _python_hacks.

Install the full crash handler (self._exception_hook) as the very first action after super().__init__, before faulthandler, config, or widget init. This lets early exceptions reach the same crash path.
Remove the temporary init-only hook (_tmp_exception_hook). Remove the later re-assignment of sys.excepthook in _python_hacks. Keep one single hook.
Inside the hook, print the traceback with sys.__excepthook__(*exc) instead of traceback.print_exception, so the default interpreter behaviour is kept.

Make every step that gathers state for the dialog (open pages, history, and so on) tolerant of half-initialized objects. Wrap each one in its own try/except, because the app may crash before mainwindow or tabs exist.
End the hook with sys.exit(1) instead of self.exit(1). QApplication.exit only stops the event loop and does nothing if the loop has not started yet. sys.exit terminates the process reliably.
validation: Run the existing tests.
Inject a raise into QuteBrowser.__init__ before mainwindow is created. Verify that the traceback prints, the crash dialog shows (or the process exits), and the exit status is 1.
Inject a raise after the event loop starts, for example in a command handler. Verify that the crash dialog appears and the process terminates with exit status 1.

name: qutebrowser-unsupported-content-mimetype-fixup
negative_constraints: Do not implement full MIME sniffing in this fix. Leave a docstring that points to the whatwg mimesniff spec as possible future work.
Do not ignore Content-Disposition: attachment. Even when the mimetype is image/jpg, the reply must still be downloaded.
Do not call readAll() before the reply has finished. Doing so gives truncated content.
Do not leak the QNetworkReply. Call deleteLater() after setContent.
Do not leave the old unsupportedContent handling connected alongside the new slot, or a single reply will trigger both a download and a display.
Do not leave unused imports (partial, http) in networkmanager.py, because the linters will fail.
procedure: Locate the BrowserPage(QWebPage) class in qutebrowser/browser/webpage.py. Confirm that setForwardUnsupportedContent(True) is called there, and check where unsupportedContent is currently connected (for example in networkmanager or in the download path).

In BrowserPage.__init__, connect self.unsupportedContent to a new on_unsupported_content slot decorated with @pyqtSlot('QNetworkReply'). That puts all decisions about unsupported content in the page layer.

In the slot, call qutebrowser.utils.http.parse_content_disposition(reply) first. If the result is not inline (Content-Disposition: attachment), emit self.start_download.emit(reply) and return. An explicit attachment always wins.

Next, call http.parse_content_type(reply) to get the mimetype. Correct only an explicit allowlist of known nonstandard values, such as image/jpg -> image/jpeg (RFC 1341 7.5). Add a comment naming the server that sends it (for example the LinkedIn CDN) and the standard it violates.
Add a helper display_content(reply, mimetype) that calls self.mainFrame().setContent(reply.readAll(), mimetype, reply.url()) and then reply.deleteLater().
Handle async completion. If reply.isFinished(), call display_content right away. Otherwise connect reply.finished to functools.partial(self.display_content, reply, corrected_mimetype).
Make every other mimetype fall back to start_download.emit(reply), so the existing download behavior stays the same.
Move the imports along with the logic. If partial or http stop being used in networkmanager.py, delete those imports there and add them in webpage.py.
validation: Run the existing tests, plus pylint/flake8, to confirm there are no unused or missing imports.
Manual check 1: open an image served with Content-Type: image/jpg and confirm it displays inline instead of opening a download prompt.
Manual check 2: confirm a response with Content-Disposition: attachment still triggers a download.
Manual check 3: confirm an unknown mimetype (for example application/octet-stream) still triggers a download.
Confirm that the reply's finished signal triggers the display exactly once, and that there are no duplicate downloads.

name: qutebrowser-version-info-utility
negative_constraints: Do not let version() raise when git is missing, when the code is not running from a git checkout, or when the platform is unknown. Each optional field must degrade to None or '?'.
Do not duplicate the version string across modules. Derive it from __version_info__ in the package __init__.
Do not mix up the compile-time Qt version (QT_VERSION_STR) with the runtime version (qVersion()). Report both.

Do not resolve git info relative to the current working directory without care. The .git check and the git call run in the cwd, not in the qutebrowser source directory. Base the lookup on os.path.dirname(qutebrowser.__file__) or pass cwd= to the subprocess call.
Avoid relying on platform.dist() on newer Pythons, where it was removed in 3.8. Guard it with a fallback if you touch this code.
procedure: Define a single source of truth for the version in qutebrowser/__init__.py: put `__version_info__` as an int tuple and derive `__version__ = '.'.join(map(str, __version_info__))`. Place both below the package docstring.

Add a public `version()` function to qutebrowser/utils/__init__.py next to the existing helpers such as qurl(). Import qutebrowser at module level and read `qutebrowser.__version__` there. Do not hardcode the version string.

Get Qt info from PyQt5.QtCore: QT_VERSION_STR gives the compile-time version and qVersion() gives the runtime version. Get the PyQt version from PYQT_VERSION_STR. Get the Python version from platform.python_version().

Branch the OS version lookup on sys.platform. Use platform.dist() for 'linux', platform.win32_ver() for 'win32' and platform.mac_ver() for 'darwin'. Join each result with ', ' and fall back to '?' for any other platform.

Build the output as a list of formatted lines ending in '\n', grouped with blank lines. Include the platform via platform.platform() and the bitness via platform.architecture()[0]. Return the lines with ''.join(lines).

Put optional git info in a private helper `_git_str()`. It runs `git describe --tags --dirty --always` through subprocess.check_output, decodes the output as UTF-8 and strips it. It returns None when there is no .git directory or on CalledProcessError or FileNotFoundError.
Append the 'Git commit: ...' line only when _git_str() returns a value other than None.
validation: Run `python -c 'from qutebrowser.utils import version; print(version())'` inside the repo and check that the qutebrowser, Python, Qt, PyQt, Platform and OS Version lines appear.
Run the same command from a directory outside any git checkout and check that no Git commit line appears and nothing raises.
Run the same command with git hidden from PATH and check that FileNotFoundError is caught.
Run the existing tests or a lint pass (pylint/flake8) on qutebrowser/utils/__init__.py.

name: qutebrowser-version-module-table-driven-imports
negative_constraints: Do not use bare __import__ or exec. Use importlib.import_module.
Do not use a plain dict on older Python versions. Use OrderedDict so the output order stays stable.
Do not catch broad Exception for the import. Catch only ImportError, and only AttributeError for the attribute lookups.
Do not mix sipconfig's special logic into the generic table.
procedure: In qutebrowser/utils/version.py, find the repeated `try: import X / except ImportError / else: getattr(X, '__version__', 'yes')` blocks inside _module_versions().
Keep special-case blocks such as sipconfig as they are. Their version lookup has its own logic and its own error handling with logging.
Add `import importlib` and `import collections` at the top of the file.

Replace the repeated blocks with a collections.OrderedDict that maps module name to a list of version attribute candidates. List the attributes in priority order. For example, colorama uses ['VERSION', '__version__']. Use [] for a module that has no version attribute, such as colorlog.
Loop over the mapping and load each module with importlib.import_module(name).
On ImportError, output 'name: no'.
On success, try each attribute in turn. Stop at the first one that exists and output 'name: value'. Use for/else to fall back to 'name: yes' when none of the attributes exist.
Remove the `# pylint: disable=import-error,unused-variable,too-many-branches` comment and the TODO comment, since neither is needed after the refactor.
validation: Run the existing unit tests for utils/version (tests for _module_versions), and update any test expectations that assumed missing modules were omitted.
Run pylint or flake8 on version.py and confirm no new disable is needed.
Run qutebrowser --version or :version manually and check that every module appears, in order, with a value of version, yes, or no.
