name: qutebrowser-version-optional-dependency-reporting
negative_constraints: 不要在 getattr 回退之后,又在 format 中直接写 `module.__version__`。原 PR 计算了 version 却仍用 `IPython.__version__`,使回退失效,版本属性缺失时会抛 AttributeError。
不要让任何可选依赖的探测异常从 version() 抛出;--version 和崩溃报告都依赖这个函数。
不要用局部变量名 `version` 遮蔽外层函数名 version(),优先用 `ver` 等名字。
不要把可选依赖改成硬依赖或移到模块顶层 import。
不要省略 `# pylint: disable=import-error` 注释,否则 lint 会失败。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/utils/version.py 中的 version() 函数,找到已有的可选依赖块(如 sipconfig 的 try/except ImportError/else 结构)。
复用现有模式:每个可选依赖单独写一个 `try: import X  # pylint: disable=import-error` / `except ImportError: pass` / `else: lines.append(...)` 块。
把这些块放在 `lines += ['Webkit ...', ...]` 这类 Qt/WebKit 核心版本行之前,和其他可选库保持同一分组。
版本号读取统一用 `getattr(module, '__version__' 或 'VERSION', 'yes')`,先赋值给一个局部变量,再在 format 里使用这个变量。不要在 format 中再次直接访问属性。
如果模块没有版本属性(如 colorlog),输出 `'name: yes'`,只表示已安装。
对需要调用 API 才能拿到版本的依赖(如 `sipconfig.Configuration().sip_version_str`),在 else 分支里再套一层 `try/except (AttributeError, TypeError)`,失败时回退为 `'SIP ?'`,保证 --version 不会崩溃。
多个模块共同组成一个特性时(ipdb + IPython),在同一个 try 中一起 import,输出一行组合标签 `'ipdb/IPython {version}'`。
validation: 运行 `python -m qutebrowser --version`,确认输出含 SIP / ipdb/IPython / colorlog / colorama 行,或在未安装时正确省略。
在缺失这些包的虚拟环境中再跑一次,确认没有 ImportError 或 AttributeError。
用 monkeypatch 删除 `__version__` 属性(或 mock 掉 sipconfig.Configuration 让它抛 TypeError),确认分别回退为 'yes' 和 'SIP ?'。
运行 pylint/flake8 和现有的 version 相关测试。

name: qutebrowser-version-output-consistent-label-format
negative_constraints: 不要让同一个输出块里同时出现 'X 1.0' 和 'X: 1.0' 两种格式。
不要因为读取环境变量或可选模块而抛异常。环境变量用 os.environ.get 并提供默认值,可选模块用 try/except ImportError 处理。
不要打乱现有的分组顺序,也不要删除空行分隔。
如果文件里还没有 import os,不要忘记补上。
procedure: 先定位 qutebrowser/utils/version.py。version() 负责组装主版本块。_module_versions() 负责可选依赖的版本行。
检查 version() 和 _module_versions() 里所有 lines.append 和 lines += [...] 的格式串。统一成 'Name: value' 的写法,名称后面加冒号和空格。多值行也一样,例如 'Qt: {}, runtime: {}'。
修改 import 失败或属性缺失时的回退输出,例如 'SIP: ?'。回退行的标签格式要和正常行保持一致。
新增的环境或运行时信息行要放在逻辑相关的分组里。例如 Harfbuzz 应紧跟 Webkit,写成 'Harfbuzz: {}'.format(os.environ.get('QT_HARFBUZZ', 'system'))。环境变量未设置时要给一个语义明确的默认值。
保留现有的空字符串分隔行('')和分组顺序:先是 qutebrowser/git 信息,然后是 Python/Qt/PyQt、可选模块、Webkit,最后是 Platform。
validation: 运行现有测试:tests 下与 utils/version 相关的测试和整体测试套件。
手动执行 python -m qutebrowser --version,或在应用中执行 :version,确认每一行都是 'Name: value' 格式。
在设置和未设置 QT_HARFBUZZ 两种情况下分别检查 Harfbuzz 行,未设置时应显示 'system'。
运行 flake8/pylint,确认没有未使用或缺失的 import。

name: qutebrowser-version-output-ordering
negative_constraints: 不要改动各字段的内容和格式化字符串, 例如 'Git commit: {}' 的文本。只调整位置和空白。
不要在 join 之后再用 strip 之类的字符串后处理来修空行。应该在构造 lines 时就不产生多余的 ''。
gitver 为 None 时不能输出占位行。
不要把顺序调整扩散到其他调用 version() 的地方, 例如 crash report。它们直接使用这个字符串。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/utils/version.py 中的 version() 函数。它先把文本行收集到 `lines` 列表里, 最后用 '\n'.join(lines) 拼接。
确定标识信息该放在哪里。build/commit 这类标识信息(gitver)应紧跟 'qutebrowser v{}' 头部那一行。不要放在可变长度的 releaseinfo 段落之后。
拆分 lines 字面量: 先只放头部一行, 然后写 `if gitver is not None: lines.append('Git commit: {}'.format(gitver))`, 再用 `lines += [...]` 追加原有的 Python/Qt/平台等段落。
删除旧位置的 gitver 追加代码, 以及为了给它做分隔而加在 releaseinfo 循环后的 lines.append('')。这样输出末尾就不会多出空行。
保留已有的可选字段守卫(`is not None`)和段落格式 '--- {} ---'。只调整顺序和空行。
validation: 运行现有测试: pytest tests 中 version 相关的用例(如果存在)。
手动运行 python -m qutebrowser --version, 或在应用内执行 :version。确认 Git commit 行紧跟在版本头部之后。
确认输出末尾没有多余空行。
分别验证 gitver 为 None 和 releaseinfo 为 None 的组合下, 输出没有空洞或重复的空行。

name: qutebrowser-webview-styling-via-user-stylesheet-default
negative_constraints: Do not use QWebView/QWebFrame setScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff) to hide scrollbars. It breaks frame scrolling and scroll-percentage logic.
Do not add a new config option when the existing user-stylesheet setting's default can carry the CSS.
Do not use display:none on the scrollbar. Use width/height 0px, which hides it while keeping scrolling functional.
Do not leave the obsolete FIXME in webview.py after fixing it.
procedure: Locate the visual behavior to change in qutebrowser/widgets/webview.py, e.g. a FIXME such as 'hide scrollbars without setScrollBarPolicy'. Decide whether CSS can solve it instead of a Qt widget API. Qt APIs like setScrollBarPolicy also disable programmatic scrolling.

Open qutebrowser/config/configdata.py. Find the existing 'user-stylesheet' entry in the DATA OrderedDict. Its type is typ.UserStyleSheet, which accepts either an absolute filename or an inline CSS string.

Change only the SettingValue default. Set it to a WebKit pseudo-element CSS rule, e.g. '::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 0px; height: 0px; }'. Users who override the setting then get their own value instead.
Update the setting description so it explains the accepted input forms, e.g. 'User stylesheet to use (absolute filename or CSS string).'
Remove the now-resolved FIXME comment from WebView.__init__. Add no new widget-level code.
validation: Run existing tests (e.g. configdata/configtypes tests). Confirm the UserStyleSheet type validates the new non-path CSS-string default.
Launch qutebrowser, open a long page and confirm no scrollbars are shown.
Confirm keyboard/command scrolling (j/k, scroll-perc) still works.
Set user-stylesheet to empty or a custom file and confirm the default CSS is no longer applied.

name: qutebrowser-wrap-long-parenthesized-imports
negative_constraints: 不要用反斜杠续行替代括号, 项目风格使用括号隐式续行。
不要为了缩短行而拆成多条 import 语句或改用别名, 除非已有代码就是这样写的。
不要顺手重排、删除或增加导入的名字, lint 修复应保持语义不变。
不要添加 `# noqa` 或 `# pylint: disable` 来压制行宽警告。
不要改测试或 changelog, 这类修复只涉及代码风格。
procedure: 定位 lint 报告中超长的行 (qutebrowser 行宽上限为 79 字符), 常见于新增模块名后的 `from x import (a, b, ...)` 多行导入。
在该行最后一个能放下的逗号之后断行, 把剩下的名字移到下一行。
续行要与左括号后的第一个字符对齐 (visual indent), 和上一行保持同一缩进列, 例如 `from qutebrowser.mainwindow.statusbar import (command, ...` 的下一行对齐到 `(` 之后。
保留原有的导入顺序和括号写法, 只改换行位置。
改完后检查同一文件里有没有其他超长行或缩进不对的续行。
validation: 对修改的文件运行 flake8 (或 tox -e flake8) 和 pylint (tox -e pylint), 确认 E501/C0301 及续行缩进类警告 (E127/E128) 都已消失。
运行 python -c 'import qutebrowser.mainwindow.statusbar.bar', 确认导入仍然正常。
用 git diff 确认只有空白和换行的变化。

name: qutebrowser-wrap-long-python-lines
negative_constraints: Do not use backslash line continuations.
Do not rename variables, signals or methods just to shorten a line. The fix must be purely a formatting change.
Do not change argument order, lambda signatures (*args), or which signal connects to which slot.
Do not touch tests, docs or changelog for a pure line-length fix.
procedure: Run the line-length check (pep8/flake8 --select=E501 or pylint C0301) over the qutebrowser/ package. This lists every line over 79 characters. Typical hotspots are qutebrowser/commands/*.py and qutebrowser/widgets/*.py.

For long str.format() calls, break the line immediately after `.format(`. Indent the arguments one extra level (4 spaces) on the next line. Example: `self.error.emit("{}: ...".format(\n    self.cmd.mainname))`.

For long lambdas passed to signal.connect(...), break inside the innermost call's argument list. Align the continued arguments with that call's opening parenthesis, for example `self._filter_signals(self.cur_statusbar_message,\n<aligned>*args))`.
For short-bodied lambdas, you can instead break after `lambda:` and indent the body. Prefer breaking inside parentheses, though. This keeps visual indentation valid for pep8 E128/E131.
Rely on implicit line continuation inside (), [] and {}. Do not add new parentheses unless no existing bracket can be used.
Re-run the line-length check and confirm that no new continuation-indent warnings (E12x) were introduced.
validation: Run pep8/flake8 --max-line-length=79 and pylint on the changed files.
Run the existing tests, if any.
Launch qutebrowser and check that the affected signals still fire: load progress, statusbar messages, and command error messages.

name: qutebrowser-wrap-long-qt-stylesheet-templates
negative_constraints: Never split inside a `{color[...]}` placeholder or its dotted config key. Doing so breaks format() lookup at runtime with a KeyError.
Do not convert `{{`/`}}` to single braces.
Do not split a selector such as `QTreeView::item:selected` or a property name such as `border-bottom`.
Do not move the stylesheet into string concatenation just to satisfy the line limit.
procedure: Find over-long lines inside triple-quoted Qt stylesheet templates, such as CompletionView.STYLESHEET in qutebrowser/widgets/completion.py. These templates are filled via .format()/config `{color[...]}` placeholders.

Use the fact that QSS/CSS ignores whitespace. Break the line between the property value tokens, for example `border-bottom: 1px solid` on one line and `{color[completion.category.border.bottom]}` on the next.
Indent the continuation one extra level relative to the property line, and keep the trailing `;` on the placeholder line.
Keep doubled braces `{{`/`}}` intact. These are literal QSS block braces escaped for str.format.
validation: Run the line-length check on the widget file.
Start qutebrowser, open the completion view, and confirm that category and selected-item borders still render with the configured colors.
Watch for absence of KeyError/IndexError when formatting the stylesheet and for absence of Qt 'Could not parse stylesheet' warnings.

name: qutebrowser-wrapper-command-maxsplit
negative_constraints: Do not keep `*command` together with a join. That loses the original quoting and whitespace.
Do not add manual quoting or shlex.quote to the joined string to work around the problem. Use the framework's maxsplit.
Do not count special parameters such as win_id or count in the maxsplit value.
Do not change the existing type validation of the leading parameters, for example the negative-value checks for ms or times.
procedure: Locate the wrapper commands that accept another command line as an argument. These are commands registered with @cmdutils.register that take a varargs `*command` and rebuild it with `' '.join(command)`. Example: later/repeat in qutebrowser/utils/utilcmds.py.

Identify the root cause. The command parser first splits and unquotes the whole line. The join then rebuilds a string that differs from the original, so quotes, runs of spaces and arguments with spaces are corrupted.

Add `maxsplit=N` to the decorator. N is the number of positional arguments before the command, for example `@cmdutils.register(scope='window', maxsplit=1)`. The parser then puts the rest of the line, unsplit, into the last positional argument.
Change the signature from `*command` to a single positional `command`. Keep special parameters such as `win_id: {'special': 'win_id'}` as they are, because they do not count toward the split.
Delete the `cmdline = ' '.join(command)` reconstruction. Pass `command` directly to `CommandRunner.run_safely` or to the `functools.partial` call.
Update the docstring Args entry from `*command:` to `command:`. Docs and completion are generated from the docstring and signature.
Grep for other commands that use the `*args` plus `' '.join` pattern to forward a command line, and fix them the same way.
validation: run existing tests (pytest / unittest for cmdutils and utilcmds)
Manual check: `:repeat 2 message-info "a  b"`. The nested command receives the original string including quotes and double spaces.
Manual check: `:later 100 open -t "foo bar"`. It runs correctly, and a negative ms still raises CommandError.
Confirm the generated command docs and signature show `command` rather than `*command`.

name: qwebpage-extension-handler-variable-binding-fix
negative_constraints: 不要访问未转换的 ExtensionOption / ExtensionReturn 基类上的子类专有属性(suggestedFileNames、fileNames)。基类没有这些属性,运行时会抛 AttributeError,而 Qt 回调可能把这个异常吞掉。
不要借修复之机重构整个 extension 分发表,也不要改 handler 签名。
不要改动 QFileDialog.getOpenFileNames 的调用方式,只修正数据来源。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/browser/webpage.py 中 BrowserPage 的 extension handler(例如 _handle_multiple_files),它接收 opt(ExtensionOption)和 out(ExtensionReturn)。
确认 extension() 分发逻辑:先把 opt / out 用 sip.cast 或类型转换成具体子类,例如 ChooseMultipleFilesExtensionOption 和 ChooseMultipleFilesExtensionReturn,再把转换后的对象作为 info 和 files 传给 handler。
用 git show 查看引入回归的提交(这里是 4c78b611)。找出被重命名或重构的局部变量,检查 handler 体内是否还在用旧名字或未转换的基类对象。
handler 内所有属性访问都要改用转换后的对象:从 info 读取 suggestedFileNames,把结果写到 files.fileNames。不能从基类 opt 读子类属性。
只做最小修复。保留原有的返回值语义:成功返回 True,失败时返回超类的返回值。
validation: 运行现有测试(tox / pytest)。
对 webpage.py 运行 pylint / pyflakes,检查是否有未使用的形参,或因重命名残留的错误引用。
手动验证:打开带 <input type=file multiple> 的页面并触发选择,确认文件对话框弹出,所选文件能回传给页面,且没有 AttributeError。

name: register-objreg-at-construction-site
negative_constraints: 不要保留两处 register 同一个名字，否则会报重复注册错误或产生不一致。
不要改注册名或 scope，其他模块通过字符串 key 查找。
不要用延迟查找、try/except KeyError 或 QTimer 来绕过注册时序问题。
不要把注册放在父容器构造完子组件之后，子组件自己的 __init__ 期间可能已经需要查到它。
procedure: 定位失败的 objreg.get(name, scope='window', window=win_id) 调用。确认在它运行时，该对象是否已经注册。
找到 objreg.register(name, obj, ...) 的位置。检查它是否在父容器(如 MainWindow)里注册子组件的属性(如 self.status.cmd)。
如果是，就把注册移到实际创建该对象的构造函数中(如 StatusBar.__init__)。注册语句紧跟在实例化和 addWidget 之后，并放在后续兄弟组件创建之前。
保持注册名、scope='window'、window=win_id 完全不变，只改调用位置。被移入的对象引用要改成本地属性(self.status.cmd -> self.cmd)。
删除父容器中原有的 register 调用，避免同名重复注册。
确认目标模块已经 import objreg(qutebrowser.utils.objreg)。没有就补上。父模块如果不再使用 objreg，就清理多余的 import。
validation: 运行现有测试套件(tox / pytest)。
启动 qutebrowser，打开新窗口和多个窗口，确认没有 objreg KeyError。确认 ':' 命令行可用，状态栏模式切换正常。
grep 注册名 'status-command'，确认只剩一处 register，且所有 get 调用的 scope/window 参数一致。

name: relocate-window-command-from-dispatcher-to-utilcmds
negative_constraints: Do not leave the method in CommandDispatcher and also register it in utilcmds. Registering the same command name twice conflicts.
Do not keep a reference to self or to dispatcher instance state in the module-level function.
Do not leave a raise of cmdexc.CommandError without importing cmdexc.
Do not misalign the continuation lines of a multi-line string. After moving the code from a method to a module-level function, re-indent them to follow the PEP8 / pylint hanging-indent rules.
Do not change the user-facing command name, argument order, or error message text.
procedure: Find the method in qutebrowser/browser/commands.py. It is registered as a CommandDispatcher method with @cmdutils.register(instance='command-dispatcher', scope='window').
Delete the whole method from CommandDispatcher.
Delete the state that only this method used. For :later that is self._timers in __init__ and the matching line in the class docstring's Attributes section.
Add a module-level function to qutebrowser/utils/utilcmds.py and register it with @cmdutils.register(scope='window'). Do not pass instance=.

Replace the self._win_id dependency with a keyword-only win_id parameter placed after *args, for example: def later(ms: int, *command, win_id). With scope='window', the cmdutils framework injects win_id automatically.
Keep the docstring Args section and keep the parameter annotations, e.g. ms: int. The command-line argument parser and the generated documentation are built from them.
Move every dependency the function body references into utilcmds' import lists: functools; usertypes from qutebrowser.utils; runners and cmdexc from qutebrowser.commands.

Search the body for every module name it uses (e.g. cmdexc.CommandError) and confirm each one is imported. The accepted diff references cmdexc but never imports it, so the error paths would raise NameError.
To get the window-level command runner, either create runners.CommandRunner(win_id) or call objreg.get('command-runner', scope='window', window=win_id). Pick one and use it consistently.
Remove functools and usertypes from commands.py only if they have no other uses there. Grep before deleting.
validation: Run python -m pyflakes or pylint on qutebrowser/utils/utilcmds.py and qutebrowser/browser/commands.py. Confirm there are no undefined names (cmdexc) and no unused imports.
Run the existing test suite.
Smoke test manually: `:later 500 message-info hi` runs after the delay.
Confirm `:later -1 x` raises a CommandError and not a NameError.
Confirm `:later 99999999999 x` reports that the number is too large.
Grep for '_timers' and 'def later' to confirm only one definition remains.

name: remove-obsolete-config-option-with-all-consumers
negative_constraints: Do not leave a stylesheet placeholder that refers to a deleted option. Formatting would raise a KeyError at runtime when the widget initialises.
Do not delete only the configdata entry while leaving config.get calls behind. Those calls fail with NoOptionError.
Do not add new replacement options or compatibility shims unless the task asks for them.
Do not change the order or defaults of neighbouring settings in the OrderedDict.
procedure: Find the setting in qutebrowser/config/configdata.py under its section's OrderedDict, for example the ('tabbar', sect.KeyValue(...)) block. Delete the whole ('name', SettingValue(...), 'desc') tuple and the blank line that follows it, so no trailing empty entry is left.

Grep the repo for every way the option is used, including config.get('<section>', '<name>') and stylesheet template interpolation like {config[<section>][<name>]}. Template references live inside STYLESHEET strings in widgets such as qutebrowser/widgets/tabwidget.py.

Delete each consumer. Remove the Qt setter calls that read the option (e.g. setUsesScrollButtons). Remove the CSS properties that interpolate it (e.g. min-width and max-width), and keep the rest of the CSS block unchanged.

If code branches on a boolean option being removed (e.g. `if config.get('tabbar','expand')`), decide which behaviour stays. Collapse the branch to that path without a conditional, and keep any validity helpers in place (e.g. qt_ensure_valid(size)).
If on_config_changed or similar handlers exist, check whether they dispatch on the removed option name, and drop that dispatch too.
Check the imports. Remove an import only if nothing uses it anymore. In this PR QSize is still used, so it stays.
validation: Run `grep -rn "<option-name>" qutebrowser/` and confirm there are no remaining references.
Run the existing test suite (e.g. `python -m unittest` or tox) and confirm the config tests pass.
Start qutebrowser or import the TabWidget and confirm the stylesheet formats without a KeyError and the tab bar renders.
Confirm that the flattened code path (e.g. tabSizeHint) still returns a valid QSize.

name: remove-qt-stylesheet-state-property-from-statusbar-widget
negative_constraints: Do not leave a dangling signal connection to a deleted slot. If you do, MainWindow construction raises AttributeError.
Do not keep a color[...] stylesheet placeholder whose config key you removed. Stylesheet formatting will fail at runtime.
Do not connect hide() directly to a signal that carries args unless you are sure Qt drops extra args. Use a *args wrapper the way the repo does.
Do not remove the shared statusbar.progress.bg key or the statusbar.bg.error key. Other widgets still use them.
procedure: Locate the widget class in qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar.py (e.g. Progress). Find the state attribute and the pyqtProperty getter/setter that drive the stylesheet. In this case they are `_error` and `error`.
Remove the internal state field together with its pyqtProperty getter and setter. Also remove the setter's side effect, the setStyleSheet re-application.
Collapse the property-qualified selectors into a single plain selector, for example QProgressBar::chunk. Keep the color[...] key that is still in use.
Drop the config key that is no longer used from the default config string in qutebrowser/utils/config.py. In this case that key is statusbar.progress.bg.error.
Remove every slot that only existed to set the removed state (e.g. load_finished). Remove the leftover state resets in the remaining slots, such as `self.error = False` in on_load_started.

Rewire the signal connections in qutebrowser/widgets/mainwindow.py. Connect cur_load_finished directly to the remaining behavior with an argument-swallowing adapter, e.g. `lambda *args: self.status.prog.hide()`. QWebView loadFinished passes an ok bool.
Grep the repo for the removed names (error property, load_finished, the bg.error key) and confirm no references remain.
validation: Run the existing tests and pylint on the touched modules to catch unused imports such as pyqtProperty.
Launch qutebrowser and load a valid page. Confirm the progress bar shows and then hides on finish.
Load a failing URL. Confirm the progress bar hides and does not turn red, and that no traceback appears.

name: replace-datetime-delta-with-qtime-stopwatch
negative_constraints: Do not keep the None sentinel alongside the QTime. Use isNull() as the only 'never started' check.
Do not call elapsed() and then start() separately. Use restart() so the measurement and the reset happen in one step.
Do not convert milliseconds to seconds or timedelta. QTime and the config value are both in ms.
Do not change the queueing or pop-timer logic. Only the delta computation should change.
Do not leave unused variables or imports. The accepted diff left `now = datetime.datetime.now()` behind, and pylint or flake8 will flag it.
Do not touch other surfaces such as tests or the changelog for this kind of internal refactor-bugfix.
procedure: Locate the Qt widget that tracks elapsed time by hand, e.g. qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar/bar.py StatusBar.disp_text / _last_text_time. Grep for the FIXME comment that references the issue number.
Add QTime to the existing PyQt5.QtCore import line. Do not add a separate import statement.
In __init__, replace the `self._last_x_time = None` sentinel with `self._stopwatch = QTime()`. A default-constructed QTime is a null QTime, and that null state replaces the None sentinel.

At the measuring point, use `if self._stopwatch.isNull(): delta = None; self._stopwatch.start()`. Otherwise use `delta = self._stopwatch.restart()`. restart() returns the elapsed milliseconds as an int and restarts the timer.
Compare delta directly with the config value, which is already in milliseconds (config.get('ui', 'message-timeout')). Drop the `.total_seconds() * 1000.0` conversion.
Update the class docstring's Attributes section: remove the old attribute and document `_stopwatch: A QTime for the last displayed message.`
Delete the FIXME comment and the issue link that this change resolves.
Remove leftovers that are now dead, such as `now = datetime.datetime.now()`. Also remove the `import datetime` line if nothing else in the module uses it.
validation: Run the existing test suite and the linters (pylint/flake8) to catch unused imports and variables.
Grep for the old attribute name (_last_text_time) and confirm there are no references left.
Test manually: the first message displays immediately. Rapid consecutive messages are queued. Messages separated by more than message-timeout ms display immediately.

name: replay-missed-qnetworkreply-signals-on-late-connect
negative_constraints: 不要在 __init__ 中同步 emit 自身信号,此时没有任何监听者。
不要直接调用 on_reply_error / on_reply_finished 来补偿。这样会在管理器连接前改变状态,或与之后真实到达的信号重复处理。
不要假设 reply 在交给 DownloadItem 时仍处于未开始状态(如本地文件、立即失败的 DNS 或 URL 错误)。
不要为了修这个竞争而重构下载管理器的信号拓扑,改动应局限于包装对象的构造处。
procedure: 定位把已存在的 QNetworkReply 包装进对象的地方(如 qutebrowser/browser/downloads.py 中 DownloadItem.__init__)。这里会连接 reply.finished / reply.error / reply.readyRead。
确认问题来源:reply 在信号连接之前可能已经出错或已经完成。之后连接的槽不会再收到这些信号,下载项就会一直挂起。
连接 reply 的信号后,同步检查 reply 当前状态。用 reply.error() != QNetworkReply.NoError 判断是否已出错,用 reply.isFinished() 判断是否已完成。
如果已出错,用 QTimer.singleShot(0, lambda: self.error.emit(reply.errorString())) 延迟重发对象自身的 error 信号。
如果已完成,用 QTimer.singleShot(0, self.finished.emit) 延迟重发 finished 信号。
必须用 0ms singleShot 延迟到事件循环:构造函数执行时,外部(DownloadManager)还没有连接 DownloadItem 的信号,同步 emit 会丢失。
从 PyQt5.QtCore 导入 QTimer,并保持现有括号换行风格。
在代码中加注释,说明为何要延迟发射(外部槽尚未连接)。
validation: 运行现有测试套件(tox / pytest),确认没有回归。
手动测试:下载一个立即失败的 URL(无效主机或不支持的 scheme),确认出现错误提示,下载项不再卡住。
手动测试:下载一个很快完成的小文件或本地资源,确认 finished 被处理且文件被保存。
检查 lambda 中捕获的 reply 在 singleShot 回调触发时仍然有效(没有被提前 deleteLater)。

name: resolve-qt-version-fixme-comments-after-release
negative_constraints: 不要在只更新文档的提交里修改版本比较条件, 例如 PYQT_VERSION 阈值, 也不要删除 workaround 代码。
不要删掉已有的上游 bug 或邮件列表链接, 它们是 workaround 存在的依据。
上游没有确认修复时, 不要把 FIXME 改成确定语句; 这种情况保留 FIXME。
不要漏掉 docstring 里的版本推测, 例如 earlyinit.fix_harfbuzz 中的说明。
procedure: 定位所有提到新发布 Qt/PyQt 版本的推测性注释: grep -rn 'FIXME\|hopefully\|5\.3\.1' qutebrowser/。重点看 browser/webpage.py, network/networkmanager.py, utils/earlyinit.py 这类带版本 workaround 的模块。
对每条注释, 先核对它对应的代码分支, 例如 `if PYQT_VERSION > 0x050300` 或 disable_qt_msghandler 包裹块, 以及注释中引用的上游 bug 或邮件列表链接, 确认该修复已在新版本中验证。
把推测语气改成确定语气: 'hopefully will be fixed' 改为 'is fixed', 'This breaks in <= 5.3.0, but hopefully works later' 改为 'This is broken in Qt <= 5.3.0.'。
删除已解决的 'FIXME: confirm/check in X' 行, 包括紧挨着它、只用来分隔的空注释行 `#`。
如果被删的推测注释是唯一的出处说明, 补上权威链接(上游 bug tracker 或 riverbankcomputing pyqt 邮件列表), 让 workaround 仍然可追溯。
保留版本门控代码和 workaround 本身不变, 本次只修改注释和 docstring。
validation: 重新 grep 'FIXME.*5\.3\.1' 和 'hopefully', 确认目标版本相关的匹配已清零。
运行 pylint/flake8, 确认没有因删除 `# pylint: disable` 而新增 invalid-name 告警; 如有告警, 恢复对应的 disable。
检查新增 URL 那一行的长度是否符合项目的 line-length 规则。
运行现有测试套件, 确认没有行为变化。

name: resolve-stale-qtwebkit-signal-fixme
negative_constraints: 不要因为 FIXME 质疑信号是否有用，就删除或改写 statusBarMessage 的 connect。
不要绕过 _filter_factory 直接连接到槽。它负责只转发当前 tab 的信号，绕过会把后台 tab 的消息也发到状态栏。
不要在纯注释清理的提交里顺手重构信号连接或增加新信号。
不要为删除注释添加测试或 changelog 条目。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/widgets/browser.py 中 TabbedBrowser 的 tab 信号连接块，也就是 tab.<signal>.connect(self._filter_factory(self.cur_*)) 这一组。
在 Qt/QtWebKit 文档中确认该 FIXME 提到的信号确实存在且会被发出。statusBarMessage 是 QWebPage/QWebView 的合法信号，会在 JS 设置 window.status 时触发。
确认对应的 cur_* 槽（例如 cur_statusbar_message）已经存在并接到状态栏，说明现有连接本身是正确的。
删除这条问题式 FIXME 注释，保留 connect 调用和 _filter_factory 包装原样不动。
检查同一连接块里有没有其他已过时的 FIXME，每个都单独核实后再决定是否处理。
validation: 确认 diff 只删除了注释行，没有改动任何 connect 语句。
运行 python -m pyflakes/pylint 检查 qutebrowser/widgets/browser.py，确认没有引入语法或缩进问题。
可选手动验证：打开设置 window.status 的页面，确认状态栏仍然显示该消息。

name: route-user-commands-through-run-safely
negative_constraints: Do not catch bare Exception in run_safely. Catch only CommandError, so real bugs still reach the crash handler.
Do not make run() itself swallow errors. The raising API and the user-safe API must stay separate.
Do not connect Qt signals directly to the raising run(). An exception inside a slot can abort the app or be lost silently.
procedure: In the command manager, provide a `run_safely(text, count=None)` wrapper next to `run()`.
In the wrapper, catch CommandError (the common base) and report it to the user through the existing message/error UI. It must not propagate.
Keep `run()` raising. Programmatic callers and tests need the exceptions.
In qutebrowser/app.py, find every user-facing entry point that executes command text. These are the startup args loop (`e.startswith(':')`) and the signal connection `cmd.got_cmd.connect(...)`.
Switch each of those entry points to `commandmanager.run_safely`.

Check other signal/slot connections that dispatch command strings, such as keybinding handlers and hint or mode managers. Decide for each whether it is user-triggered. If it is, route it via run_safely as well.
validation: Run the existing tests.
Start with `qutebrowser ':nonexistentcmd'` and confirm the app stays up and shows an error message.
Type an invalid command and a wrong-arg-count command in the command line, and confirm each shows an error instead of a traceback.
Run `grep -n 'commandmanager.run\b' qutebrowser/app.py` and confirm no user-facing caller remains on the raising variant.

name: scope-qstyle-proxy-to-tabbar-not-tabwidget
negative_constraints: Do not call setStyle with a custom proxy or QCommonStyle on a container widget such as QTabWidget when only one sub-widget needs the fix. It leaks into all child widgets.
Do not wrap the parent's style() when the style is being attached to the child. Use the child's own style() as the base.
Do not leave the old class name in place after moving the style to a different widget, either as an alias or as stale references.
Do not change the stylesheet registration (set_register_stylesheet) or the size policy as part of this fix.
procedure: Locate the custom style setup in TabWidget.__init__ (qutebrowser/widgets/tabwidget.py). Look for any place that calls setStyle with a custom QCommonStyle subclass. Such a subclass usually wraps another style through a stored _style and forwards calls to it.

Find the narrowest widget that actually needs the custom drawing. Tab-related overrides such as the focus rect on tabs, CE_TabBarTab and tab labels belong on the QTabBar. They do not belong on the QTabWidget, because a style set on the QTabWidget also propagates to child widgets like the webviews and other tab contents.

Construct the custom tab bar into a local variable (bar = TabBar()). Then call self.setTabBar(bar) and configure that same reference (bar.setDrawBase(False), and so on). Avoid configuring it through repeated self.tabBar() calls.
Install the style on the bar itself, wrapping the bar's own base style: bar.setStyle(TabBarStyle(bar.style())). Do not wrap self.style() of the parent widget.
Rename the style class and update its docstring so the name matches its new target, e.g. TabWidgetStyle becomes TabBarStyle. Grep the repo for the old class name and update every reference.
validation: grep -rn 'TabWidgetStyle' qutebrowser/ should return no results.
Run the existing test suite and pylint/flake8 on qutebrowser/widgets/tabwidget.py.
Launch qutebrowser and confirm that tabs still render without a focus rectangle and with the custom layout.
Confirm that web content and other child widgets of the tab widget now use the native or default style rather than the tab style.

name: scope-statusbar-stylesheet-selectors-to-leaf-widgets
negative_constraints: 不要为 QMenu 单独补一套颜色来掩盖问题。根因是选择器过宽导致级联, 应当收窄选择器。
不要新增或重命名配置里的 color/font 键。这只是选择器修复, 不需要改配置。
不要把选择器收窄到漏掉 statusbar 中仍需前景色的控件类型。修改前先确认 statusbar 里有哪些控件类型, 例如 QLabel 子类和 QLineEdit 子类 Command。
procedure: 定位出问题的子控件所属的父容器 stylesheet 模板。本例是 qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar/bar.py 中 StatusBar 的 Jinja 风格 STYLESHEET, 内容用 {{ color[...] }} 和 {{ font[...] }} 填充。
查找设置 fg 颜色或字体的泛型选择器, 如 `QWidget { ... }`。Qt 的样式会级联到所有子控件, 包括 QLineEdit 等控件弹出的 QMenu。右键菜单因此继承了 statusbar 前景色, 却仍使用默认背景, 导致文字看不清。
把泛型选择器收窄为实际需要样式的叶子控件类型。本例改为 `QLabel, QLineEdit { color; font }`, 这样 statusbar 中的标签和命令输入框保持原样式, 弹出菜单不再被波及。
保留原有的模板占位符, 比如 color['statusbar.fg'] 和 font['statusbar']。只修改选择器, 不要改动配色键。
检查同一 stylesheet 中其余基于属性的选择器是否仍然生效, 例如 [error="true"] 背景规则。确认收窄选择器后, 原本依赖 QWidget 匹配的样式没有丢失。
validation: 运行现有测试套件, 确认没有回归。
手动验证: 启动 qutebrowser, 在命令栏(:)右键, 确认菜单文字颜色与背景对比正常。
手动验证: statusbar 中的标签(url、进度、文本)和命令输入框仍使用 statusbar.fg 颜色和 statusbar 字体。
手动验证: 处于 error 状态时 statusbar 背景色仍然正确切换。

name: simplify-stack-capture-in-log-handlers
negative_constraints: 不要使用 sys._getframe 等 CPython 私有 API 来获取堆栈, 也不要为它添加防御性 try/except 和 pylint 抑制。
不要改变 Qt 消息的级别映射、过滤列表或 makeRecord 的其他参数。
不要为了少显示一层堆栈帧而重新引入手动帧裁剪逻辑; 多出的 handler 帧可以接受。
不要顺带修改 xkbcommon/faulthandler 相关的特殊处理分支。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/utils/log.py 中的 qt_message_handler, 找到用于构造 makeRecord(..., sinfo=stack) 的堆栈获取代码。
将基于 sys._getframe(1) 的 try/except 包装 (含 AttributeError/ValueError 回退和 pylint protected-access 抑制) 删除。
复用标准库: 直接写 stack = ''.join(traceback.format_stack()), 不传 f 参数, 让 traceback 自行从当前帧开始。
保留 qt.makeRecord(name, level, context.file, context.line, msg, None, None, func, sinfo=stack) 和 qt.handle(record) 调用不变。
检查 sys 是否仍在本模块其他地方被使用; 如果不再使用, 删除 import sys 以免产生 unused-import 告警。
validation: 运行现有 log 相关测试: pytest tests/unit/utils/test_log.py。
运行 pylint/flake8 检查 qutebrowser/utils/log.py, 确认没有 unused import 或 protected-access 告警。
手动或通过测试触发一条 Qt warning, 确认日志记录的 stack_info 非空且包含调用链。

name: snapshot-qt-event-data-instead-of-storing-event-objects
negative_constraints: Do not store QEvent or QKeyEvent references beyond the handler call, and do not rely on their identity or equality.
Do not include modifiers in the equality or hash of the snapshot. The release would then fail to match its press, and the release would be swallowed.
Do not implement __eq__ without __hash__ when the object goes into a set.
Do not change the filtering policy itself. Only change how press/release pairs are matched.
procedure: Find the code that keeps a QKeyEvent (or any other QEvent) after the handler has returned. In qutebrowser, look at the press/release pairing in qutebrowser/keyinput/modeman.py, starting with ModeManager._eventFilter_keypress, _eventFilter_keyrelease and _releaseevents_to_pass.
Qt reuses and mutates event objects. A stored event reference or an `in` / `==` comparison on it is unreliable, because the object's data may already have changed.

Add a small value class, such as KeyEvent, in the same module. Its __init__ should copy only the fields that stay the same between press and release, which are key() and text(). Do not store modifiers(), because they can differ between the press and the release.
Implement __eq__ and __hash__ on the value class using the same tuple, (key, text). Implement __repr__ with utils.get_repr so debug logs show the snapshot.

Change the container from a list to a set. On keypress, if the event is not filtered, call `self._releaseevents_to_pass.add(KeyEvent(event))`. On keyrelease, build a KeyEvent(event). If it is in the set, remove it and let the release through. Otherwise filter the release.
Update the docstrings for the attribute and the class so they describe 'a set of KeyEvents', and explain why snapshots are needed (Qt mutates existing events).
validation: Run the existing test suite, especially the keyinput tests.
Write a unit check. Build two mock events with the same key and text but different modifiers, and confirm that their KeyEvent snapshots compare equal and hash equal.

Check manually: in normal mode with forward-unbound-keys enabled, press and release an unbound key. Confirm the release reaches the widget, and that the set is empty after the release, so nothing leaks.
Check that a release with no matching passed-through press is still filtered.

name: speculative-fixme-is-not-a-bug-to-fix
negative_constraints: 不要因为任务被标记为 bugfix 就改动运行时逻辑。
不要引入新的 API 依赖(如 QKeySequence)来'兑现'被删除的 FIXME。
procedure: 阅读 FIXME 原文, 将其分类为: (a) 已知错误行为, (b) 推测性重构建议。
对类别 (b), 若任务标题是 'Remove FIXME', 解决方式就是删除注释, 而不是实现建议。
核对当前实现(如基于 e.text() 的按键文本匹配)是否已能正常工作。若能, 删除注释即可。
validation: 运行现有测试套件, 确认结果与修改前一致。
检查改动行数: 应只有删除, 没有新增。

name: split-qt-widgets-module-into-package
negative_constraints: Do not leave a widgets.py and a widgets/ directory at the same time. The names collide and imports become ambiguous.
Do not change class names, constructor signatures, objectName or setDocumentMode behavior while splitting.
Do not keep unused Qt imports in the new files.
Do not miss any call site that still uses the old path 'from qutebrowser.widgets import X'.
procedure: Locate the monolithic module, e.g. qutebrowser/widgets.py. List each top-level QWidget subclass in it, such as StatusBar, StatusText, StatusCommand and TabWidget.
Group the classes by UI component. Helper classes go with their owner: StatusText and StatusCommand belong with StatusBar.

Turn the module into a package with the same name: create qutebrowser/widgets/. Prefer git mv to rename the original file to the largest submodule (widgets.py -> widgets/statusbar.py) so history is kept. Add an __init__.py if the repo uses regular packages.
Create a new submodule for each remaining group, e.g. widgets/tabbar.py. Move the class bodies over unchanged.
Trim the imports in each submodule so they match the classes it now contains. Remove imports that are no longer used, such as QTabWidget left behind in statusbar.py.

grep the whole repo for 'from qutebrowser.widgets import' and 'import qutebrowser.widgets'. Change every call site to import from the concrete submodule, e.g. app.py: 'from qutebrowser.widgets.statusbar import StatusBar' and 'from qutebrowser.widgets.tabbar import TabWidget'.
Clean up the call sites' own Qt imports as well. If QTabWidget is no longer used in app.py, remove it from that import list.
validation: python -c 'from qutebrowser.widgets.statusbar import StatusBar; from qutebrowser.widgets.tabbar import TabWidget'
grep -rn 'from qutebrowser.widgets import' returns nothing
Start qutebrowser/app.py; the status bar and tab bar should render as before
Run pyflakes/pylint to confirm there are no unused or missing imports
run existing tests

name: statusbar-command-history-prefix-browse
negative_constraints: 不要只过滤一次就修改 self.history 本身。过滤结果只能放在临时的 _tmphist 里, 原始历史必须保持完整。
不要在浏览途中根据当前显示的文本重新计算前缀。前缀只在会话开始 (_histpos is None) 时捕获, 否则第二次按 Up 会用已补全的整条命令作为前缀。
不要用 _histpos 的真假值判断是否处于浏览状态。0 是合法位置, 必须用 'is None' 判断。
不要遗漏 focusOut 和提交命令时的状态复位, 否则下次进入命令行会沿用旧的 _tmphist 和旧位置。
过滤前要去掉前导 ':', 因为 history 中存储的命令不带 ':'。否则前缀永远匹配不上。
不要在 _tmphist 为空时继续索引, 否则会抛 IndexError。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar.py 中的 StatusCommand(QLineEdit), 找到 history 列表、_histpos 和 key_up_handler/key_down_handler。
引入一个浏览会话状态: 增加 _tmphist (当前会话的过滤后历史视图), 并用 _histpos is None 表示 '不在浏览中'。
增加 _histbrowse_start(): 先取 self.text().strip().lstrip(':') 作为前缀。前缀非空时, 设 _tmphist = [e for e in history if e.startswith(pre)]; 前缀为空时, 用完整 history。最后设 _histpos = len(_tmphist) - 1。
增加 _histbrowse_stop(): 把 _histpos 置为 None。所有结束浏览的路径都统一调用它, 不要在各处直接写 _histpos = None。
key_up: 如果 _histpos 为 None, 就调用 _histbrowse_start() 并显示最新的匹配项。如果 _histpos <= 0 或 _tmphist 为空, 直接 return。其他情况 _histpos -= 1。
key_down: 如果 _histpos 为 None、已到达 len(_tmphist)-1, 或 _tmphist 为空, 直接 return。否则 _histpos += 1。
up/down 都只用 _tmphist 做索引和边界判断, 不再直接索引 self.history。显示时走已有的 set_cmd(':' + entry) 入口, 不要直接调用 setText。
在所有结束编辑的路径调用 _histbrowse_stop(): process_cmd (提交命令) 和 focusOutEvent 中清空文本的分支。这样下次按 Up 会按新的前缀重新过滤。
validation: run existing tests (若存在)。
手动验证: 依次执行 ':open a'、':open b'、':reload', 然后输入 ':op' 按 Up, 应显示 ':open b'; 再按 Up 应显示 ':open a'; 再按 Up 应停留不变; 按 Down 应回到 ':open b'。
手动验证: 空输入按 Up 应遍历全部历史; 无匹配前缀时按 Up 不应崩溃。
手动验证: 浏览途中失焦或回车提交后, 换一个前缀再按 Up, 应按新前缀过滤。
检查 debug 日志的 format 参数与占位符数量一致, 避免多余参数掩盖问题。

name: statusbar-segmented-text-widget
negative_constraints: Do not store a copy of the previous label text so you can restore it later. Asynchronous updates, such as keystring or scroll percentage changing while an error is shown, will be lost or will resurrect stale text.

Do not name a segment attribute 'text'. Do not name the render method 'update'. These shadow QLabel.text() and QWidget.update(), which breaks Qt repaint and any code that reads label.text(). Prefer names like 'text_segment' and '_render'.
If you use a __setattr__ hook, only re-render for the known segment names. Re-rendering on every attribute assignment, including assignments made inside Qt or __init__, is fragile.
Do not leave call sites using the old attribute name or the old disp_error/clear_error API after renaming.
procedure: Open qutebrowser/widgets/statusbar.py. Find the StatusText(QLabel) class and the StatusBar methods that drive it, such as disp_error and clear_error.
Replace the save-and-restore approach (pre_error_text plus setText) with independent named segments: keystring, error, text and scrollperc. Default each one to the empty string.
Build the label content in one place by concatenating the segments in a fixed order and calling setText with the result. A segment change must never overwrite the other segments.
Re-render automatically whenever a segment is assigned. Either use a setter or property for each segment, or use a __setattr__ hook that calls the render method after the assignment.
Make StatusBar set the segment directly. disp_error assigns txt.error = text, and clear_error assigns txt.error = ''. Keep the color changes and the has_error flag in StatusBar.

If you rename the child widget attribute (lbl to txt), grep the whole repository for '.lbl' and the old method names (disp_error/clear_error on the label). Update every caller, including signal connections in the main window and browser modules.
validation: Run the existing tests or a linter such as pyflakes or pylint on statusbar.py.
Launch qutebrowser. Trigger an error and check that the bar turns red and shows the error.
Clear the error and check that the other segments (keystring and scroll percentage) are still shown.
Grep for '.lbl' and confirm there are no remaining references.

name: strip-single-prefix-char-not-lstrip
negative_constraints: 不要用 str.lstrip(c) 去除单个前缀。lstrip 会去掉所有连续的相同字符，导致搜索 '//foo' 变成 'foo'、命令 '::cmd' 变成 'cmd'。
不要在没有确认前缀存在的地方直接用 [1:] 切片，否则会吞掉正常的首字符。
不要改动用户输入的其余部分，例如不要额外做 strip() 去空白。
procedure: 定位所有用 lstrip(ch) 去掉 mode/command 前缀字符的位置。在 qutebrowser 中重点查 qutebrowser/mainwindow/statusbar/command.py 的 accept 逻辑（text[0] 分发到 search/rev-search/command signals），以及 qutebrowser/app.py 中处理以 ':' 开头的启动参数的 cmd.lstrip(':')。
用 grep 搜索 `lstrip(` 和 `lstrip(text[0])`，确认去掉的是单个已知前缀字符，而不是任意数量的重复字符。
把 lstrip(prefix) 改为切片 text[1:]（多字符前缀用 text[len(prefix):]）。前提是调用前已确认 text 以该前缀开头，例如通过 text[0] in signals 或 startswith(':')。
保持其它逻辑不变：signal 分发映射、history.append、modeman.leave 的调用顺序都不要动。
检查同一类前缀解析是否还有其它入口（statusbar 命令行、启动参数、IPC、userscript），并统一修复。
validation: 运行现有测试套件（pytest / tox），确认没有回归。
手动验证：在命令行输入 '//foo' 时，搜索词应为 '/foo'；输入 '??bar' 时，反向搜索词应为 '?bar'。
手动验证：启动参数 '::open' 或 ':open x' 只去掉一个 ':'。
如有 statusbar command 的单测，补充以重复前缀字符开头的用例。

name: suppress-harmless-qt-warning-in-log-handler
negative_constraints: Do not delete or filter the message entirely. Matched messages are demoted to logging.DEBUG and stay available for debugging.
Do not add a separate filter mechanism or a new if-branch. Reuse the suppressed_msgs tuple.
Do not forget the comma after the previous last entry. Implicit string concatenation would merge two patterns into one and break both.
Do not suppress messages that may point to real bugs without a justification comment or upstream reference.
Do not change the logging level logic or the re.match/strip semantics for the whole handler.
procedure: Open qutebrowser/utils/log.py. Find qt_message_handler(msg_type, context, msg) and its suppressed_msgs tuple.
Copy the exact Qt warning text from a user report or log. Check whether it is a fixed string or contains variable parts such as hex codes, IDs or paths.

Add a new entry at the end of suppressed_msgs. Put a comment line above it that says why the message is harmless. Link the upstream QTBUG URL if there is one, for example '# Harmless, see https://bugreports.qt-project.org/browse/QTBUG-NNNNN'.
Matching uses re.match(pattern, msg.strip()). re.match anchors at the start of the string, so begin the pattern at the start of the message.
If the message has variable parts, use a raw string (r'...') with \S+ or similar placeholders.
If the message is a fixed string, regex special characters still count. '.', '(' and '?' are interpreted, and '::' is literal. Escape them where they matter, or accept the benign over-match of '.'.
Split long messages with adjacent string literal concatenation across lines. Check that every split keeps the spaces between words, such as 'defaulting to ' + 'application/...'.
Add a trailing comma after the previous last element so the new entry becomes a separate tuple item. Without it, Python concatenates adjacent string literals silently.
Put the closing parenthesis of the tuple on its own line if the entry spans several lines, matching the existing style.
validation: Run the existing test suite, including tests for utils/log.py if present.
In a Python REPL, check that re.match(new_pattern, '<exact Qt message>'.strip()) is truthy.
Check that len(suppressed_msgs) grew by exactly one, which confirms no accidental literal concatenation.
Run flake8/pylint on log.py to catch line-length and style issues.

name: suppress-intentional-pylint-warning-inline
negative_constraints: Do not disable the check for the whole module or class, or in pylintrc, when only one line is intentional.
Do not use numeric message IDs (W0122). Use the symbolic name, such as exec-used.
Do not rewrite or remove the deliberate crash/exec code just to satisfy the linter.
Do not push the line past the project's max line length. If the comment would overflow, wrap the statement instead.
procedure: Run pylint on the module and find the exact line and message symbol, e.g. exec-used on qutebrowser/app.py.
Check whether the flagged construct is intentional. One example is the deliberate segfault in the debug-crash path of QuteBrowser, which builds a bogus types.CodeType and calls exec(co).
If the code is intentional, append a trailing comment `# pylint: disable=<symbol>` to that one statement. Use the symbolic name, not the numeric code.
Leave the logic and the surrounding comments untouched. The only change is the trailing disable comment.
Re-run pylint on the file and confirm the warning is gone and no new useless-suppression or line-too-long warning appears.
validation: Run pylint on the changed file (e.g. `pylint qutebrowser/app.py`) and confirm the targeted message no longer appears.
Run flake8/pep8 on the file and confirm line length is still within limits.
Run the existing tests to confirm behavior is unchanged.

name: sync-stale-code-comments-after-refactor
negative_constraints: Do not change code behavior or argument defaults in a comment-only fix.
Do not keep pointers to removed or renamed functions or files.
Do not drop the explanation of non-obvious choices such as store_const versus store_true. Drop only the obsolete parts.
procedure: Locate comments that reference function names or module paths, e.g. 'needs to be added to _get_qt_args in app.py'.
Use grep to check that the referenced symbol still exists at the stated location. In this case _get_qt_args in app.py has been moved to utils/misc.py as get_qt_args.

Delete maintenance instructions that no longer hold. Here the old comment said a new option must also be registered by hand. Read the current implementation to see whether that is still needed. get_qt_args now iterates over the namespace generically, so the step is no longer required.
Keep the rationale that is still valid: Qt args use store_const with const=True instead of store_true so the default stays None. Write it as one compact sentence.
Point the reference at the new location in module:function form, e.g. utils.misc:get_qt_args.
Change only the comment lines. Do not touch the argparse definitions.
validation: Use grep to confirm the referenced symbol (get_qt_args) exists in qutebrowser/utils/misc.py.
Run flake8/pylint on qutebrowser/qutebrowser.py to check comment line length.
Run the existing tests, e.g. pytest tests/unit/utils/test_misc.py -k qt_args, to confirm nothing broke.

name: tabbed-browser-resolve-page-via-current-widget
negative_constraints: 不要给 TabbedBrowser 加一个缓存的 self.page_ 属性来让代码跑通。切换 tab 后它会过期。
不要在同一方法中分别从 self 和 self.currentWidget() 取 viewport 尺寸与 frame。混用来源正是这次回归的原因。
不要顺带重写滚动算法，也不要处理 HTML frames 的 FIXME。这些超出本次修复范围。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/widgets/browser.py 中报错或行为回归的 TabbedBrowser.cur_* 方法。
检查方法里是否直接用 self.page_ 或其他属于单个 tab 的属性。TabbedBrowser 是 TabWidget 容器，page_ 挂在每个 tab 的 browser widget 上，容器自身没有这个属性。
把方法开头改成 page = self.currentWidget().page_，后续的 viewportSize() 和 mainFrame() 都通过这个局部变量取。这样尺寸和滚动作用在同一个页面上，也只解析一次当前 tab。
保持原有的 count / mx / my 换算逻辑，即 int(count) * float(mx) * size.width()。只修正对象来源，不改算法。
在同一个类里搜索其余的 self.page_ 和 self.<per-tab attr> 用法，按同样的方式改为经由 currentWidget() 访问。
validation: 如果有现成测试就运行；否则启动 qutebrowser 打开多个 tab，分别执行 scroll_page 命令（含正负值和 count 前缀），确认没有 AttributeError，并且滚动的是当前 tab。
切换到另一个尺寸或内容不同的 tab 后再滚动，确认滚动距离按当前 tab 的视口计算。
grep 'self.page_' qutebrowser/widgets/browser.py，确认 TabbedBrowser 内没有残留的直接引用。

name: unify-command-exception-hierarchy
negative_constraints: Do not leave aliases or imports of the removed exception classes. A dangling import raises ImportError at startup.
Do not keep command exceptions subclassing ValueError or TypeError. Broad excepts would then swallow genuine bugs.
Do not raise exceptions without a message. The old bare `raise NeedsJSError` is the anti-pattern.
Do not define the exceptions in _command.py or in the commandmanager. Keep them in _exceptions.py to avoid circular imports.
procedure: Open qutebrowser/commands/_exceptions.py. This module exists to avoid circular imports, so define every command exception here.
Add a common base class `CommandError(Exception)`.
Make NoSuchCommandError and ArgumentCountError inherit from CommandError. Drop their old builtin bases (ValueError and TypeError) so that callers cannot accidentally catch real programming errors.

Merge the narrow precondition exceptions (InvalidModeError, NeedsJSError) into one `PrerequisitesError(CommandError)`. Express what differs between them in the message text, not in the exception type.
In qutebrowser/commands/_command.py `Command.check()`, change the import to `ArgumentCountError, PrerequisitesError`.
Raise PrerequisitesError for each of the three cases: the modes whitelist, the not_modes blacklist, and needs_js when QWebSettings JavascriptEnabled is off.
Prefix every message with the command name, as in `'{}: This command ...'.format(self.name, ...)`. The user should be able to see which command failed.
Update the docstring `Raise:` section to list the new exception names.

Grep the whole repo for the removed names (InvalidModeError, NeedsJSError) and for `except ValueError` / `except TypeError` that were catching command errors. Migrate each of these to CommandError or a subclass.
validation: Run the existing tests (python -m unittest / tox) and fix any reference to the old exception names.
Run `python -c 'import qutebrowser.app'` to confirm no ImportError or circular import.
Run `grep -rn 'InvalidModeError\|NeedsJSError' qutebrowser/` and confirm it returns nothing.
Trigger a mode-restricted command in the wrong mode and confirm the error message starts with the command name.

name: unwrap-config-value-wrappers-at-consumers
negative_constraints: 不要把包装对象（type 实例）直接作为 dict key 或命令字符串使用，否则查找会因为 hash/eq 不匹配静默失败。
不要在调用方继续捕获 configparser 风格的 NoOptionError，自定义 section 抛的是 KeyError。
不要假设 ValueListSection 已有 values 属性，也不要在 __init__ 里于包装前访问或记录未定义的状态。
不要把整个 section 对象直接传给 str.format 的映射包装器；ColorDict/FontDict 期望的是原始 dict。
procedure: 定位所有消费 config.config[...] 或 config.config.get(...) 结果的调用点，例如 commands/keys.py 的 KeyParser 绑定注册、config/style.py 的 get_stylesheet、commands/parsers.py 的 alias 查找。
确认 config/templates.py 中 section 的数据形态：ValueListSection 会把 default 的 key/value 都包装成 types[0]/types[1] 实例，这些实例的原始值放在 .value 上。
在消费点显式解包：存入 dict 的 key 和 value 都用 .value，例如 self._bindings[key.value] = cmd.value。对整个 section 要取原始映射时用 section.values，例如 config.config['colors'].values，然后再传给 ColorDict/FontDict。
日志里也打印解包后的值（cmd.value），保持日志可读且与实际存储一致。
对齐异常类型：ValueListSection.__getitem__ 在缺 key 时抛 KeyError，所以调用方的 except 要从 config.NoOptionError 改成 KeyError。
检查 section 类自身：在 __init__ 中初始化 self.values = OrderedDict()，避免 __getitem__ 访问未定义属性。核对属性名拼写，回退时用 self.default，不是 self.defaults。
validation: 启动 qutebrowser 并加 debug 日志，确认 'registered key: X -> cmd' 打印的是原始字符串，不是对象 repr。
按下已配置的普通键和 @mod@ 修饰键绑定，确认命令被触发。
执行一个已配置的 alias 和一个未配置的命令，确认 alias 能展开，未知命令不会抛出未捕获的 KeyError。
调用 style.get_stylesheet(template)，确认能格式化出颜色和字体；如仍失败，检查 ColorDict/FontDict 的 __getitem__ 是否也需要解包 .value。
运行现有测试套件（如有）。

name: version-gate-pyqt-bug-workaround
negative_constraints: Do not delete the workaround entirely. Older supported PyQt versions still need it.
Do not compare version strings lexically. Use the integer PYQT_VERSION hex constant.
Do not mix up PYQT_VERSION and QT_VERSION. Gate on the library that actually contains the bug.
Do not change what happens after the call in either branch, such as request tracking or signal connections.
Do not leave stale comments that describe the issue as an unknown Qt freeze.
procedure: Locate the unconditional workaround for the PyQt/Qt bug. For example, in qutebrowser/network/networkmanager.py, NetworkManager.createRequest wraps super().createRequest in `with log.disable_qt_msghandler():`.

Find out which upstream release fixes the bug, for example from the riverbankcomputing PyQt mailing list or a changelog. Encode that release as a hex constant in the form 0xMMmmpp, e.g. 0x050301 for 5.3.1.
Import PYQT_VERSION from PyQt5.QtCore by adding it to the existing import line. For Qt-level bugs, use QT_VERSION or qVersion instead.
Replace the unconditional context manager with `if PYQT_VERSION < 0xXXXXXX:` that keeps the workaround, plus an `else:` that runs the plain call.
Make both branches assign the same variable, e.g. `reply`. Leave the code after the branches unchanged, such as self._requests.append(reply) and the destroyed.connect bookkeeping.
Rewrite the comment so it gives the real root cause (a PyQt bug), a reproduction example, and the upstream reference URL. Remove FIXME questions that are now answered.
If you have not confirmed the fix yourself, add a FIXME saying the fixed version still needs verification.
validation: Run the existing tests: python -m unittest or tox for qutebrowser.
Run a static check (pyflakes/pylint) to confirm PYQT_VERSION is imported and used, and that `reply` is defined in both branches.
Manually check that both branches execute: either on a PyQt version below the threshold, or by temporarily flipping the condition and loading a page so createRequest returns a reply.
Confirm the hex constant matches the intended version: hex(PYQT_VERSION) against PyQt5.QtCore.PYQT_VERSION_STR.

name: version-gate-pyqt-workaround
negative_constraints: Do not compare against a version string (e.g. '5.3.2') or parse PYQT_VERSION_STR. Use the integer PYQT_VERSION with a hex literal.
Do not remove the old workaround outright. Older PyQt is still supported, and on it exceptions would be silently swallowed again.
Do not reintroduce the QTimer single-shot re-raise approach. The comment records that it caused a KeyError problem.
Do not change the `# pylint: disable=bare-except` annotation or narrow the caught exception types. The branch must re-raise the original exception unchanged.
Do not touch tests or the changelog unless asked. This change only touches the code surface.
procedure: Search qutebrowser/ for workaround comments that name a target version, e.g. 'FIXME: This should be fixed with PyQt X.Y.Z'. Common hits are the bare except in BrowserPage.extension() in qutebrowser/browser/webpage.py.
Do not delete the old workaround outright. Wrap it in a version branch instead. Write the comparison as a hex integer, e.g. `if PYQT_VERSION >= 0x50302:`, where 0x50302 corresponds to 5.3.2.
In the new-version branch, restore the original intended behavior. For the extension() case, use a bare `raise` so the exception propagates normally.
Move the original workaround code and its explanatory comment into the else branch. That keeps behavior unchanged on older PyQt. Re-wrap the comment to fit line length after the extra indentation.
Delete the FIXME line about re-checking once the version ships, since it is now handled. Keep the WORKAROUND explanation and the upstream bug link.
Make sure PYQT_VERSION is imported at the top of the module, e.g. `from PyQt5.QtCore import PYQT_VERSION`. If an existing import line already exists, extend it rather than adding a duplicate.
validation: Run python -m py_compile qutebrowser/browser/webpage.py and the existing unit tests.
Run pylint/flake8 to confirm there is no undefined-name error for PYQT_VERSION and no line-length violations.
Simulate an exception inside an extension handler. On PyQt >= 5.3.2 it should propagate. On older versions it should only be logged via log.webview.exception and return False.

name: whitespace-only-change-scope-guard
negative_constraints: Do not reformat the whole file with an auto-formatter, because it creates noisy diffs in qutebrowser's hand-formatted code.
Do not alter line wrapping of continued arguments (e.g. `immediately=True` alignment) unless flagged.
procedure: Identify the exact lines the style checker reports. Restrict edits to those lines.
Apply the minimal whitespace edit: add or remove a blank line, or adjust spacing.
Verify with `git diff -w` that it shows no changes, which proves the commit is behavior-neutral.
Use a short commit subject such as 'Whitespace fix'.
validation: Confirm `git diff -w` is empty.
Confirm the linter reports no new warnings.
Run existing tests to confirm nothing changed.

name: wrap-qt-widget-in-own-subclass
negative_constraints: 不要在 app.py 中对原生 QTabWidget 实例直接调用 setStyleSheet，样式应放在 widgets.py 的子类里。
不要省略 setObjectName(self.__class__.__name__)，其它自定义控件都依赖这个约定。
不要把新控件放进新模块，应和 StatusBar 一起放在 qutebrowser/widgets.py。
不要改变构造签名：仍然只接收 parent，以保持与现有调用方式一致。
procedure: 在 qutebrowser/app.py 里找到直接实例化的 Qt 原生控件，例如 QTabWidget(self.cwidget)。
在 qutebrowser/widgets.py 中按 StatusBar/StatusCommand 的写法新增子类，例如 class TabWidget(QTabWidget)。
子类 __init__ 接收 parent 参数，然后调用 super().__init__(parent)。
在 __init__ 中调用 self.setObjectName(self.__class__.__name__)，与现有控件的命名约定保持一致。
把外观相关代码收进子类，通过 self.setStyleSheet(...) 设置。样式表用多行字符串，选择器针对子部件，例如 QTabWidget::pane、QTabBar::tab、QTabBar::tab:selected。
在 widgets.py 顶部的 PyQt5.QtWidgets 导入里补上新的基类，如 QTabWidget。
在 app.py 中把 from qutebrowser.widgets import ... 扩展为包含新类，并把原来的实例化改为 TabWidget(self.cwidget)。
如果样式效果需要多个元素才能看出来（比如选中和未选中的 tab），在 TestWindow 里多加一个测试 tab，并给它设置 objectName。
validation: 运行 python -m qutebrowser.app 或等价入口，确认窗口能启动、没有 ImportError。
目视检查：未选中的 tab 为灰底白字，选中的 tab 为黑底，pane 顶部没有多余间距。
确认 widgets.py 的导入包含新基类，并且 app.py 已不再需要直接实例化 QTabWidget。
